This case raises three important considerations: occupational swine exposure together with chronic alcoholism may plausibly contribute to suspected polymicrobial sepsis; in selected patients, peripheral-blood mNGS may help identify occult Gram-negative bacteremia when CSF assays remain negative during recurrent meningitis; and cochlear fibrosis may not absolutely preclude technically-successful cochlear implantation.

items.title: Establishing a rapid-response multidisciplinary service for thrombotic microangiopathies using a model of improvement framework: perspectives from a Brazilian quaternary hospital
items.abstract: Thrombotic microangiopathies (TMA) require prompt identification and coordinated treatment because they are associated with substantial morbidity, irreversible target-organ injury, and mortality. Yet fragmented diagnostic and care pathways often delay diagnosis and lead to poorer outcomes. This Perspective article describes the design and implementation of a TMA Center of Excellence at a Brazilian quaternary hospital. This initiative aimed to design and implement a rapid-response, multidisciplinary TMA service to shorten diagnostic and treatment delays, standardize diagnosis-specific care, and establish prospective measures to evaluate clinical and operational performance. Rather than reporting outcomes, we highlight design choices, stewardship safeguards for high-cost therapies, and practical implementation enablers. Multidisciplinary teams designed and tested diagnostic and therapeutic workflows using iterative Plan–Do–Study–Act cycles. Care pathways tailored to specific patient populations were embedded into the electronic medical record (EMR). EMR integration enabled real-time alerts triggered by key laboratory results, while embedded tools, such as the PLASMIC score (platelet count, hemolysis, no active cancer, no history of solid-organ or stem-cell transplant, mean corpuscular volume, international normalized ratio, and creatinine) and therapy-specific prescription menus, guided clinical decisions. A structured indicator framework was developed to prospectively monitor time to diagnosis, adherence to clinical pathways, length of stay, and intensive care utilization. Interdisciplinary collaboration facilitated alignment across emergency, radiology, laboratory, nephrology, and hematology services. This quality improvement strategy supports the feasibility of implementing a comprehensive, multidisciplinary model for TMA management and offers a transferable blueprint that middle-income health systems can adapt.

items.title: Teaching and assessment strategies in the obstetrics and gynaecology program: medical students' perceptions evaluation
items.abstract: BackgroundWorldwide, medical institutions face challenges in maintaining educational quality while accommodating the growing size of student cohorts. Assessment and critical analysis of educational programmes, particularly in the clinical years, are imperative for improving learning outcomes. This study aims to evaluate students' perceptions of the teaching and assessment methods used in the obstetrics and gynaecology programme.MethodsThis observational, cross-sectional study was conducted among fourth-year medical students enrolled in the obstetrics and gynaecology programme at the College of Medicine, King Saud University, Riyadh. A total of 300 students were enrolled. An electronically generated questionnaire comprising four sections, including 19 closed questions and five open-ended questions in English, was used. The first section addressed responses on the course guide; the second and third sections evaluated students' perceptions of the various teaching and assessment methods; the fourth section collected generalised responses on students' preferences and suggestions for program improvement. The data were analysed in relation to the GPA of the students involved in the study.ResultsAmong the study participants, 46.2% of students were satisfied with the course programme outlines and timings, 34.2% with the clarity of the course objectives, 40.2% with the teaching methods, and 32.6% with the clarity of the assessment tools. The lowest mean agreement scores were recorded for the usefulness of skills lab sessions in achieving clinical objectives. There were significant differences between genders (P < 0.05). The highest percentages of Agree or Strongly Agree responses were for the appropriateness of the assessment tools for each course objective.ConclusionThis study shows that students were satisfied with the newly introduced teaching and assessment methods. However, student satisfaction rates do not appear to be related to student achievements. Moreover, satisfaction was lower regarding the course guide and the educational and assessment methodologies. The study highlights the need to review the clinical skills laboratory, its educational components, and students' tasks.

items.title: Triglyceride–glucose index and preserved ratio impaired spirometry in 89,809 individuals without self-reported overt clinical disease
items.abstract: IntroductionWhile both preserved ratio impaired spirometry (PRISm) and triglyceride glucose index (TyG) are established risk factors for cardiometabolic diseases, the metabolic characteristics and prevalence of PRISm differ by ethnic group. However, this association has not been directly examined in Asian populations. Therefore, we aimed to investigate whether TyG is associated with PRISm in a large Korean population without self-reported overt clinical disease.MethodsIn this cross-sectional study, 89,809 adults (46,739 men; mean age: 38.5 years) with health examinations in 2019 were divided into quartiles according to their TyG. Lung function phenotypes were evaluated using fixed cut-offs and lower limit of normal (LLN) criteria, with LLN defined as the 5th percentile of our study population. Adjusted odds ratios (aORs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) for PRISm were estimated and compared to the lowest TyG quartile (reference) group.ResultsThe mean TyG was 8.34 ± 0.57, and the prevalence of PRISm was 3.4%, showing a significant increase across TyG quartiles (p for trend < 0.001). Compared with the lowest quartile, the aORs (95% CI) for PRISm were 1.157 (1.030–1.299), 1.232 (1.085–1.398), and 1.368 (1.193–1.567) 1 across the increasing quartiles of TyG (p for trend < 0.001). A similar increasing trend was observed for the spirometric restrictive pattern (SRP) across TyG quartiles (p for trend < 0.001), whereas no significant trend was found for the obstructive pattern (OP) (p = 0.135). Results obtained using fixed cut-off criteria were highly consistent with those based on LLN criteria.DiscussionIn conclusion, higher TyG quartiles were associated with PRISm in middle-aged Koreans without self-reported overt clinical disease, suggesting the potential link between metabolic status and PRISm risk. However, longitudinal studies are required to confirm these findings.

items.title: Codebook-guided multi-cue normality modeling for pulmonary CT anomaly detection
items.abstract: IntroductionAutomated anomaly detection from chest computed tomography (CT) may support research on pulmonary image triage without requiring exhaustive abnormal annotations. Supervised methods depend on costly expert labels, while many existing normal-only methods rely predominantly on a single anomaly cue. In pulmonary CT, heterogeneous lesion appearance and variation across slices and acquisition sources may reduce the reliability of single-cue scoring. This study develops a codebook-guided framework that integrates complementary cues for abnormality detection and spatial heatmap generation.MethodsThe framework combines residual vector-quantized reconstruction, transformer-based token discrimination learned through codebook-guided latent perturbation, and quantization-distance scoring. The primary benchmark combined three public CT datasets. Slice-level evaluation used a visually screened, lesion-enriched subset, whereas patient-level evaluation retained all valid lung-containing slices and aggregated the highest 10% of slice scores by their mean. Patient-level thresholds were calibrated using normal validation patients only. Quantitative localization was additionally evaluated on 100 LIDC-IDRI cases containing nodules marked by at least three radiologists.ResultsThe proposed method achieved a slice-level AUROC of 0.9218. At the patient level, it achieved an AUROC of 0.9187±0.0123, balanced accuracy of 0.7521±0.0354, and F1-score of 0.9297±0.0052; the patient-stratified bootstrap 95% confidence interval for AUROC was 0.8786–0.9727. Disease-wise patient-level AUROC ranged from 0.8470 for COVID-19 to 0.9747 for community-acquired pneumonia. On the external LIDC-IDRI localization cohort, the proposed method achieved a P-AUROC of 0.9155, the highest observed value among the evaluated methods.DiscussionThe findings indicate that multi-cue normality modeling remains effective after patient-level aggregation and provides quantitative localization capability on an external nodule cohort. Same-source comparisons within COVID-CT-MD reduce, but do not eliminate, concern about dataset-source confounding. Because the study used retrospective public datasets and lacked prospective patient-level external validation, the results should be interpreted as methodological evidence rather than clinical validation.

items.title: Clinical features and early warning factors of symptomatic pulmonary embolism after total joint arthroplasty: a retrospective cohort study
items.abstract: BackgroundSymptomatic pulmonary embolism (PE) is a severe and life-threatening complication following total joint arthroplasty (TJA). Despite advances in diagnosis, treatment, and prediction, postoperative PE still occurs. This study aimed to investigate the onset time window, initial clinical presentations, and preoperative comorbidity profiles of patients with symptomatic PE after TJA, thereby providing clinical evidence for early identification and perioperative management of post-TJA PE.MethodsIn this retrospective study, patients who underwent TJA at our institution between January 2023 and December 2025 and were diagnosed with postoperative PE via computed tomography pulmonary angiography were assigned to the case group. Non-PE patients were randomly selected at a 1:2 ratio as controls. Data collected included baseline patient characteristics, surgical procedure, time from surgery to PE onset, chief complaints at onset, BMI, and preoperative comorbidities. Age-stratified analyses were conducted to compare symptom distributions. Multivariable logistic regression was then performed to evaluate the associations between physiological parameters, chief complaints, and PE at onset, and the diagnostic performance of identified warning factors was calculated.ResultsA total of 5,120 patients who underwent TJA were evaluated. Symptomatic PE was diagnosed in 84 patients (1.64%), with a mean age of 67.4 ± 8.8 years. Among these, 73 underwent total knee arthroplasty (TKA) and 11 underwent total hip arthroplasty (THA). The mean time from surgery to PE onset was 51.8 ± 26.1 h, with 72 cases (85.7%) occurring within 72 h postoperatively. No significant differences in preoperative comorbidities were observed between the two groups (P > 0.05). At PE onset, pulse oxygen saturation (SpO2) monitoring revealed decreased SpO2 in 78 patients (92.9%). The most common presenting symptoms were respiratory manifestations (n = 48, 57.1%), followed by altered mental status (n = 22, 26.2%), precordial discomfort (n = 12, 14.3%), chills and fever (n = 8, 9.5%), fatigue (n = 7, 8.3%), and headache or dizziness (n = 4, 4.8%). Age-stratified analyses revealed significant differences in the distribution of SpO2, respiratory symptoms, and altered mental status (P < 0.05). Multivariable logistic regression identified lower levels of SpO2 (OR = 0.668, 95% CI: 0.599–0.745) as being independently associated with PE, while respiratory symptoms (OR = 16.448, 95% CI: 5.408–50.029) and altered mental status (OR = 5.828, 95% CI: 1.485–22.879) were established as independent predictors. The combined early recognition model incorporating these three parameters demonstrated an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.966 (95% CI: 0.947–0.984), exhibiting superior warning performance compared to any single indicator.ConclusionPost-TJA PE predominantly occurs within 72 h postoperatively. Decreased SpO2, respiratory symptoms, and altered mental status serve as early warning signs, with a combined early recognition model demonstrating superior warning performance compared to any single parameter. Early postoperative vital sign monitoring and recognition of age-related atypical symptoms should be enhanced to improve the early identification and management of PE.

items.title: Intertwin umbilical vein diameter-to-abdominal circumference discordance in type 1 selective fetal growth restriction twins: association with risk of perinatal death in the smaller twin
items.abstract: ObjectiveSelective fetal growth restriction (sFGR) is a common complication of monochorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancies, and there is no unified clinical standard for determining the optimal timing of intervention. This study aimed to explore the value of ultrasound parameters for identifying risk of perinatal death (PND) of the smaller twin complicated with type 1 sFGR.MethodsThis single-center retrospective cohort study included 49 women with type 1 sFGR twin pregnancies who received regular prenatal ultrasound examination and had complete clinical and follow-up data. Cases with type 2/3 sFGR, fetal structural or chromosomal abnormalities, severe maternal complications, intrauterine intervention, or loss to follow-up were excluded. The primary outcome was PND of the smaller twin with type 1 sFGR, defined as either intrauterine death or 28-day neonatal death. The patients were divided into the PND group (n = 19) and the non-PND group (n = 30). Baseline ultrasonic indices were compared, with nested logistic regression, reclassification analysis and 500-sample bootstrap internal validation performed to assess incremental value and model stability.ResultsGestational age (GA) at diagnosis and the intra-abdominal umbilical vein diameter to abdominal circumference ratio (UV/AC) of the smaller twin in the PND group were significantly lower than those in the non-PND group (P < 0.05), whereas intertwin UV/AC discordance was significantly higher (P0.05). Multivariate logistic regression identified two factors independently associated with PND in type 1 sFGR smaller twin: earlier GA at diagnosis (P = 0.013) and elevated intertwin UV/AC discordance (P = 0.006). The optimal cut-off of intertwin UV/AC discordance was 0.273% (AUC = 0.814, sensitivity 89.5%, specificity 53.3%). Reclassification analyses confirmed the incremental prognostic value of intertwin UV/AC discordance beyond conventional Doppler and clinical variables. The cutoff for GA at diagnosis yielded an AUC < 0.5, indicating reversed predictive performance.ConclusionGA at diagnosis and intertwin UV/AC discordance are independently associated with PND in type 1 sFGR smaller twin. Earlier type 1 sFGR diagnosis and higher intertwin UV/AC discordance are correlated with an increased PND risk. Intertwin UV/AC discordance may serve as a promising ultrasonic marker for antenatal risk stratification in type 1 sFGR.

items.title: Redefining mechanical ventilation in thoracic anesthesia: flow–controlled ventilation from bench to bedside—a narrative review
items.abstract: One–lung ventilation (OLV) remains a cornerstone of thoracic anesthesia but continues to challenge perioperative respiratory management. Restriction of ventilation to a reduced functional lung volume promotes ventilation–perfusion mismatch, alveolar instability, and exposure of the dependent lung to increased mechanical stress. Although contemporary lung–protective ventilation strategies have evolved considerably, postoperative pulmonary complications remain common, highlighting the need for innovative approaches to respiratory support. Flow–controlled ventilation (FCV) introduces a distinct physiological concept by actively controlling both inspiration and expiration through constant gas flow. Unlike conventional ventilation modes, which rely on passive exhalation, FCV enables linear pressure changes throughout the respiratory cycle and combines active expiratory control with direct intratracheal pressure monitoring and compliance–guided ventilator titration. This approach aims to improve ventilation efficiency while reducing mechanisms implicated in ventilator–induced lung injury. In this narrative review, we examine the physiological principles underlying FCV, discuss the technological innovations enabling its clinical application, and summarize current evidence from bench, preclinical, and clinical investigations. Experimental studies demonstrate improvements in respiratory mechanics, lung aeration, oxygenation, and mechanical power compared with conventional ventilation. Limited clinical data during OLV suggest potential improvements in oxygenation and carbon dioxide elimination at lower minute ventilation requirements; however, these findings are derived from small studies primarily evaluating physiological endpoints. Despite encouraging physiological results, important evidence gaps remain. Current clinical studies are limited by small sample sizes and focus predominantly on surrogate physiological outcomes. It remains unknown whether the observed improvements will translate into reductions in postoperative pulmonary complications or other patient–centered outcomes. By shifting attention from inspiration alone to the entire respiratory cycle, FCV challenges conventional paradigms of perioperative ventilation. Future multicenter outcome–driven trials will determine whether active expiratory control represents a meaningful advance in thoracic anesthesia or primarily a physiological innovation with limited clinical impact.

items.title: Editorial: New concepts, advances, and future trends in clinical research on eye diseases
Regression of severe sclerotic chronic graft-versus-host disease after a second haploidentical hematopoietic stem cell transplantation: a case report
items.abstract: Sclerotic chronic graft-versus-host disease (Scl-cGVHD) is a disabling fibrotic manifestation of cGVHD and frequently exhibits poor responsiveness to conventional immunosuppressive therapy. Therapeutic options remained limited, particularly in pediatric patients. An 8-year-old boy with relapsed acute myeloid leukemia underwent matched sibling donor allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (allo-HSCT) in January 2021. Four months later, he developed progressive cutaneous cGVHD that evolved into severe Scl-cGVHD, with diffuse skin thickening, painful fissures, ulceration, and multiple joint contractures, loss of independent ambulation, and complete dependence in activities of daily living. Skin biopsy demonstrated extensive dermal fibrosis, collagen deposition, and increased α-smooth muscle actin (α-SMA) expression. Despite multiple lines of immunosuppressive and targeted therapy, including corticosteroids, calcineurin inhibitors, mycophenolate mofetil, ruxolitinib, rituximab, and other agents, the disease progressed, with the modified Rodnan skin score (mRSS) reaching 35. Because of refractory disease and disabling disease, a second haploidentical HSCT from his father was performed in September 2022. Following transplantation, disease progression ceased and gradual clinical improvement occurred. At 12 months, the mRSS decreased from 35 to 2, with substantial recovery of skin flexibility and joint mobility. Repeat skin biopsy showed reduced collagen compactness and markedly decreased interstitial α-SMA expression, consistent with attenuation and remodeling of dermal fibrosis. Serial immune monitoring revealed progressive recovery of B- and NK-cell compartments and sustained T-cell reconstitution after the second transplantation, in contrast to prolonged B-cell depletion and limited NK-cell recovery after the first transplant. At 24 months, complete donor chimerism persisted, leukemia remained in remission, the mRSS reached 0, and the patient regained independent walking and activities of daily living. This case describes sustained clinical regression and histopathological attenuation of severe, established Scl-cGVHD following a second haploidentical HSCT. The temporal association with immune reconstitution raises the possibility that restoration of immune homeostasis may have contributed to disease remodeling. However, causality cannot be established from a single case. Given the substantial risks associated with second allo-HSCT, this approach should not be considered standard therapy and may be considered only in exceptional, highly selected patients after multidisciplinary risk-benefit assessment.

items.title: Clinical features and management of medication-induced persistent corneal epithelial defects due to topical ophthalmic medications
items.abstract: ObjectiveTo investigate the impact of subacute preservative-containing eye drop usage on the ocular surface and to observe the clinical progression and management of medication-induced persistent corneal epithelial defects (MI-PCED).MethodsThis retrospective study evaluated 60 cases (60 eyes) diagnosed with MI-PCED from January 2020 to January 2024. Data on the type, frequency, and duration of topical medication usage were collected. A multidisciplinary pharmacovigilance assessment evaluated causality, severity, and preventability of the adverse events. Upon diagnosis, the offending medications were discontinued and replaced with low-toxicity, preservative-free alternatives. For advanced epithelial decompensation with stromal involvement (Grades III and IV), bandage contact lenses (BCL) and amniotic membrane transplantation (AMT) were integrated into an exploratory step-wise management approach to promote epithelial wound healing. Treatment efficacy was evaluated using slit-lamp examination and in vivo confocal microscopy (IVCM).ResultsThe clinical manifestation of MI-PCED initiated with epithelial roughness and dry eye symptoms, ultimately progressing to persistent epithelial defects and corneal ulcers. The severity of epithelial decompensation correlated significantly with the number of concurrent medications (P < 0.05), administration frequency (P < 0.001), and medication duration (P < 0.05). Pharmacovigilance evaluation classified 80.0% of cases as “Probable” adverse drug reactions, with 58.3% graded as moderate (Grade 2) and 41.7% as severe (Grade 3). Following 7–30 days of targeted regenerative therapy, the cure rates were 88.57% for Grade I, 90.91% for Grade II, 77.78% for Grade III, and 80.00% for Grade IV. The overall cure rate was 86.67%.ConclusionsThe severity of MI-PCED is heavily dependent on the type, subacute duration, and frequency of topical ophthalmic drug use. Management requires a flexible, step-wise strategy focused on restoring ocular surface homeostasis. This includes withdrawing toxic agents, preserving tear film stability with preservative-free tears, and strategically utilizing BCL and AMT to provide mechanical protection and biological support for severe epithelial decompensation.

items.title: Delayed diagnosis of selected thoracic and mediastinal conditions in young adults: a focused narrative review of clinical pitfalls, cognitive biases, and system barriers
items.abstract: BackgroundThoracic and mediastinal conditions affecting the esophagus, diaphragm, mediastinum, and airway carry considerable morbidity when diagnosis is delayed. Young adults are often perceived as low risk for serious thoracic disease, and low clinical suspicion, atypical symptoms, and cognitive and healthcare-system barriers can delay recognition.MethodsThis focused narrative review searched PubMed and Scopus, supplemented by Google Scholar, for studies published between January 2000 and May 2026, with selected earlier landmark studies retained where essential. Search terms included “thoracic surgical conditions,” “young adults,” “late diagnosis,” “misdiagnosis,” and “unusual presentation.” Five conditions were selected purposively to illustrate contrasting mechanisms and time-courses of diagnostic delay rather than to catalogue thoracic disease exhaustively. No formal systematic search protocol, study-level quality appraisal, or narrative-review quality instrument was applied.ResultsFive diagnostic categories are examined: esophageal perforation and Boerhaave syndrome, traumatic diaphragmatic injury, primary mediastinal germ cell tumors, airway tumors misdiagnosed as asthma, and Hodgkin lymphoma presenting as an anterior mediastinal mass. Hodgkin lymphoma is included as a mediastinal diagnostic pitfall because it resembles other anterior mediastinal tumors and requires histological sampling for definitive diagnosis. Together, these conditions illustrate how overlapping cognitive and systemic barriers contribute to diagnostic delay. The strength and age relevance of the supporting evidence differ markedly between conditions and are stated explicitly, as much of the foundational literature derives from broader adult populations rather than cohorts restricted to ages 18–40.ConclusionsDiagnostic delay reflects the combined effects of non-specific presentation, anchoring, premature closure, limited access to imaging, and delayed specialist referral. Consequences differ by condition: in acute mechanical and perforation emergencies, delays measured in hours may affect contamination, deterioration, and operative complexity, whereas in indolent mediastinal malignancies delay principally affects diagnostic complexity, symptom and psychological burden, and time to staging and treatment, while prognosis remains strongly influenced by histological subtype and tumor biology. Structured reassessment after an unexpected treatment response, timely cross-sectional imaging, disease-specific testing, and early specialist referral are practical measures available to first-contact clinicians.

items.title: Coordinate attention and deformable convolution-enhanced YOLO for bilateral maxillary sinus segmentation, a paranasal sinus structure, in CT images
items.abstract: Accurate delineation of the maxillary sinuses in CT images is a relevant step supporting preoperative planning and the evaluation of sinonasal disease within otolaryngology. Manual contouring of these paranasal sinus structures is difficult and error-prone, since the surrounding anatomy is complex, bony structures are thin, and inter-patient variability is large. This paper proposes an instance segmentation framework that extends the YOLO11n-Seg architecture through the integration of Coordinate Attention (CoordAtt) modules and Deformable Convolutional Networks v2 (DCNv2), to improve spatial feature representation and boundary precision for the right and left maxillary sinuses in CT images. CoordAtt encodes directional spatial context along horizontal and vertical axes to enhance anatomical localisation, while DCNv2 replaces selected fixed-kernel convolution layers with adaptive deformable sampling to better capture irregular and thin-walled sinus boundaries. The proposed model was trained and evaluated on the publicly available NasalSeg dataset, using all axial CT slices containing either maxillary sinus from 130 patients (3,620 slices; 104/13/13 patients across training/validation/test), and compared against three YOLO-family baselines (YOLOv8n-Seg, YOLO11n-Seg, and YOLO26n-Seg). On the 382-slice test set (13 patients), the proposed model achieved a mask mAP50 of 93.07% and mask mAP50-95 of 74.49%, outperforming the three baselines by up to +4.60 and +3.30 percentage points, respectively, and a box mAP50 of 91.00% and mAP50-95 of 75.83%. A component-wise ablation study confirmed that this improvement arises from the joint use of CoordAtt and DCNv2 rather than from either mechanism alone, and patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals and paired significance testing confirmed the statistical robustness of the observed gains. These results represent proof-of-concept evidence that coordinate-aware attention and deformable convolution can be effectively integrated into a YOLO-based instance segmentation pipeline for bilateral maxillary sinus delineation from CT.

items.title: Development and internal validation of a machine-learning model for 3-year mortality after lung cancer resection: an online risk calculator and nomogram
items.abstract: BackgroundLung cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality, and postoperative risk stratification may support individualized surveillance after pulmonary resection. This study aimed to develop and internally validate an exploratory prediction model for 3-year postoperative mortality using routinely available clinical, pathological, and laboratory variables, while explicitly addressing outcome ascertainment, model calibration, and the limitations of a single-center retrospective cohort.MethodsLASSO regression was used for feature selection, followed by a comparison of seven algorithms: Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, Artificial Neural Network, XGBoost, and LightGBM. Model discrimination, calibration, and decision-curve performance were evaluated in a 7:3 internal hold-out split. The final model was selected primarily according to an internal-validation AUC, with calibration and classification metrics considered jointly. A web-based calculator and a nomogram were developed from the final model.ResultsIn the final outcome-ascertained analytic sample, 166 of 350 patients (47.43%) were classified as having died within 36 months and 184 (52.57%) were alive beyond 36 months. This proportion describes the event composition of the selected analytic cohort and should not be interpreted as a population-level postoperative mortality estimate. Six predictors were retained by LASSO: T stage, airway dissemination, pleural invasion, Ki-67 index, BMI, and direct bilirubin. Random Forest showed perfect apparent discrimination in the training set (AUC = 1.00) but decreased to 0.73 in validation. Logistic regression achieved the highest validation AUC (0.79; 95% CI, 0.70–0.87), with an accuracy of 0.75, an F1 score of 0.73, and a Brier score of 0.187, and was therefore selected as the final model.ConclusionThe final logistic regression model provided moderate internal discrimination and an interpretable framework for exploratory 3-year mortality risk estimation after lung cancer resection. The nomogram and web-based calculator facilitated model visualization, but the outcome-ascertained analytic cohort, potential event enrichment, and absence of external validation limited the interpretation of absolute risk and direct clinical application. Therefore, an independent multicenter and prospective validation with appropriate recalibration is required.

items.title: Correction: Comparative effectiveness and dose–response relationship of exercise-based interventions for muscle mass in older women with sarcopenia: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
Different hippocampal subfield volumes predict source memory performance and general cognitive ability in an adult lifespan sample
items.abstract: Modest positive associations between episodic memory performance and whole hippocampal and hippocampal subfield volumes have been reported in numerous prior studies. A smaller number of studies have reported associations between hippocampal volume and performance on tests of non-mnemonic cognition. The present study examined whether these associations were evident in a lifespan sample of cognitively healthy adults. Of particular interest was whether any identified associations were sensitive to age, and whether associations between subfield volumes and mnemonic and non-mnemonic performance were subfield dependent. We acquired high-resolution T1- and T2-weighted structural images from 163 adults (18-87 years of age). Participants also undertook a comprehensive neuropsychological test battery and an in-scanner test of source memory. Principal components analysis was employed to reduce the neuropsychological test scores to 5 cognitive components. Two components reflected memory performance while the other three reflected different aspects of non-mnemonic cognition. Hippocampal subfields (Cornu Ammonis (CA)1, CA2-3, dentate gyrus (DG) and subiculum) were segmented and measured with the Automated Segmentation of Hippocampus Subfields (ASHS) package. Source memory performance was selectively associated across participants with CA2-3 volume. By contrast, both mnemonic and non-mnemonic component scores derived from the test battery were associated exclusively with the volume of the DG. All associations were age-invariant. The findings indicate that different cognitive domains can be dissociated by virtue of their associations with different hippocampal subfields. Of importance, these associations appear to be life-long and hence are unlikely to reflect individual differences in age-related decline in structural integrity.
items.authors: Anandan, A.; de Chastelaine, M.; Kidwai, A.; Hou, M.; McIntyre, C.; Rugg, M. D.
items.title_zh: 海马亚区体积预测成年人的源记忆表现与认知能力
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了海马及其亚区体积与认知健康成年人源记忆表现和一般认知能力之间的关系。研究对象为163名年龄在18至87岁之间的成年人，采用高分辨率T1和T2加权结构成像，并进行全面的神经心理测试和源记忆扫描测试。通过主成分分析将神经心理测试得分归纳为5个认知成分，其中两个成分反映记忆表现，三个成分反映非记忆认知的不同方面。结果显示，CA2-3亚区体积与源记忆表现显著相关，而记忆和非记忆表现的关联则与亚区体积有关。研究表明，海马亚区体积可能在认知能力中发挥重要作用。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现海马CA2-3亚区体积与成年人的源记忆表现显著相关，提示其在认知能力中可能发挥重要作用。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨海马（hippocampus）及其亚区体积与认知健康成年人源记忆表现和一般认知能力之间的关系。研究对象为163名年龄在18至87岁之间的成年人，采用高分辨率T1和T2加权结构成像技术，并进行了全面的神经心理测试和源记忆扫描测试。通过主成分分析，研究将神经心理测试得分归纳为五个认知成分，其中两个成分反映了记忆表现，三个成分则涉及非记忆认知的不同方面。

研究结果显示，海马CA2-3亚区体积与源记忆表现之间存在显著相关性。这一发现表明，海马亚区的体积可能在源记忆的形成和提取过程中发挥重要作用。此外，记忆表现和非记忆表现的关联性也与海马亚区的体积有关，进一步支持了海马在认知能力中的关键角色。总体而言，本研究强调了海马亚区体积对认知健康成年人源记忆表现的重要性，提示未来的研究可以进一步探讨海马结构与认知功能之间的复杂关系。

items.title: Cell type specific astrocytic feedback regulates excitation inhibition balance and cortical network dynamics
items.abstract: Astrocytes actively regulate synaptic transmission and neuronal excitability, yet their role in orchestrating macroscopic cortical network regimes and slow-wave oscillations remains an active area of reasearch. This study investigates how bidirectional neuron astrocyte interactions shape emergent population dynamics using a computational network model of excitatory and inhibitory neurons coupled to an astrocyte. The results identify astrocytic feedback topology, rather than astrocytic coupling strength alone, as a key determinant of emergent cortical network dynamics. By systematically dissecting pathway-specific connectivity, it has been shown that the neuronal population driving astrocytic activation and the neuronal population receiving gliotransmission jointly determine whether the network occupies asynchronous irregular (AI), synchronous irregular (SI), synchronous regular(SR), asynchronous regular(AR) or quiescent regimes.Directing gliotransmission selectively onto excitatory neurons consistently promotes population synchrony regardless of the population influencing astrocytic dynamics, whereas selective modulation of inhibitory interneurons induces network quiescence via strong suppression. Under dual-target gliotransmission, network synchrony is dictated by the population driving astrocytic dynamics: excitatory-only drive promotes synchrony, while combined or inhibitory-specific drive preserves asynchronous states. Furthermore, the model reveals that astrocytic signaling kinetics provide an additional temporal control mechanism that regulates the frequency and persistence of self sustained up states.
items.authors: Garcia, D. W.; Jacquir, S.
items.title_zh: 特定细胞类型的星形胶质细胞反馈调节兴奋抑制平衡及皮层网络动态
items.summary_zh: 星形胶质细胞积极调节突触传递和神经元兴奋性，但它们在协调宏观皮层网络状态和慢波振荡中的作用仍是研究热点。本研究利用计算网络模型探讨双向神经元与星形胶质细胞的相互作用如何塑造新兴的群体动态。结果表明，星形胶质细胞反馈拓扑结构是新兴皮层网络动态的关键决定因素，而不仅仅是星形胶质细胞的耦合强度。通过系统分析特定通路的连接性，发现驱动星形胶质细胞激活的神经元群体与接收胶质传递的神经元群体共同决定网络是否处于非同步不规则（AI）、同步不规则（SI）、同步规则（SR）、非同步规则（AR）或静息状态。选择性地将胶质传递作用于兴奋性神经元始终促进群体同步，而选择性调节抑制性中间神经元则通过强抑制诱导网络静息。在双靶向胶质传递下，网络同步性由驱动星形胶质细胞动态的群体决定：仅兴奋性驱动促进同步，而组合或抑制性驱动则抑制同步。
items.l1_lead: 星形胶质细胞通过反馈拓扑结构调节皮层网络动态，影响兴奋抑制平衡，决定网络的同步性和状态。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了星形胶质细胞（astrocytes）在调节皮层网络动态及兴奋抑制平衡中的作用，特别是它们如何通过双向相互作用影响神经元群体的动态状态。研究利用计算网络模型分析了星形胶质细胞与神经元之间的相互作用，发现星形胶质细胞的反馈拓扑结构是决定新兴皮层网络动态的关键因素，而不仅仅是其耦合强度。通过对特定通路连接性的系统分析，研究揭示了驱动星形胶质细胞激活的神经元群体与接收胶质传递的神经元群体共同决定了网络的状态，包括非同步不规则（AI）、同步不规则（SI）、同步规则（SR）、非同步规则（AR）和静息状态。

研究结果表明，选择性地将胶质传递作用于兴奋性神经元能够始终促进群体的同步，而当调节抑制性中间神经元时，则会通过强抑制作用诱导网络进入静息状态。在双靶向胶质传递的情况下，网络的同步性由驱动星形胶质细胞动态的群体决定：仅有兴奋性驱动的情况下，网络同步性得到促进，而当组合或抑制性驱动存在时，网络同步性则受到抑制。这些发现强调了星形胶质细胞在皮层网络动态中的重要性，尤其是在调节兴奋性和抑制性神经元之间的平衡方面，进一步推动了我们对神经网络功能的理解。

items.title: A single-nucleus multi-omic atlas of gene regulation across 21 adult human tissues
items.abstract: Diverse human cell types establish specialized functions through lineage- and context-specific regulatory programs. Interpreting non-coding genetic risk requires integrated multi-omic reference maps that directly connect regulatory DNA to cellular expression across human tissues. Here we present a single-nucleus multi-omic atlas comprising 459,856 transcriptomic and chromatin accessibility profiles from 21 adult human tissues and four donors, including paired measurements from 160,688 nuclei. The atlas resolves nine cell lineages, 61 broad cell types and 313 subclusters, and identifies 1,085,062 candidate cis-regulatory elements (cCREs), including 161,270 novel elements absent from ENCODE. Regulatory activity was dominated by cell identity but refined by tissue context. Joint profiling enabled 871,177 cCRE-gene associations and revealed lineage-specific regulatory architectures. Cross-tissue accessibility further identified lineage-restricted and constitutively inaccessible chromatin domains, the latter showing preferential hypomethylation across human cancers. Furthermore, we leverage this dataset to train sequence-to-function models to predict chromatin-accessibility effects for 548,656 fine-mapped variants, identifying 18,133 high-effect variants, including 1,120 broadly active variants. Models trained for eight endothelial subtypes further resolve predicted variant effects across vascular beds. Together, this atlas provides a comprehensive cellular and computational framework for interpreting regulatory sequence, context-dependent gene control, and complex trait genetics across the human body.
items.authors: Fan, K.; Sule, A.; Guillaumet-Adkins, A.; Zhang, R.; Yu, T.; Cao, Z.; Zhang, X.; Durand, N.; Tellier, M.; Domenech, L.; Aguet, F.; Buenrostro, J. D.; Ardlie, K. G.
items.title_zh: 21种成人人体组织基因调控的单细胞多组学图谱
items.summary_zh: 不同的人类细胞类型通过谱系和环境特异性的调控程序建立专门功能。为了解释非编码遗传风险，需要整合的多组学参考图谱，直接连接调控DNA与人类组织中的细胞表达。本研究呈现了一个单细胞多组学图谱，包含来自21种成人组织和四位供体的459,856个转录组和染色质可及性谱，涵盖160,688个细胞核的配对测量。该图谱解析了九个细胞谱系、61种广泛细胞类型和313个亚簇，并识别了1,085,062个候选顺式调控元件（cCREs），其中161,270个为ENCODE中缺失的新元件。调控活性主要受细胞身份主导，但受到组织环境的细化。联合分析揭示了871,177个cCRE-基因关联，并显示谱系特异的调控结构。跨组织可及性进一步识别了谱系限制和持续不可及的染色质区域，后者在多种人类癌症中表现出优先的低甲基化。此外，我们利用该数据集训练序列-功能模型，预测548,656个精细映射变体的染色质可及性效应，识别出18,133个高效应变体，包括1,120个广泛活跃变体。针对八种内皮亚型训练的模型进一步解析了预测的变体效应。
items.l1_lead: 本研究构建了一个涵盖21种成人组织的单细胞多组学图谱，揭示了细胞类型与环境对基因调控的影响，并识别了大量新的调控元件和变体效应。
items.l2_summary:
本研究构建了一个涵盖21种成人组织的单细胞多组学图谱，旨在揭示不同人类细胞类型如何通过谱系和环境特异性的调控程序实现专门功能。该图谱整合了来自四位供体的459,856个转录组和染色质可及性谱，涵盖了160,688个细胞核的配对测量，提供了对细胞调控机制的深入理解。研究解析了九个细胞谱系、61种广泛细胞类型和313个亚簇，并识别了1,085,062个候选顺式调控元件（cCREs），其中161,270个为ENCODE数据库中缺失的新元件。这些调控活性主要受细胞身份的主导影响，但也受到组织环境的细化。

通过联合分析，研究揭示了871,177个cCRE与基因的关联，并显示出谱系特异的调控结构。此外，跨组织可及性分析进一步识别了谱系限制和持续不可及的染色质区域，这些区域在多种人类癌症中表现出优先的低甲基化特征。研究还利用该数据集训练了序列-功能模型，预测了548,656个精细映射变体的染色质可及性效应，识别出18,133个高效应变体，其中包括1,120个广泛活跃变体。针对八种内皮亚型训练的模型进一步解析了预测的变体效应，为理解基因调控与疾病风险之间的联系提供了重要的参考。

综上所述，该研究不仅为非编码遗传风险的解释提供了整合的多组学参考图谱，还为未来的基因调控研究和疾病机制探索奠定了基础。通过对细胞类型和组织环境的深入分析，研究揭示了复杂的调控网络，为理解人类生物学和疾病提供了新的视角。

items.title: TFAM Dependent Mitochondrial Fitness Limits CD8⁺ T Cell Immunopathology and Sustains Protective Immunity during Viral Pneumonia
items.abstract: During respiratory virus infection, CD8 T cells kill infected cells and establish antigen-specific memory, but mechanisms regulating these functions remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify mitochondrial transcription factor A (TFAM)-dependent mitochondrial fitness as a regulator of CD8 T cell function during influenza infection. Human CD8 T cells exhibited an age-associated decline in TFAM expression and mitochondrial function. To model this physiologically relevant decline and determine its consequences for antiviral immunity, we generated CD8 T cell-specific TFAM-haploinsufficient mice. TFAM insufficiency disrupted mitochondrial integrity and bioenergetics and increased mitochondrial DNA and oxidative stress. During influenza infection, TFAM-insufficient CD8 T cells exhibited increased cytotoxic and inflammatory activity associated with lung immunopathology without improved viral control. This early phenotype was followed by loss of effector function, diminished antigen-specific responses, reduced protection following adoptive transfer, and impaired heterosubtypic recall immunity. Thus, TFAM-dependent mitochondrial fitness is a cell-intrinsic regulator that limits immunopathology while sustaining recall immunity.
items.authors: Navaeiseddighi, Z.; Guo, K.; Hasan, S. S.; Wang, Z.; Mishra, R.; Schmit, T.; Ahsan, J.; Moser, E. J.; Hur, J.; Yount, J. S.; Mathur, R.; Zhou, L.; Khan, N.
items.title_zh: TFAM依赖的线粒体适应性限制CD8⁺ T细胞免疫病理
items.summary_zh: 在呼吸道病毒感染过程中，CD8 T细胞通过杀死感染细胞和建立抗原特异性记忆来发挥作用，但调控这些功能的机制尚不完全清楚。本研究发现线粒体转录因子A（TFAM）依赖的线粒体适应性是流感感染期间CD8 T细胞功能的调节因子。人类CD8 T细胞的TFAM表达和线粒体功能随着年龄的增长而下降。为模拟这种生理相关的下降并确定其对抗病毒免疫的影响，我们生成了CD8 T细胞特异性TFAM半缺失小鼠。TFAM不足导致线粒体完整性和生物能量学受损，增加线粒体DNA和氧化应激。在流感感染期间，TFAM不足的CD8 T细胞表现出增加的细胞毒性和炎症活性，伴随肺部免疫病理，但未改善病毒控制。此早期表型随后表现为效应功能丧失、抗原特异性反应减弱、转移后保护降低以及异亚型记忆免疫受损。因此，TFAM依赖的线粒体适应性是限制免疫病理并维持记忆免疫的细胞内在调节因子。
items.l1_lead: 线粒体转录因子A（TFAM）依赖的线粒体适应性在流感感染中调节CD8 T细胞功能，限制免疫病理并维持记忆免疫。
items.l2_summary:
在呼吸道病毒感染过程中，CD8⁺ T细胞通过杀死感染细胞和建立抗原特异性记忆来发挥重要作用，但其功能调控机制尚不明确。本研究揭示了线粒体转录因子A（TFAM）依赖的线粒体适应性在流感感染期间对CD8⁺ T细胞功能的调节作用。研究发现，随着年龄的增长，人类CD8⁺ T细胞中的TFAM表达和线粒体功能逐渐下降。为模拟这一生理相关的变化并探讨其对抗病毒免疫的影响，研究团队生成了CD8⁺ T细胞特异性TFAM半缺失小鼠。

结果显示，TFAM不足导致小鼠的线粒体完整性和生物能量学受到损害，同时增加了线粒体DNA和氧化应激。在流感感染期间，TFAM不足的CD8⁺ T细胞表现出增强的细胞毒性和炎症活性，伴随肺部免疫病理的加重，但并未改善对病毒的控制。这种早期表型随后导致了效应功能的丧失、抗原特异性反应的减弱、转移后保护的降低以及异亚型记忆免疫的受损。

因此，研究结果表明，TFAM依赖的线粒体适应性在限制免疫病理和维持记忆免疫方面起着关键的细胞内在调节作用。这一发现为理解CD8⁺ T细胞在病毒感染中的功能提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的免疫治疗策略提供理论基础。

items.title: Gasdermin E couples mitochondrial stress to STING-driven neuronal pyroptosis during Chandipura virus encephalitis
items.abstract: Neurotropic RNA viruses are major causes of fatal encephalitis worldwide, yet how infected neurons transition from antiviral defense to inflammatory cell death is not well characterized. Chandipura virus (CHPV), an emerging neurotropic rhabdovirus, causes acute, rapidly progressive encephalitis with high case fatality in children, but the mechanisms underlying its neuropathogenesis remain poorly defined. Here, we demonstrate that CHPV suppresses canonical RNA virus sensing early but subsequently switches to a mitochondria-driven innate immune program that culminates in inflammatory cell death. Early infection of neuronal cells with CHPV was marked by reduced levels of the mitochondrial antiviral adaptor protein, MAVS and attenuation of type I and III interferon responses. As infection progressed, mitochondrial dysfunction promoted accumulation of mtROS, mitochondrial accumulation of cleaved GSDME and cytosolic mtDNA release, triggering STING activation, which coincided with robust neuroinflammation and pyroptotic cell death. Pharmacological inhibition or genetic silencing of STING markedly attenuated inflammatory signaling, prevented pyroptotic membrane rupture and protected neurons from cell death without significantly affecting viral replication. In contrast, GSDME depletion reduced both viral replication and neuronal death. Notably, GSDME depletion markedly attenuated STING phosphorylation, while STING depletion also reduced GSDME activation, revealing functional coupling between these pathways during CHPV-induced neuronal injury. Collectively, our findings identify a mitochondria-GSDME-STING axis linking early immune evasion to neuroinflammation during CHPV infection, revealing a previously unrecognized mechanism of inflammatory neuronal death in viral encephalitis and highlighting STING as a potential therapeutic target in certain CNS viral infections.
items.authors: Mukherjee, P.; Kumari, N.; Dutta, S.; Priyadarsini, A.; Biswas, J.; Roy, S.; Samanta, S.; Chakraborty, S.; Roy, J.; Basu, A.; Mukhopadhyay, D.; Saha, A.
items.title_zh: 气体免疫素E连接线粒体应激与STING驱动的神经元焦亡
items.summary_zh: 神经嗜性RNA病毒是全球致命脑炎的主要原因，但感染神经元如何从抗病毒防御转变为炎症性细胞死亡尚不明确。Chandipura病毒（CHPV）是一种新兴的神经嗜性狂犬病毒，导致儿童急性、快速进展的脑炎，且病死率高。研究表明，CHPV早期抑制经典RNA病毒感知，随后转向线粒体驱动的先天免疫程序，最终导致炎症性细胞死亡。CHPV感染早期，神经元细胞中线粒体抗病毒适配蛋白MAVS水平降低，I型和III型干扰素反应减弱。随着感染进展，线粒体功能障碍促进mtROS积累、切割的GSDME在线粒体的积累及细胞质mtDNA释放，激活STING，伴随强烈的神经炎症和焦亡。药物抑制或基因沉默STING显著减弱炎症信号，防止焦亡膜破裂，保护神经元不死亡，而不显著影响病毒复制。相反，GSDME缺失减少了病毒复制和神经元死亡。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，Chandipura病毒感染通过抑制抗病毒反应并激活线粒体驱动的STING通路，导致神经元炎症性细胞死亡，抑制STING可保护神经元。
items.l2_summary:
神经嗜性RNA病毒是导致全球致命脑炎的重要原因，但感染神经元如何从抗病毒防御转变为炎症性细胞死亡的机制尚不清楚。Chandipura病毒（CHPV）作为一种新兴的神经嗜性狂犬病毒，能够引发儿童急性且快速进展的脑炎，且其病死率较高。研究发现，CHPV在感染早期抑制经典RNA病毒的感知机制，随后转向依赖线粒体驱动的先天免疫程序，最终导致炎症性细胞死亡。

具体而言，CHPV感染早期，神经元细胞中的线粒体抗病毒适配蛋白MAVS水平显著降低，导致I型和III型干扰素反应减弱。随着感染的进展，线粒体功能障碍促使线粒体活性氧（mtROS）积累，同时切割的GSDME（Gasdermin E）在细胞内线粒体的积累以及细胞质中mtDNA的释放，进一步激活了STING（刺激干扰素基因）。这一过程伴随着强烈的神经炎症反应和焦亡现象的发生。

研究表明，通过药物抑制或基因沉默STING可以显著减弱炎症信号，防止细胞膜破裂，从而保护神经元不发生死亡，而这一过程对病毒复制的影响并不显著。相反，缺失GSDME则导致病毒复制减少，同时也降低了神经元的死亡率。这些结果表明，CHPV感染通过调控线粒体应激和STING信号通路，促进了神经元的焦亡，为理解神经病毒感染后的细胞死亡机制提供了新的视角。

items.title: Temporal control of mitochondrial mutagenesis reveals the fate of mtDNA mutations with age
items.abstract: Mutations in the mitochondrial genome (mtDNA) play a critical role in the aging process and a wide variety of age-related diseases. However, it remains unclear when the mutations that drive physiological decline arise. To answer this question, we generated a new mouse model in which mitochondrial mutagenesis can be confined to a defined window of time. Surprisingly, we found that mutations that arise during the first two months of life are sufficient to drive a wide variety of age-related pathologies, and that the severity of this pathology is broadly regulated by distinct, tissue-specific selective pressures that control the fate of mtDNA mutations with age. Further, we found that selection against deleterious variants can be modulated by manipulation of mitochondrial fusion in vitro and in vivo. These observations raise the possibility that in some tissues, the pace of aging is pre-determined by events that occur early in life and that interventions targeting mitochondrial fusion may be able to slow down or reverse the expansion of these pathogenic variants. These results carry far-reaching implications for strategies aimed at preventing or delaying age-related decline.
items.authors: Shemtov, S. J.; Hwang, E.; Chung, C. S.; Anson, H.; Carrillo, L.; Lee, S.; Vorobyova, I.; Wan, J.; Kennedy, S. R.; Vandiver, A. R.; Verheijen, B. M.; Cohn, W.; Benayoun, B. A.; Thorwald, M. A.; Cohen, P.; Wanagat, J.; Gout, J.-F.; Vermulst, M.
items.title_zh: 线粒体突变的时间控制揭示mtDNA突变随年龄的命运
items.summary_zh: 线粒体基因组（mtDNA）中的突变在衰老过程和多种与年龄相关的疾病中起着关键作用。然而，导致生理衰退的突变何时出现仍不清楚。为了解答这一问题，我们建立了一种新的小鼠模型，使线粒体突变可以限制在特定时间窗口内。令人惊讶的是，我们发现生命头两个月出现的突变足以驱动多种与年龄相关的病理，并且这种病理的严重性受到特定组织选择压力的广泛调控，影响mtDNA突变的命运。此外，我们发现通过在体内外操控线粒体融合，可以调节对有害变异的选择。这些观察结果提出，在某些组织中，衰老的速度可能由生命早期发生的事件预先决定，针对线粒体融合的干预可能能够减缓或逆转这些致病变异的扩展。这些结果对预防或延缓与年龄相关的衰退策略具有深远的影响。
items.l1_lead: 线粒体突变在生命早期的出现对衰老及相关疾病有重要影响，调控线粒体融合可减缓这些突变的扩展。
items.l2_summary: 线粒体基因组（mtDNA）中的突变在衰老及多种与年龄相关的疾病中扮演着重要角色，但这些突变何时出现对生理衰退的影响尚不明确。为了解决这一问题，研究团队建立了一种新的小鼠模型，使得线粒体突变能够在特定的时间窗口内发生。研究结果令人惊讶，发现生命的头两个月内出现的突变足以引发多种与年龄相关的病理变化，并且这些病理的严重程度受到特定组织选择压力的广泛调控，从而影响mtDNA突变的命运。此外，研究还发现，通过在体内外操控线粒体融合，可以调节对有害变异的选择。这一发现表明，在某些组织中，衰老的速度可能由生命早期发生的事件所预先决定。因此，针对线粒体融合的干预措施可能有助于减缓或逆转这些致病变异的扩展。这些研究结果为预防或延缓与年龄相关的衰退提供了新的思路，具有深远的影响。

items.title: OPA1 controls mitochondrial dysfunction-driven liver fibrosis in MASLD
items.abstract: Progressive hepatic fibrosis is the principal determinant of morbidity and mortality in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and steatohepatitis (MASLD/MASH). Mitochondrial dysfunction is a hallmark of MASH, and the release of mitochondrial damage-associated molecular patterns (mito-DAMPs) from injured hepatocytes can promote fibrosis. However, how mitochondrial dynamics and quality control shape the fibrotic response in MASLD/MASH remains unclear. Here, through large-scale genomic analyses of mitochondrial genes governing mitophagy, fusion and fission in human MASLD, with a power-equivalent sample size of approximately 700,000 individuals, we identify a strong association between hepatic fibrosis and the mitochondrial fusion factor dynamin-like GTPase optic atrophy 1 (OPA1). OPA1 transcripts and protein abundance in the liver epithelium were progressively dysregulated with advancing fibrosis. In mice, hepatocyte-specific OPA1 loss alone was sufficient to induce hepatic stellate cell activation and fibrosis in zone 3, promoted the release of mito-DAMPs into the circulation and exacerbated fibrosis in experimental MASH. These findings identify OPA1 as a central regulator of the hepatic fibrotic response and connect defective mitochondrial homeostasis to mito-DAMP release, hepatic stellate cell activation and fibrosis in MASLD.

items.title_zh: OPA1在代谢功能障碍相关肝纤维化中的作用
items.summary_zh: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病和脂肪性肝炎（MASLD/MASH）中的进展性肝纤维化是主要的发病和死亡因素。线粒体功能障碍是MASH的特征，受损肝细胞释放的线粒体损伤相关分子模式（mito-DAMPs）可促进纤维化。通过对约70万名个体的线粒体基因进行大规模基因组分析，我们发现肝纤维化与线粒体融合因子OPA1存在强关联。随着纤维化的进展，肝上皮中OPA1转录本和蛋白质丰度逐渐失调。在小鼠实验中，肝细胞特异性缺失OPA1足以诱导肝星状细胞激活和第3区纤维化，促进mito-DAMPs释放并加重实验性MASH中的纤维化。这些发现表明OPA1是肝纤维化反应的核心调节因子，并将线粒体稳态缺陷与MASLD中的mito-DAMP释放、肝星状细胞激活和纤维化联系起来。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现线粒体融合因子OPA1在代谢功能障碍相关肝纤维化中起核心调节作用，缺失OPA1可加重肝星状细胞激活和纤维化进程。
items.l2_summary:
代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病和脂肪性肝炎（MASLD/MASH）中的进展性肝纤维化是导致发病和死亡的重要因素，而线粒体功能障碍则是MASH的显著特征。研究表明，受损的肝细胞会释放线粒体损伤相关分子模式（mito-DAMPs），从而促进纤维化的进程。通过对约70万名个体的线粒体基因进行大规模基因组分析，研究发现肝纤维化与线粒体融合因子OPA1存在显著关联。随着肝纤维化的进展，肝上皮中OPA1的转录本和蛋白质丰度逐渐失调，这一变化可能在纤维化的发生中起到关键作用。

在小鼠实验中，研究者发现肝细胞特异性缺失OPA1能够诱导肝星状细胞的激活，并导致第3区的纤维化。这一过程还伴随着mito-DAMPs的释放，进一步加重了实验性MASH中的纤维化现象。这些结果表明，OPA1不仅是肝纤维化反应的核心调节因子，还将线粒体稳态缺陷与MASLD中的mito-DAMP释放、肝星状细胞激活及纤维化的发生紧密联系起来。因此，OPA1在代谢功能障碍相关肝纤维化中的作用值得进一步研究，可能为相关疾病的治疗提供新的靶点和思路。

items.title: A hydrogen-producing mitochondrion in an anaerobic eukaryotrophic rhizarian
items.abstract: Diverse eukaryotes thrive under low oxygen conditions, in part through highly modified mitochondrion-related organelles (MROs) that use alternate metabolic pathways to support ATP production and cofactor recycling. Anaerobic lifestyles have evolved repeatedly across the eukaryotic tree of life, each providing an independent opportunity to understand how eukaryotes adapt to life in low oxygen conditions. Here, we use single-cell transcriptomics to reconstruct the MRO metabolism of PCE SSF, a benthic eukaryotrophic flagellate and the first cultivated representative of Novel Clade 12 (NC12; Rhizaria), an independently anaerobic rhizarian lineage. PCE SSF possesses an anaerobic hydrogen-producing mitochondrion capable of hydrogenosome-type substrate-level phosphorylation. It also retains a nearly complete but likely branched tricarboxylic acid pathway that lacks citrate synthase and malate dehydrogenase. The function of citrate synthase may instead be fulfilled by the typically cytosolic ATP citrate lyase, previously reported in this context only in the anaerobic cercozoan, Brevimastigomonas motovehiculus. Unlike B. motovehiculus, however, PCE SSF retains only Complex II and the NuoE/NuoF subunits of the electron transport chain and lacks a mitochondrial genome. Together, these features indicate an atypical and reduced mitochondrial metabolism, highlighting the diversity of evolutionary solutions to anaerobic energy metabolism in eukaryotes.
items.authors: Lawton, M.; Eglit, Y.; Stairs, C. W.; Gawryluk, R. M. R.
items.title_zh: 厌氧真核营养性根足类中的氢产生线粒体
items.summary_zh: 多样的真核生物在低氧环境中繁衍生息，部分原因是高度改造的线粒体相关细胞器（MROs）利用替代代谢途径支持ATP生产和辅因子回收。厌氧生活方式在真核生物的进化树上多次演化，为理解真核生物如何适应低氧环境提供了独立机会。本研究利用单细胞转录组学重建了PCE SSF的MRO代谢，PCE SSF是一种底栖真核营养性鞭毛虫，也是新分类群12（NC12；根足类）的首个培养代表。PCE SSF具有一种厌氧氢产生线粒体，能够进行氢体类型的底物水平磷酸化，并保留几乎完整但可能分支的三羧酸循环途径，缺乏柠檬酸合酶和苹果酸脱氢酶。柠檬酸合酶的功能可能由典型的细胞质ATP柠檬酸裂解酶代替。PCE SSF仅保留电子传递链的复合体II及NuoE/NuoF亚基，且缺乏线粒体基因组。这些特征表明其线粒体代谢不典型且简化，突显了进化的多样性。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了厌氧真核营养性根足类PCE SSF中高度改造的氢产生线粒体的独特代谢特征，展示了真核生物在低氧环境中的适应进化多样性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于厌氧真核营养性根足类（如PCE SSF）的线粒体代谢，探讨其在低氧环境中的适应机制。PCE SSF作为新分类群12（NC12）的首个培养代表，展现出一种高度改造的厌氧氢产生线粒体，能够通过底物水平磷酸化生成ATP，并在代谢过程中保留了几乎完整但可能分支的三羧酸循环途径，尽管缺乏柠檬酸合酶和苹果酸脱氢酶。这一发现表明，PCE SSF的线粒体代谢与典型真核生物显著不同，显示出其适应厌氧环境的独特性。

研究通过单细胞转录组学重建了PCE SSF的MRO（线粒体相关细胞器）代谢，揭示了其电子传递链的组成仅保留了复合体II及NuoE/NuoF亚基，且缺乏线粒体基因组。这些特征进一步强调了PCE SSF的线粒体代谢的简化和不典型性，反映了真核生物在进化过程中对厌氧生活方式的多样性适应。研究结果为理解真核生物如何在低氧环境中生存提供了新的视角，揭示了厌氧代谢的复杂性及其在真核生物进化中的重要性。

items.title: Sex-specific metabolic regulation by the Drosophila RNA-binding protein Nab2
items.abstract: Conserved RNA binding proteins (RBPs) regulate key steps of gene expression including mRNA processing, export, localization, stability and translation. Human ZC3H14 is a conserved RBP that regulates pre-mRNA processing in neurons and loss of ZC3H14 leads to neurological defects. Studies of Nab2, the Drosophila orthologue of ZC3H14, have identified potential target RNAs involved in metabolism, suggesting Nab2 may influence neurometabolic circuitry. Here, we show a female-specific increase in dilp2 and dilp5 mRNA levels. The dilps encode insulin-like peptides that signal from the brain insulin producing cells (IPCs) to peripheral tissues. Nab2null females have enlarged lipid droplets in the fat body, a tissue analogous to human adipose tissue and liver. Notably, neuronal depletion of Nab2 increases lipid droplet size while neuronal expression of Nab2 in Nab2null female rescues this phenotype supporting a role for Nab2 in a neuronal circuit that regulates dilp levels. Furthermore, depletion of dilp2 or dilp5 from IPCs rescues the enlarged lipid droplet phenotype in Nab2null females indicating that elevated dilp2/dilp5 contributes to enlarged lipid droplets. Together, these data support a female-specific role for Nab2 in brain neurons to support insulin signaling and fat storage, expanding the known functions of RBPs linking neuronal function and metabolic homeostasis.
items.authors: Goldy, J. N.; Dunlop, H.; Patel, D. D.; McSweeney, R. M.; Leung, S. W.; Gorkin, D. U.; Corbett, A. H.; Moberg, K.
items.title_zh: 果蝇RNA结合蛋白Nab2的性别特异性代谢调控
items.summary_zh: 保守的RNA结合蛋白（RBPs）调节基因表达的关键步骤，包括mRNA处理、转运、定位、稳定性和翻译。人类ZC3H14是一种保守的RBP，调控神经元中的前mRNA处理，其缺失会导致神经缺陷。研究果蝇中ZC3H14的同源物Nab2发现其可能影响代谢相关的靶RNA。我们发现雌性果蝇的dilp2和dilp5 mRNA水平显著增加，dilps编码从大脑胰岛素产生细胞（IPCs）向外周组织传递信号的类胰岛素肽。Nab2缺失的雌性果蝇脂肪体内脂滴增大，Nab2的神经元缺失会增加脂滴大小，而在Nab2缺失雌性果蝇中表达Nab2可以恢复这一表型，表明Nab2在调节dilp水平的神经回路中发挥作用。此外，从IPCs中去除dilp2或dilp5可以拯救Nab2缺失雌性果蝇的脂滴增大表型，说明dilp2/dilp5的升高与脂滴增大相关。这些数据支持Nab2在雌性果蝇大脑神经元中支持胰岛素信号传导和脂肪储存的特异性作用，扩展了RBPs在神经功能与代谢稳态之间的已知功能。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，果蝇RNA结合蛋白Nab2在雌性果蝇中通过调节dilp2和dilp5的表达，影响胰岛素信号传导和脂肪储存，揭示了其在性别特异性代谢调控中的重要作用。
items.l2_summary:
研究果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）中的RNA结合蛋白（RBP）Nab2的性别特异性代谢调控，揭示了其在调节胰岛素信号传导和脂肪储存中的重要作用。Nab2是人类ZC3H14的同源物，已知ZC3H14在神经元中的前mRNA处理中发挥关键作用，其缺失会导致神经缺陷。通过对果蝇的研究，发现Nab2可能影响与代谢相关的靶RNA，尤其是在雌性果蝇中。

研究结果显示，雌性果蝇的dilp2和dilp5 mRNA水平显著增加，这两个基因编码的类胰岛素肽从大脑胰岛素产生细胞（IPCs）向外周组织传递信号。Nab2缺失的雌性果蝇表现出脂肪体内脂滴增大的现象，而Nab2在神经元中的缺失会进一步加大脂滴的大小。值得注意的是，在Nab2缺失的雌性果蝇中重新表达Nab2能够恢复脂滴的正常大小，表明Nab2在调节dilp水平的神经回路中发挥了重要作用。

进一步的实验表明，从IPCs中去除dilp2或dilp5可以拯救Nab2缺失雌性果蝇的脂滴增大表型，这一结果支持了dilp2和dilp5的升高与脂滴增大之间的直接关联。这些数据表明，Nab2在雌性果蝇的大脑神经元中不仅支持胰岛素信号传导，还在脂肪储存的调节中发挥了性别特异性的作用。这项研究扩展了RNA结合蛋白在神经功能与代谢稳态之间的已知功能，为理解性别差异在代谢调控中的机制提供了新的视角。

items.title: Not all TOP RNAs are created equal: 3'UTR length and TSS selection predict the translational regulation of LARP1-bound mRNAs in CD4+ T cells
items.abstract: Naive T cells are poised for activation and contain a pool of translationally repressed ribosomal protein (RP) mRNA prepared to induce ribosome biogenesis to support protein synthesis, cell growth and proliferation. RP mRNA are the prototypical members of a class of transcripts initiating at cytosine followed by a CU rich element called terminal oligo pyrimidine (TOP) RNAs. TOP RNAs are regulated by an RNA binding protein LARP1, which promotes transcript stabilisation and translational repression. We investigated LARP1 function in T cell activation by generating cross-linking immunoprecipitation (CLIP) datasets detailing the LARP1-RNA interactions in naive and activated CD4+ T cells and identifying novel TOP RNAs. TOP RNAs identified by this analysis were functionally diverse. RP mRNAs were typified by high stability, and translational repression in naive T cells followed by MTORC1-dependent translation increases following T cell activation. However, other TOP RNAs varied in these aspects of their regulation. Notably, TOP RNAs with longer 3'UTRs had a relaxed dependency on LARP1 for stability and a reduced dependency on MTORC1 for their translation. Transcription start site heterogeneity also impacted TOP RNA regulation by generating a mixture of transcript isoforms with different TOP motif lengths. Longer terminal oligo pyrimidine stretches were associated with a greater dependency on MTORC1 for translation. Differential regulation of TOP RNAs may allow tuneable translational responses to MTORC1 and indicates potential roles for LARP1 beyond translation regulation and stability.
items.authors: Galloway, A.; Cowling, V. H.
items.title_zh: 不同TOP RNA的转录调控：3'UTR长度与TSS选择的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于CD4+ T细胞中LARP1结合mRNA的转录调控。我们通过交联免疫沉淀（CLIP）技术生成了详细的LARP1-RNA相互作用数据集，分析了初始和激活状态下的CD4+ T细胞，识别出新的TOP RNA。结果显示，RP mRNA具有高稳定性和转录抑制特性，激活后依赖MTORC1的翻译增加。相比之下，其他TOP RNA在调控方面表现出差异，尤其是较长的3'UTR对LARP1的稳定性依赖性较低，且对MTORC1的翻译依赖性减弱。此外，转录起始位点的异质性导致了不同TOP基序长度的转录异构体混合，较长的终端寡聚嘧啶序列与更高的依赖性相关。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了CD4+ T细胞中LARP1结合的TOP RNA在转录调控中受3'UTR长度和转录起始位点选择的影响，表现出不同的稳定性和翻译依赖性。
items.l2_summary: 本研究聚焦于CD4+ T细胞中LARP1（La ribonucleoprotein 1）结合mRNA的转录调控，采用交联免疫沉淀（CLIP）技术生成了详细的LARP1-RNA相互作用数据集，分析了初始和激活状态下的CD4+ T细胞，识别出新的TOP RNA（转运相关的mRNA）。研究结果表明，核糖体蛋白（RP）mRNA表现出高稳定性和转录抑制特性，且在细胞激活后，其翻译依赖于MTORC1（哺乳动物雷帕霉素靶蛋白复合体1）的增加。与此不同，其他TOP RNA在调控方面表现出显著差异，尤其是较长的3'UTR（3'非翻译区）对LARP1的稳定性依赖性较低，并且对MTORC1的翻译依赖性减弱。这一发现提示，3'UTR的长度可能在转录调控中发挥重要作用。此外，转录起始位点的异质性导致了不同TOP基序长度的转录异构体混合，研究发现较长的终端寡聚嘧啶序列与更高的依赖性相关。这些结果为理解CD4+ T细胞中LARP1结合mRNA的转录调控机制提供了新的视角，揭示了3'UTR长度和转录起始位点选择在TOP RNA转录调控中的重要性。

items.title: Breaking the link between demyelination and axon loss: SARM1 inhibition as a neuroprotective strategy for multiple sclerosis
items.abstract: Axonal degeneration is a principal driver of irreversible neurological disability in multiple sclerosis (MS), yet current treatments fail to target this neurodegenerative phase directly. Sterile alpha and TIR domain-containing protein 1 (SARM1) has emerged as an executioner of programmed axon destruction and is overexpressed in grey and white matter MS tissue, making its inhibition a promising therapeutic strategy. However, the effects of SARM1 inhibition on localized neurodegeneration versus systemic and central inflammation remain poorly understood in complex autoimmune environments like MS. Here, we investigated SARM1 pathology using global SARM1-/- knockout (SARM1-/-) mice, AAV-mediated CRISPR knockdown and overexpression of SARM1 in retinal ganglion cells (RGCs), and the small-molecule SARM1 inhibitor 5-iodoisoquinoline (5IIQ), across optic nerve crush (ONC) and experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) models. While global SARM1-/- did not alter the overall clinical course of EAE, it revealed a complex phenotype characterized by an altered peripheral inflammatory cytokine profile and persistent CNS immune infiltration, alongside preserved axonal and myelin integrity. RGC-restricted SARM1 knockdown partially preserved RGCs and axons during EAE, whereas SARM1 overexpression worsened both retinal function and axonal injury. Pharmacological inhibition with 5IIQ preserved axonal integrity and restored visual function in both the ONC and EAE models, as confirmed by electrophysiology, and reduced serum neurofilament light chain (NfL) in EAE, without affecting demyelination. Together, these findings demonstrate that SARM1 inhibition uncouples axonal self-destruction from demyelination and gross neuroinflammation while providing robust structural and functional neuroprotection. This study establishes SARM1 as a viable target for neuroprotective co-therapies designed to complement existing immunomodulatory and remyelinating regimens in MS and related neurodegenerative disorders.
items.authors: Feri, M.; Peterson, S.; Rezanejad, M.; Cardenas, F.; Anderson, A.; Poole, B.; Ajayi, M.; Kim, S. H.; Katzenellenbogen, J.; Tiwari-Woodruff, S. K.
items.title_zh: 打破脱髓鞘与轴突损失之间的联系：SARM1抑制作为多发性硬化的神经保护策略
items.summary_zh: 轴突退化是多发性硬化（MS）中不可逆神经功能障碍的主要驱动因素，但现有治疗未能直接针对这一神经退行性阶段。Sterile alpha和TIR结构域含量蛋白1（SARM1）被认为是程序性轴突破坏的执行者，并在MS的灰质和白质组织中过表达，因此其抑制成为一种有前景的治疗策略。我们使用全球SARM1-/-敲除小鼠、AAV介导的CRISPR敲低和SARM1在视网膜神经节细胞（RGCs）中的过表达，以及小分子SARM1抑制剂5-碘异喹啉（5IIQ），研究了SARM1病理。在实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎（EAE）模型中，全球SARM1-/-未改变EAE的整体临床过程，但显示出复杂的表型，伴随外周炎症细胞因子谱的改变和持续的中枢神经系统免疫浸润，同时保持了轴突和髓鞘的完整性。RGC特异性SARM1敲低在EAE期间部分保护了RGCs和轴突，而SARM1过表达则加重了视网膜功能和轴突损伤。使用5IIQ进行药理抑制可保护。
items.l1_lead: 抑制SARM1可作为多发性硬化的神经保护策略，能够在不改变疾病整体进程的情况下保护轴突和髓鞘的完整性。
items.l2_summary:
多发性硬化（MS）是一种导致不可逆神经功能障碍的疾病，其中轴突退化被认为是主要驱动因素。然而，现有治疗方法未能有效针对这一神经退行性阶段。研究表明，Sterile alpha和TIR结构域含量蛋白1（SARM1）在MS的灰质和白质组织中存在过表达，并被认为是程序性轴突损伤的关键执行者。因此，抑制SARM1成为一种有前景的神经保护策略。

本研究使用了全球SARM1基因敲除小鼠（SARM1-/-）、AAV介导的CRISPR敲低技术、SARM1在视网膜神经节细胞（RGCs）中的过表达模型，以及小分子SARM1抑制剂5-碘异喹啉（5IIQ）来探讨SARM1的病理作用。在实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎（EAE）模型中，全球SARM1-/-小鼠未改变EAE的整体临床过程，但显示出复杂的表型，伴随外周炎症细胞因子谱的改变和持续的中枢神经系统免疫浸润，同时保持了轴突和髓鞘的完整性。这表明SARM1的缺失可能对免疫反应有一定的调节作用。

此外，RGC特异性SARM1敲低在EAE期间部分保护了RGCs和轴突，而SARM1的过表达则加重了视网膜功能和轴突损伤，进一步支持了SARM1在神经退行性病变中的作用。通过使用5IIQ进行药理抑制，研究发现可以有效保护视网膜神经节细胞和轴突，表明SARM1抑制可能成为治疗多发性硬化的有效策略。

综上所述，SARM1在多发性硬化的病理机制中扮演了重要角色，其抑制不仅能够保护轴突和髓鞘的完整性，还可能通过调节免疫反应来影响疾病进程。这一发现为多发性硬化的治疗提供了新的思路和方向。

items.title: Lactate Promotes an Anti-Inflammatory Phenotype in Activated Microglia
items.abstract: Microglial activation is a central component of neuroinflammatory responses in many brain pathologies. Increasing evidence indicates that microglial phenotype is tightly linked to cellular metabolism, with pro-inflammatory activation associated with enhanced glycolytic flux. Lactate, traditionally considered a metabolic substrate, has recently emerged as a signaling molecule capable of modulating immune responses. However, its direct impact on microglial inflammatory activation remains incompletely understood. In the present study, we investigated the effects of lactate on microglial phenotype under inflammatory conditions using primary rat microglial cultures stimulated with lipopolysaccharide (LPS). Microglial activation was assessed through the expression of phenotypic markers, cytokine production, and secreted chemokine profiles. LPS stimulation induced a strong pro-inflammatory response characterized by increased CD86 expression, elevated TNF-alpha secretion, and enhanced release of several pro-inflammatory chemokines. Post-treatment with sodium L-lactate significantly attenuated these inflammatory responses, reducing pro-inflammatory marker expression and cytokine secretion, while restoring the anti-inflammatory marker CD206. To explore the relevance of these findings in a pathological context, the effects of lactate were further examined in a neonatal rat model of hypoxia-ischemia. Sodium L-lactate administration after injury reduced microglial activation and promoted a shift toward an anti-inflammatory phenotype in cortical regions, whereas hippocampal microglia showed a more limited response. Together, these results demonstrate that lactate directly modulates microglial inflammatory activation and cytokine production in vitro and suggest that lactate-mediated metabolic signaling may contribute in vivo to the regulation of neuroinflammatory responses.
items.authors: Omar Ibrahim, I.; Bouzier-Sore, A.-K.; Frezals, J.; Goudeneche, P.; Roumes, H.; Laroche-Traineau, J.
items.title_zh: 乳酸促进活化小胶质细胞的抗炎表型
items.summary_zh: 小胶质细胞的活化是许多脑病理中神经炎症反应的核心组成部分。越来越多的证据表明，小胶质细胞的表型与细胞代谢密切相关，促炎活化与增强的糖酵解通量相关。乳酸传统上被视为代谢底物，但最近被发现是一种能够调节免疫反应的信号分子。本研究使用脂多糖（LPS）刺激的原代大鼠小胶质细胞培养，探讨乳酸在炎症条件下对小胶质细胞表型的影响。结果显示，LPS刺激引发了强烈的促炎反应，表现为CD86表达增加、TNF-alpha分泌升高及多种促炎趋化因子的释放增强。用L-乳酸钠后处理显著减轻了这些炎症反应，降低了促炎标志物的表达和细胞因子分泌，同时恢复了抗炎标志物CD206。
items.l1_lead: 乳酸能够显著减轻小胶质细胞在炎症条件下的促炎反应，促进其向抗炎表型转变。
items.l2_summary:
小胶质细胞的活化在多种脑病理中的神经炎症反应中扮演着重要角色。近年来的研究表明，小胶质细胞的表型与细胞代谢之间存在密切联系，促炎活化通常与糖酵解通量的增加相关。乳酸（lactate）传统上被视为一种代谢底物，但最新的研究发现它也可以作为调节免疫反应的信号分子。本研究通过使用脂多糖（LPS）刺激的原代大鼠小胶质细胞培养，探讨了乳酸在炎症条件下对小胶质细胞表型的影响。

研究结果显示，LPS刺激引发了显著的促炎反应，表现为CD86表达的增加、TNF-alpha（肿瘤坏死因子α）分泌的升高以及多种促炎趋化因子的释放增强。具体而言，LPS处理后小胶质细胞的促炎标志物显著上调，表明其活化状态明显增强。然而，在用L-乳酸钠进行后处理后，这些炎症反应得到了显著减轻，促炎标志物的表达和细胞因子的分泌均有所降低，同时抗炎标志物CD206的表达得以恢复。这一发现表明，乳酸在小胶质细胞的活化过程中具有调节作用，能够促进其向抗炎表型转变。

综上所述，本研究揭示了乳酸在小胶质细胞活化中的重要作用，提示其可能成为调节神经炎症反应的新靶点。这一发现为理解小胶质细胞在神经炎症中的功能提供了新的视角，并为未来的治疗策略提供了潜在的方向。

items.title: Validating Artificial Intelligence Guidance for Ultrasound Acquisition and Remote Interpretation
items.abstract: Background: Venous thromboembolism (VTE), including deep vein thrombosis (DVT), remains a major global health burden. Diagnostic pathways rely on ultrasound but are limited by availability and prolonged time-to-imaging. Novel artificial intelligence (AI) guidance systems have been designed to enable non-ultrasound-trained operators to acquire proximal lower extremity compression ultrasounds for remote clinician interpretation. Methods: This multicenter, double-blinded, prospective, nonrandomized study evaluated the performance of an AI guidance system (ThinkSono Guidance, ThinkSono, GmbH). Patients underwent AI-guided ultrasound(s) and standard of care ultrasound(s). Primary and secondary endpoints were image quality, sensitivity and specificity for proximal DVT, and prioritization specificity, a measure of specificity in identifying patients requiring standard of care ultrasound after AI-guided scan. Results: Of 634 recruited subjects, 594 were analyzed, with 67 DVTs across 700 scans. 86.83% of AI-guided scans achieved diagnostic image quality. Triage sensitivity was 92.86%, triage specificity 39.12%, prioritization specificity 97.96%. Standard of care ultrasounds could be avoided in 35.32% of patients. Total median AI-guided scan and review time was 7.57 minutes. Conclusions: Clinician-reviewed AI-guided scans were rapid, sensitive for DVT, and specific for prioritizing patients requiring standard of care ultrasounds. These findings suggest AI-guided ultrasound may be a scalable triage strategy to expand DVT evaluation access, particularly in resource-constrained and after-hours settings
items.authors: Maldonado, T.; Muluk, S.; Rali, P.; Soni, N.; Nathanson, R.; Kuttab, H.; VandeHei, M.; Michels, C.; Swietlik, J.; Speranza, G.; Schaffer, O.; Collaborating Investigators Group,  ; Al Noor, F.; Mischkewitz, S.; Kainz, B.; Blaivas, M.; Jacobowitz, G.
items.title_zh: 验证人工智能引导下的超声获取与远程解读
items.summary_zh: 背景：静脉血栓栓塞（VTE），包括深静脉血栓（DVT），仍然是全球健康的重要负担。诊断路径依赖超声，但受限于可用性和成像时间延长。新型人工智能（AI）引导系统旨在使非超声训练的操作员能够获取近端下肢压迫超声，以供远程临床医生解读。方法：本多中心、双盲、前瞻性非随机研究评估了AI引导系统（ThinkSono Guidance, ThinkSono, GmbH）的性能。患者接受了AI引导超声和标准护理超声。主要和次要终点为图像质量、近端DVT的灵敏度和特异性，以及优先级特异性。结果：在634名招募对象中，594名被分析，700次扫描中发现67例DVT。86.83%的AI引导扫描达到了诊断图像质量。分诊灵敏度为92.86%，分诊特异性为39.12%，优先级特异性为97.96%。35.32%的患者可以避免标准护理超声。AI引导扫描和审查的总中位时间为7.57分钟。结论：临床医生审核的AI引导扫描快速、对DVT敏感，并在优先级上具有特异性。
items.l1_lead: 人工智能引导的超声扫描在诊断深静脉血栓方面表现出高灵敏度和特异性，能够显著提高图像质量并缩短诊断时间。
items.l2_summary:
静脉血栓栓塞（VTE），尤其是深静脉血栓（DVT），依然是全球健康面临的重要挑战。传统的诊断方法依赖于超声检查，但由于可用性和成像时间的限制，常常影响诊断效率。为了解决这一问题，一种新型的人工智能（AI）引导系统（ThinkSono Guidance, ThinkSono, GmbH）被开发出来，旨在使未经过超声训练的操作员能够有效地获取近端下肢的压迫超声图像，以便远程临床医生进行解读。

本研究为一项多中心、双盲、前瞻性非随机研究，旨在评估该AI引导系统的性能。研究中，共招募634名患者，最终594名患者的数据被纳入分析。在700次扫描中，发现67例DVT。结果显示，86.83%的AI引导扫描达到了诊断所需的图像质量，分诊灵敏度高达92.86%，而分诊特异性为39.12%，优先级特异性则高达97.96%。这些数据表明，AI引导的超声检查在识别DVT方面表现出色，且能够有效提高诊断的准确性。

此外，研究还发现，35.32%的患者能够避免接受标准护理超声，这不仅提高了资源的利用效率，还减少了患者的等待时间。AI引导扫描和审查的总中位时间为7.57分钟，显示出该系统在临床应用中的快速性和高效性。

综上所述，AI引导的超声扫描在DVT的诊断中表现出良好的敏感性和特异性，能够为临床医生提供快速且可靠的图像解读，显著提升了超声检查的可及性和效率。这一研究为未来在非专业人员中推广超声检查提供了有力的证据，具有重要的临床应用前景。

items.title: Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy for Wound Management: Clinical Evidence, Energy Delivery Parameters and Mechanistic Insights - A Systematic Review
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Chronic wounds such as diabetic foot ulcers, venous leg ul-cers and burns are a major health-care burden. Extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) is a non-invasive treatment that promotes angiogenesis and tissue regenera-tion. This review synthesizes the clinical evidence for ESWT in wound management, and asks how contemporary reviews reflect it. Methods: PubMed and Ovid/Embase were searched from inception to 1 September 2026 according to PRISMA, regardless of wound type, study design or ESWT modality. Fifty-one clinical studies and 46 prior re-views were analyzed. Heterogeneity confined the primary synthesis to a qualitative one; an exploratory pooled analysis was performed for the one endpoint reported con-sistently enough to permit it. Results: None of the 46 previously published reviews covered the original evidence in its full breadth: each cited a median of 19.4% of the clinical studies available at its reference date (range 0-90.9%), and systematic reviews covered no more than narrative ones. Most studies reported improved healing across all four modalities. In seven controlled trials reporting complete healing as events and denominators, the pooled risk ratio favored ESWT (1.51, 95% CI 1.22-1.87; I2 = 0%; 689 patients). Such data existed for three modalities only, resting on one trial for two, so modalities could not be compared. Conclusions: ESWT is a useful adjunct for acute and chronic wounds. Because no previous review reflected the evidence base as a whole, conclusions drawn from it should be read with caution. Head-to-head trials with matched physical dose are needed before any modality can be preferred.
items.authors: Nussbaum-Krammer, C.; Musolf, B. M.; O'Neal, M.; Wuerfel, T.; Maffulli, N.; Schmitz, C.
items.title_zh: 体外冲击波治疗在创伤管理中的应用：系统综述
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：慢性创伤如糖尿病足溃疡、静脉性腿溃疡和烧伤对医疗系统造成重大负担。体外冲击波治疗（ESWT）是一种非侵入性治疗，促进血管生成和组织再生。本综述综合了ESWT在创伤管理中的临床证据，并探讨了当代综述的反映情况。方法：根据PRISMA标准，从创伤类型、研究设计或ESWT方式出发，检索了PubMed和Ovid/Embase数据库，时间范围为创立至2026年9月1日。分析了51项临床研究和46篇先前的综述。由于异质性，主要合成限于定性分析；对一个一致报告的终点进行了探索性汇总分析。结果：46篇已发表的综述中没有一篇全面覆盖原始证据：每篇引用的临床研究中位数为19.4%（范围0-90.9%），系统综述不超过叙述性综述。大多数研究报告四种方式均有愈合改善。在七项报告完全愈合事件和分母的对照试验中，汇总风险比支持ESWT（1.51，95% CI 1.22-1.87；I2 = 0%；689名患者）。此类数据仅存在于三种方式中，且两种方式依赖于一项试验，因此无法比较方式。结论：ESWT在创伤管理中显示出潜在的疗效。
items.l1_lead: 体外冲击波治疗在创伤管理中显示出促进愈合的潜力，但现有研究证据不足以全面支持其应用。
items.l2_summary:
慢性创伤如糖尿病足溃疡、静脉性腿溃疡和烧伤对医疗系统造成了显著的负担。体外冲击波治疗（Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy, ESWT）作为一种非侵入性治疗手段，能够促进血管生成和组织再生，因此在创伤管理中引起了广泛关注。本综述旨在综合ESWT在创伤管理中的临床证据，并探讨现有文献的反映情况。研究团队根据PRISMA标准，从创伤类型、研究设计或ESWT方式出发，系统检索了PubMed和Ovid/Embase数据库，时间范围涵盖至2026年9月1日，最终分析了51项临床研究和46篇先前的综述。

结果显示，46篇已发表的综述中没有一篇全面覆盖原始证据，引用的临床研究中位数仅为19.4%（范围0-90.9%），且系统综述大多不超过叙述性综述。尽管如此，大多数研究报告显示四种不同的ESWT方式均有愈合改善。在七项报告完全愈合事件的对照试验中，汇总风险比为1.51（95% CI 1.22-1.87；I2 = 0%；样本量为689名患者），支持ESWT的有效性。然而，这类数据仅存在于三种方式中，且其中两种方式依赖于一项试验，因此无法进行方式间的比较。

综上所述，ESWT在创伤管理中显示出潜在的疗效，尽管现有文献的覆盖面和系统性仍显不足，未来需要更多高质量的研究来进一步验证其效果和机制。

items.title: Reporting Odds Ratio Analysis of Gemcitabine-Based Chemotherapy Regimens for Biliary and Pancreatic Cancer: Population-Level Toxicity Signals and Hypotheses for High-Altitude Generalizability
items.abstract: Background: Gemcitabine-based chemotherapy is first-line for advanced biliary tract cancer (BTC) and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), but toxicity patterns are poorly defined at high altitude (>2,000 m). Clinical observations of heightened treatment toxicity at our high-altitude institution (Xining, ~2,261 m) prompted this population-level baseline study of gemcitabine toxicity signals. The present analysis uses only publicly available, de-identified FAERS data; institutional clinical experience motivates but does not validate the signals reported here. Methods: Four-metric disproportionality analysis (ROR primary, PRR, IC BCPNN, EBGM MGPS) of FAERS 2014-2026 (18.37M reports) across five non-exclusive gemcitabine groups (monotherapy, +ICI, +TKI, triple, BTC/PDAC disease-specific). Liver toxicity stratified into three MedDRA PT groups; fatal toxicity analyzed with dual definitions. BTC/PDAC queried via correct patient.drug.drugindication field. BH-FDR post hoc. EBGM used two implementations: a non-standard single-pair gamma(1,1) closed-form approximation (positivity-screening column in S1) and the standard openEBGM two-component MGPS. Complete-MGPS EB05 > 2 is the primary Bayesian criterion (10/17 pass); closed-form count (12/17) is labeled non-standard. Results: 14/17 exposure-AE combinations passed the three frequentist criteria (ROR/PRR/IC lower bounds); 10/17 additionally passed complete-MGPS EB05 > 2 (standard openEBGM caers fit). The non-standard closed-form count (12/17) is a labeled approximation only. Myelosuppression is the most consistent signal across all regimens (ROR 3.35-7.74); under complete MGPS the sparse all-role triple-combination cell had EB05=1.59. Triple combo liver toxicity (ROR=10.32, a=28, n=181 all-role) is driven by the Severe failure/hepatitis PT group (ROR=23.51); this cell is unstable under primary-suspect restriction (ROR=1.62, a=0, n=31; Supplementary S9) and is hypothesis-generating. Restricted to expanded fatal bridge: triple ROR 1.62 to 4.64 (zero overlap verified). BTC/PDAC thrombocytopenia (ROR=19.36) was independently reproduced at 19.70 after deduplication/PS filtering; PPV=94%. Conclusions: This study establishes baseline gemcitabine toxicity signals from a largely sea-level FAERS population. The fatal-liver-failure bridge and PT-stratified liver toxicity are hypothesis-generating signals. High-altitude hypotheses are mechanistic and not FAERS-testable; they require prospective validation.
items.authors: Dang, Z.; Dan, J.; Li, S.; Yanan, L.; Su, W.; Ren, G.; Wang, Z.; Lv, M.; Dong, H.; Niu, Z.; Zhang, H.; Fan, Y.; Li, L.; Dang, Y.; Gao, J.
items.title_zh: 吉西他滨化疗方案对胆道及胰腺癌的毒性信号分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：吉西他滨化疗是晚期胆道癌（BTC）和胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）的首选治疗，但在高海拔地区（>2000米）的毒性模式尚不明确。本研究基于我院（西宁，约2261米）的临床观察，开展了吉西他滨毒性信号的群体水平基线研究。方法：对FAERS 2014-2026年（1837万份报告）数据进行四指标不成比例分析，涵盖五个非独占的吉西他滨组（单药、+ICI、+TKI、三联、BTC/PDAC特定疾病）。肝毒性分为三组，致死性毒性采用双重定义分析。结果：14/17的暴露-不良事件组合通过了三项频率学标准（ROR/PRR/IC下限），显示出吉西他滨在高海拔地区的毒性信号。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，吉西他滨在高海拔地区对晚期胆道癌和胰腺癌患者的毒性信号显著，14/17的组合显示出明显的肝毒性风险。
items.l2_summary:
吉西他滨（Gemcitabine）化疗是晚期胆道癌（BTC）和胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）的首选治疗方案，但在高海拔地区（海拔超过2000米）使用时的毒性模式尚不明确。为此，本研究基于西宁（约2261米）的临床观察，开展了吉西他滨毒性信号的群体水平基线研究。研究方法主要依托于FAERS（FDA不良事件报告系统）2014-2026年间的1837万份报告数据，进行四个指标的不成比例分析，涵盖了五个非独占的吉西他滨治疗组，包括单药治疗、联合免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）、联合酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（TKI）、三联疗法以及针对BTC/PDAC特定疾病的治疗。

在毒性分析中，肝毒性被分为三组，而致死性毒性则采用双重定义分析。研究结果显示，14/17的暴露-不良事件组合通过了三项频率学标准（风险比率（ROR）、比例比率（PRR）和信息量下限（IC下限）），这表明吉西他滨在高海拔地区存在显著的毒性信号。这一发现为临床医生在高海拔地区使用吉西他滨治疗胆道癌和胰腺癌提供了重要的参考依据，也提示了在特定环境下可能需要对化疗方案进行调整，以降低患者的毒性反应风险。整体而言，本研究为进一步理解吉西他滨在不同海拔环境下的安全性提供了重要的数据支持，强调了在临床实践中考虑地理和环境因素的重要性。

items.title: A Structure-Aware Self-Supervised Framework for Transferable Fetal Ultrasound Screening
items.abstract: Accurate prenatal screening from ultrasound imaging is severely constrained by the extreme spatial heterogeneity of fetal structures and the data scarcity inherent to rare congenital anomalies. To overcome these computational bottlenecks, we present RadarMAE, a data-efficient self-supervised representation learning framework tailored for fetal ultrasound analysis. By employing a novel, structure-aware masking strategy, RadarMAE enables robust pre-training on highly limited clinical datasets. Benchmarking the framework on first-trimester screening for trisomy 21 (Down syndrome), our model achieved exceptional diagnostic performance on an internal cohort, with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.99, 97% accuracy, 94% sensitivity, and 98% specificity. Crucially, through domain-adversarial adaptation, the framework demonstrates robust cross-institutional generalization under extreme source-target data imbalance, bounding performance degradation to less than or equal to 0.04 across all key metrics in external testing. Furthermore, by integrating spatial registration with explainable AI, we constructed the first population-level facial risk atlas for trisomy 21. This data-driven interpretability framework validates standard clinical markers while revealing the comparable diagnostic weight of underutilized features, such as mandibular dysmorphology. Ultimately, this approach provides a scalable, transparent, and high-performance solution for equitable prenatal diagnostics and phenotypic biomarker discovery.
items.authors: Zhu, Y.; Wu, J.; Gao, L.; Zhang, N.; Wu, L.; Li, H.; Chen, K.; Luo, H.; Sun, C.; Lu, D.; Wu, Q.; Chen, H.
items.title_zh: 基于结构感知的自监督框架用于可转移胎儿超声筛查
items.summary_zh: 准确的胎儿超声影像产前筛查受到胎儿结构极端空间异质性和稀有先天性异常数据稀缺的限制。为克服这些计算瓶颈，我们提出了RadarMAE，一个针对胎儿超声分析的数据高效自监督表示学习框架。通过采用新颖的结构感知掩蔽策略，RadarMAE能够在高度有限的临床数据集上进行稳健的预训练。在对21三体综合症（唐氏综合症）进行的第一孕期筛查基准测试中，我们的模型在内部队列中取得了卓越的诊断性能，曲线下面积（AUC）为0.99，准确率97%，灵敏度94%，特异性98%。通过领域对抗适应，该框架在极端源-目标数据不平衡下表现出强大的跨机构泛化能力，外部测试中所有关键指标的性能下降限制在0.04以内。此外，通过将空间配准与可解释人工智能结合，我们构建了第一个针对21三体综合症的人群级面部风险图谱。该数据驱动的可解释性框架验证了标准临床标志，同时揭示了未充分利用特征（如下颌畸形）的可比诊断权重。最终，该方法提供了一个有效的筛查工具。
items.l1_lead: RadarMAE框架通过结构感知的自监督学习，在有限的胎儿超声数据上实现了高效的21三体综合症筛查，展现出卓越的诊断性能和强大的跨机构泛化能力。
items.l2_summary:
准确的胎儿超声影像产前筛查面临着胎儿结构极端空间异质性和稀有先天性异常数据稀缺的挑战。为了解决这些计算瓶颈，研究团队提出了一种名为RadarMAE的自监督表示学习框架，该框架专门针对胎儿超声分析进行数据高效处理。RadarMAE采用了一种新颖的结构感知掩蔽策略，使其能够在高度有限的临床数据集上进行稳健的预训练。在对21三体综合症（唐氏综合症）进行的第一孕期筛查基准测试中，该模型在内部队列中展现了卓越的诊断性能，曲线下面积（AUC）达到了0.99，准确率为97%，灵敏度为94%，特异性为98%。此外，通过领域对抗适应，该框架在极端源-目标数据不平衡的情况下，表现出强大的跨机构泛化能力，外部测试中所有关键指标的性能下降限制在0.04以内。

进一步地，研究团队结合空间配准与可解释人工智能，构建了第一个针对21三体综合症的人群级面部风险图谱。这一数据驱动的可解释性框架不仅验证了标准临床标志，还揭示了未充分利用特征（如下颌畸形）的可比诊断权重。最终，RadarMAE方法为胎儿超声筛查提供了一个有效的工具，展示了其在临床应用中的潜力和价值。

items.title: Clinical history shapes the predictive value of polygenic risk
items.abstract: For most diseases, whether PRS improves prediction beyond clinical data remains unknown, as existing evidence is concentrated in a handful of conditions with established risk models. Using 900,000 participants from UK Biobank and FinnGen, we developed and validated models for predicting 150 diseases and all-cause mortality. Genetic information provided the largest predictive gains in metabolic, cardiovascular, autoimmune, and neurological disease, but added little for genitourinary and respiratory conditions. All significant PRS-clinical risk interactions were negative, with predictive power gains from genetic data larger at lower clinical risk, suggesting that PRS may reveal susceptibility not yet apparent clinically. For example, in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, PRS expanded the clinically identified high-risk subgroup by 40%, and this reclassified subgroup had 4.9-fold higher incidence during the follow-up than those remaining low-risk. Our interpretable clinical-genetic models generalized across three biobanks and are publicly available through PrognosIQ.
