Our findings reveal secondary stress response activation as an important mechanism linking heterochromatin dysfunction to pathology and identify transcriptional dampening as a potential therapeutic strategy for mitigating these effects.
items.authors: Pradhan, R.; Townley, A. F.; Protasio, A. V.; Danac, J. M.; Dong, Y.; Fang, Y.; Appert, A.; Carelli, F. N.; Han, S.; Vaikkinen, H.; Tchasovnikarova, I.; Ahringer, J.
items.title_zh: 先天免疫应激通路激活导致异染色质功能障碍病理
items.summary_zh: 异染色质的丧失破坏了细胞核结构、基因调控和重复元素沉默，并与多种人类疾病相关。然而，异染色质功能障碍与病理表型之间的机制尚不清楚。通过在秀丽隐杆线虫（C. elegans）中进行遗传互作筛选和基因组分析，我们发现细胞内病原体反应（IPR）这一先天免疫应激通路的二次激活是异染色质突变表型的重要因素。持续的IPR激活表现出与这些突变体相似的生长缓慢和间接转录变化。基因增强子的耗竭进一步增加了IPR激活，而抑制性RNA干扰则减弱了IPR激活，直接的异染色质靶标仍显著失调。值得注意的是，许多抑制因子编码活跃的染色质成分，适度降低RNA聚合酶II活性可改善秀丽隐杆线虫HP1突变体和人类HP1缺乏细胞的生长缺陷。我们的研究揭示了二次应激反应激活作为连接异染色质功能障碍与病理的重要机制，并确定转录抑制作为缓解这些影响的潜在治疗策略。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，先天免疫应激通路的激活是异染色质功能障碍与病理表型之间的重要机制，转录抑制可能成为缓解这些影响的治疗策略。
items.l2_summary:
研究表明，异染色质的丧失会导致细胞核结构、基因调控和重复元素沉默的破坏，并与多种人类疾病相关。然而，异染色质功能障碍与病理表型之间的具体机制仍不明确。通过在秀丽隐杆线虫（C. elegans）中进行遗传互作筛选和基因组分析，研究发现细胞内病原体反应（IPR）这一先天免疫应激通路的二次激活是导致异染色质突变表型的重要因素。持续的IPR激活表现出与这些突变体相似的生长缓慢和间接转录变化，表明IPR的激活与异染色质功能障碍之间存在密切联系。

研究还发现，基因增强子的耗竭会进一步增加IPR的激活，而抑制性RNA干扰则能够减弱IPR的激活，尽管直接的异染色质靶标仍然显著失调。这一发现提示，抑制因子编码的活跃染色质成分在这一过程中起着重要作用。值得注意的是，适度降低RNA聚合酶II活性能够改善秀丽隐杆线虫HP1突变体和人类HP1缺乏细胞的生长缺陷，进一步支持了转录抑制在缓解异染色质功能障碍影响中的潜在治疗策略。

综上所述，本研究揭示了二次应激反应激活作为连接异染色质功能障碍与病理的重要机制，并为未来的治疗策略提供了新的思路，强调了转录抑制在改善相关病理表型中的潜在应用价值。

items.title: Discrepancies between ChIP-seq and CUT&Tag histone mark profiles are explained by GC content and chromatin accessibility
items.abstract: Chromatin profiling methods, such as ChIP-seq (chromatin immunoprecipitation followed by sequencing), are used to characterize the genomic localization of DNA-associated proteins. While ChIP and ChIP-seq have been used for decades, an orthogonal approach, CUT&Tag (Cleavage Under Targets and Tagmentation), is gaining popularity as an efficient and cost-effective alternative. Although previous comparative studies note discrepancies in signal-to-noise ratios and detection bias at certain genomic regions, many differences between ChIP-seq and CUT&Tag results remain largely unreconciled. Here, we systematically investigate the disagreeing signals captured by these two methods across well annotated genomic regions. We assess multiple histone mark profiles generated by different groups in two cell lines (K562 and MCF-7). Overall, our analysis indicates that compared to ChIP-seq, CUT&Tag may have limited sensitivity in low-GC environments and, as previously observed, increased signal in hyper-accessible chromatin. Notably, within GC-poor regions of active gene bodies and Polycomb-repressed domains, CUT&Tag exhibits a loss of H3K36me3 and H3K27me3 signal, respectively, where occupancy of these histone marks is otherwise expected. Further, active promoters with discrepant H3K4me3 and H3K27ac signal between the two assays differ systematically in GC content and chromatin accessibility. Promoters differentially enriched for CUT&Tag signal relative to ChIP-seq generally show higher, broader GC-content profiles and higher DNase-seq and ATAC-seq signal, while promoters enriched for ChIP-seq signal harbor the opposite characteristics. A local bias for high GC content and/or chromatin accessibility in CUT&Tag may also explain its differing signal patterns at nucleosome-depleted regions (NDRs) compared to ChIP-seq and MNase-seq promoter profiles. Altogether, our results highlight that studies focused on profiling the intensity and structure of histone modification occupancy can be sensitive to potential biases of CUT&Tag to GC content and chromatin accessibility. These characteristics should be accounted for when selecting a chromatin profiling approach, analyzing and interpreting data as well as drawing biological conclusions.
items.authors: Modolo, E.; Patel, L.; Ram, O.; Simon, I.; Mendenhall, E.; Heinz, S.; Benner, C.; Goren, A.
items.title_zh: ChIP-seq与CUT&Tag组蛋白标记差异的GC含量与染色质可及性解释
items.summary_zh: 本研究系统性探讨了ChIP-seq（染色质免疫沉淀测序）与CUT&Tag（靶点下切割与标记）在已注释基因组区域捕获的信号差异。我们评估了在K562和MCF-7细胞系中不同组生成的多种组蛋白标记谱。分析结果表明，与ChIP-seq相比，CUT&Tag在低GC环境中的灵敏度有限，而在超可及染色质中信号增强。特别是在活跃基因体的GC贫乏区域和Polycomb抑制域中，CUT&Tag分别缺失H3K36me3和H3K27me3信号。此外，两个实验中H3K4me3与H3K27ac信号不一致的活跃启动子在GC含量和染色质可及性上存在系统性差异。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了ChIP-seq与CUT&Tag在不同GC含量和染色质可及性条件下捕获组蛋白标记信号的差异，影响了活跃基因体和抑制域的标记表现。
items.l2_summary: 本研究系统性探讨了染色质免疫沉淀测序（ChIP-seq）与靶点下切割与标记（CUT&Tag）在已注释基因组区域捕获信号的差异，重点分析了在K562和MCF-7细胞系中不同组生成的多种组蛋白标记谱。研究结果显示，CUT&Tag在低GC（鸟嘌呤-胞嘧啶）含量的环境中灵敏度有限，而在超可及染色质中信号则显著增强。具体而言，在活跃基因体的GC贫乏区域和Polycomb抑制域中，CUT&Tag分别缺失了H3K36me3和H3K27me3的信号。此外，两个实验中H3K4me3与H3K27ac信号不一致的活跃启动子在GC含量和染色质可及性上存在系统性差异。这些发现表明，GC含量和染色质的可及性对组蛋白标记的捕获效率有显著影响，提示在选择实验方法时需考虑这些因素，以便更准确地解析基因组调控机制。

items.title: The Network Landscape of Non-Clinical Eating Behaviors in India
items.abstract: Eating behaviors are traditionally conceptualized as individual psychological phenomena, yet their structural organization remains largely unmapped in non-Western contexts. Adopting a dimensional perspective, this study used network analysis to characterize the architecture of non-clinical eating behaviors in India (N = 1,508; 48.9% male, 50.7% female; age range = 18-65 years) based on 35 well-validated biopsychosocial measures. Mixed Graphical Models revealed a highly optimized, small-world system defined by a dual-layered hierarchy. Cultural and living conditions (religion, home type) served as local behavioral anchors (highest expected influence), whereas socioeconomic factors (employment, education) and self-esteem functioned as structural bridges (highest betweenness centrality) integrating the biopsychosocial system. Notably, shape and weight concerns were highly predictable but operated as local cluster nodes rather than global integrators-directly challenging Western body-image-centric models. Limitations include cross-sectional design, precluding causal inference, and the need for ongoing validation of Western-derived measures in Indian contexts. These findings suggest that in a developing economy, broader psychosocial structural factors rather than individual factors may contribute to the maintenance of eating disorder symptoms.
items.authors: Ray, D.; Ravishankar, A.; Chen, E. Y.; Das, M.
items.title_zh: 印度非临床饮食行为的网络结构研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对印度的非临床饮食行为进行网络分析，样本量为1,508人（男性48.9%，女性50.7%，年龄范围18-65岁），基于35项经过验证的生物心理社会测量工具。混合图形模型揭示了一个高度优化的小世界系统，具有双层次的层级结构。文化和生活条件（宗教、居住类型）作为地方行为锚点（影响力最高），而社会经济因素（就业、教育）和自尊则作为结构性桥梁（中介中心性最高），整合了生物心理社会系统。值得注意的是，形体和体重关注高度可预测，但作为地方集群节点而非全球整合者，直接挑战了西方以身体形象为中心的模型。研究的局限性包括横断面设计，无法推断因果关系，以及需要在印度背景下持续验证西方衍生测量工具。这些发现表明，在发展中经济体中，较广泛的心理社会结构因素可能比个体因素更能维持饮食障碍症状。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示，印度非临床饮食行为受文化和生活条件影响显著，心理社会结构因素在维持饮食障碍症状中比个体因素更为重要。
items.l2_summary:
本研究针对印度的非临床饮食行为进行了网络分析，样本量为1,508人，其中男性占48.9%，女性占50.7%，年龄范围为18至65岁。研究基于35项经过验证的生物心理社会测量工具，采用混合图形模型揭示了一个高度优化的小世界系统，展现出双层次的层级结构。在这一结构中，文化和生活条件（如宗教和居住类型）被认定为地方行为的锚点，具有最高的影响力；而社会经济因素（如就业和教育）以及自尊则作为结构性桥梁，展现出中介中心性最高的特征，整合了生物心理社会系统。

研究发现，形体和体重关注在饮食行为中具有高度可预测性，但其作为地方集群节点的角色却并未成为全球整合者，这一发现直接挑战了以身体形象为中心的西方模型。研究的局限性在于其采用了横断面设计，无法推断因果关系，同时也指出需要在印度背景下持续验证西方衍生的测量工具。

总体而言，这些发现表明，在发展中经济体中，较广泛的心理社会结构因素可能比个体因素更能维持饮食障碍症状。这一研究为理解印度的饮食行为提供了新的视角，强调了文化和社会经济背景在饮食行为中的重要性。

items.title: Performance of protein panels is inflated across many biomarker studies
items.abstract: Data leakage is a prevalent yet underappreciated flaw in biomarker discovery studies. Through simulation and real-world proteomic data, we demonstrate that typical pipelines are broadly susceptible to this issue, producing inflated performance estimates, poor generalization, and excess false positives. We further introduce two tools to detect data leakage at the code and manuscript level, providing a practical path toward more rigorous and reproducible biomarker reporting.
items.authors: An, L.; Finney, C. A.; Shvetcov, A.; The Global Neurodegeneration Proteomics Consortium,  ; Vogel, J.
items.title_zh: 蛋白质面板在生物标志物研究中的表现被高估
items.summary_zh: 数据泄漏是生物标志物发现研究中普遍存在但被低估的缺陷。通过模拟和真实的蛋白质组学数据，我们展示了典型的研究流程普遍容易受到这一问题的影响，导致性能估计被高估、泛化能力差以及假阳性过多。我们进一步介绍了两种工具，用于在代码和手稿层面检测数据泄漏，为更严格和可重复的生物标志物报告提供了实用路径。
items.l1_lead: 蛋白质面板在生物标志物研究中的表现被高估，数据泄漏问题普遍存在，影响研究结果的可靠性和泛化能力。
items.l2_summary: 在生物标志物发现研究中，数据泄漏（data leakage）是一个普遍存在但常常被低估的缺陷。通过对模拟和真实的蛋白质组学（proteomics）数据进行分析，我们发现典型的研究流程普遍容易受到数据泄漏的影响。这种影响导致了性能估计的过高，泛化能力的不足，以及假阳性（false positive）结果的增加。具体而言，研究表明，在未能有效控制数据泄漏的情况下，研究结果的可靠性和有效性受到严重威胁。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了两种工具，旨在帮助研究人员在代码和手稿层面检测数据泄漏。这些工具为生物标志物报告提供了更严格和可重复的实用路径，从而提高研究的可信度和科学性。通过这些措施，研究者能够更好地识别和避免数据泄漏带来的负面影响，确保生物标志物的发现过程更加严谨和可靠。

items.title: Neuro-Symbolic AI for Automated Pathology Quality Measurement
items.abstract: Background. Clinical quality measurement often relies on manual abstraction of medical records, an approach that is costly, burdensome, and often infeasible for measures requiring interpretation of narrative text; these constraints have shaped measure development itself, filtering out clinically important measures that are too difficult to operationalize. We evaluated whether neuro-symbolic artificial intelligence (NSAI), which combines large language model extraction with symbolic reasoning, could reliably abstract complex quality measures from narrative pathology reports. Methods. The NSAI system decomposes each measure into atomic questions and is aligned to real-world reports through case-based refinement, an iterative human-in-the-loop process. Using 2,000 independently double-abstracted reports, we compared NSAI-based abstraction against trained human abstractors across four pathology quality measures established by the College of American Pathologists. Results. The NSAI system's agreement with the adjudicated gold standard (Cohen's kappa = 0.95) matched or modestly exceeded that of the trained human abstractors measured against the same standard (kappa = 0.92), with particularly strong performance on Gastrointestinal Metaplasia (CAP 43). In component analyses, case-based refinement drove the largest accuracy gains (up to 0.25 in kappa), whereas architectural decomposition primarily reduced performance variance across language-model backends more than tenfold, a property essential for clinical deployment. Conclusions. These findings suggest that automated abstraction could enable census-level quality measurement, reduce reporting burden, and expand the range of clinically meaningful measures that can be operationalized from narrative clinical documentation.
items.authors: Brann, F.; Tadele, L.; Skau, C.; Bocsi, G.; Clarke, A. K.
items.title_zh: 神经符号人工智能在自动化病理质量测量中的应用
items.summary_zh: 背景：临床质量测量通常依赖于手动抽取医疗记录，这种方法成本高、负担重，且对需要解读叙述文本的指标往往不可行。我们评估了神经符号人工智能（NSAI）是否能够从叙述病理报告中可靠地抽取复杂的质量指标。方法：NSAI系统将每个指标分解为基本问题，并通过案例基础的迭代人机协作过程与现实报告对齐。使用2000份独立双重抽取的报告，我们将NSAI抽取与经过训练的人类抽取者在美国病理学会设定的四个病理质量指标上进行了比较。结果：NSAI系统与裁定的金标准一致性（Cohen's kappa = 0.95）与经过训练的人类抽取者的结果相当或略有超出（kappa = 0.92），在胃肠道化生（CAP 43）上表现尤为突出。组件分析显示，案例基础的细化带来了最大的准确性提升（kappa提升至0.25）。
items.l1_lead: 神经符号人工智能能够高效、准确地从叙述病理报告中提取复杂的质量指标，其表现与训练有素的人类抽取者相当，甚至在某些方面有所超越。
items.l2_summary:
在临床质量测量中，传统方法通常依赖于手动抽取医疗记录，这种方式不仅成本高、负担重，而且在处理需要解读叙述文本的指标时常常不可行。为了解决这一问题，本研究评估了神经符号人工智能（Neuro-Symbolic Artificial Intelligence, NSAI）在从叙述病理报告中可靠抽取复杂质量指标的能力。研究方法上，NSAI系统将每个质量指标分解为基本问题，并通过案例基础的迭代人机协作过程与实际报告进行对齐。研究使用了2000份独立双重抽取的病理报告，将NSAI的抽取结果与经过训练的人类抽取者在美国病理学会设定的四个病理质量指标上的表现进行了比较。

结果显示，NSAI系统与裁定的金标准之间的一致性达到了Cohen's kappa = 0.95，表现与经过训练的人类抽取者的结果相当或略有超出（kappa = 0.92），尤其在胃肠道化生（CAP 43）指标上表现尤为突出。组件分析表明，案例基础的细化过程显著提升了准确性，使得kappa值提升至0.25。这些结果表明，NSAI在自动化病理质量测量中具有很高的潜力，能够有效减轻人工抽取的负担，并提高质量指标的抽取准确性。整体而言，本研究为神经符号人工智能在医疗领域的应用提供了有力的证据，展示了其在提升临床质量测量效率和准确性方面的前景。

items.title: Public awareness of the hearing loss-dementia link and self-reported behavioral changes in middle- to older-aged Canadians
items.abstract: Hearing loss is a potential risk factor for dementia, but public awareness of this link and its behavioral implications remain poorly understood. In a cross-sectional survey, 1,404 Canadians aged 44-97 years completed measures of awareness, subjective hearing and cognition, dementia-related concerns, perceptions of the link, and demographics. 28% of people were aware of the hearing loss-dementia link. Of these, 17% were more inclined to seek/continue hearing-loss treatment. Awareness and self-reported behavioral responses were over twice as prevalent in a health-engaged subsample. Education, dementia concern, older age, and female gender were associated with awareness. Among aware participants, dementia concern, poorer subjective cognition, and confidence in understanding the link, but not education, were associated with reported treatment inclination. Awareness thus follows socioeconomic and demographic gradients, but these alone do not appear to ensure behavior change. Communication may need to reach beyond health-engaged groups and prioritize accurate understanding over awareness.
items.authors: Bobbitt, S.; Mathiesen, S. L.; Binns, M.; Herrmann, B.
items.title_zh: 加拿大中老年人对听力损失与痴呆关联的认知及行为变化
items.summary_zh: 听力损失是痴呆的潜在风险因素，但公众对这一关联及其行为影响的认知仍不充分。本研究通过横断面调查，收集了1,404名年龄在44至97岁之间的加拿大人的认知、主观听力与认知、与痴呆相关的关注、对关联的看法及人口统计信息。结果显示，28%的人意识到听力损失与痴呆之间的关联，其中17%的人更倾向于寻求或继续接受听力损失治疗。在健康参与者子样本中，意识和自我报告的行为反应的比例超过两倍。教育水平、对痴呆的关注、年龄较大和女性性别与意识相关。对于已意识到这一关联的参与者，痴呆关注、主观认知较差和对理解关联的信心与治疗倾向相关，但教育水平并无显著影响。因此，意识受社会经济和人口统计因素影响，但这些因素并不足以确保行为改变。沟通可能需要超越健康参与群体，优先考虑准确理解而非仅仅是意识。
items.l1_lead: 加拿大中老年人对听力损失与痴呆关联的认知不足，只有28%意识到其关系，且社会经济因素影响意识但未必导致行为改变。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了加拿大中老年人对听力损失与痴呆（dementia）之间关联的认知及其行为变化。研究通过横断面调查的方式，收集了1,404名年龄在44至97岁之间的参与者的数据，涵盖了他们的认知水平、主观听力感受、对痴呆的关注程度、对听力损失与痴呆关联的看法以及人口统计信息。结果显示，只有28%的参与者意识到听力损失与痴呆之间存在关联，其中17%的人表示更倾向于寻求或继续接受听力损失的治疗。在健康参与者的子样本中，意识到这一关联的比例和自我报告的行为反应超过了两倍。

研究还发现，教育水平、对痴呆的关注、年龄较大以及女性性别与参与者的意识水平相关联。然而，对于那些已经意识到听力损失与痴呆关联的参与者，痴呆关注、主观认知较差以及对理解这一关联的信心与其治疗倾向存在相关性，但教育水平并未显示出显著影响。这表明，尽管社会经济和人口统计因素对意识的形成有影响，但这些因素并不足以确保行为的改变。因此，研究建议在沟通策略上应超越健康参与群体，优先考虑参与者对听力损失与痴呆关联的准确理解，而不仅仅是提高意识。这一发现强调了在公共健康教育中，提升对听力损失与痴呆关联的理解的重要性，以促进更积极的健康行为。

items.title: Long-term mortality rate changes and inverse patterns for pandemic and post-pandemic excess mortality
items.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic and pandemic response may have long-term consequences. The cumulative impact may be better appraised when post-pandemic years are also considered. For 38 populations with reliable death registration data, we estimated excess deaths for 2020-2025 with granular age stratification. One model (Fa) compared deaths against the mean of 2017-2019. Three other trend models considered changes in mortality rates after 2003 (or after a country reached $20,000 per capita income) factoring trend-of-trends (TTa), including shrinkage (STTa), and factoring also the 2024-2025 data for trend-of-trends calculation (STTa+). Slopes (weighted mean -0.62%/year in 2019) and slopes-of-slopes (weighted mean +0.104%/year^2) for age-stratified mortality rates were highly heterogeneous across populations. On model average, 4 populations (Luxembourg, Ireland, Sweden, New Zealand) had cumulative death deficits during 2020-2025, while another 6 (Chile, Bulgaria, Japan, Greece, Slovakia, Italy) had >4% excess deaths. Differences were more prominent during 2020-2023, while 33/38 countries had death deficits in 2024-2025. Total 2020-2025 excess deaths were 0.92-2.49 million (2020-2023: 1.99-2.88 million; 2024-2025: a deficit of 0.39-1.08 million). Lack of age stratification and use of unchanged linear trends for the baseline (as in Lee-Carter modeling) grossly biased excess death estimates upwards. Socioeconomically more vulnerable populations had higher pandemic deaths, but a more pronounced post-pandemic death deficit. Excess death estimates require careful consideration of changing population age structure and long-term mortality trajectories. Post-pandemic deficits, especially in more vulnerable populations, may reflect pandemic deaths of people with modest life expectancy, paid off in 2024-2025.
items.authors: Ioannidis, J.; Levitt, M.
items.title_zh: 疫情及后疫情期过剩死亡率的长期变化研究
items.summary_zh: COVID-19疫情及其应对措施可能带来长期影响。本文分析了38个具有可靠死亡登记数据的人群在2020-2025年的过剩死亡情况，采用细致的年龄分层。通过与2017-2019年均值比较的模型（Fa）及考虑2003年后死亡率变化的趋势模型，估算出不同人群的死亡率变化。结果显示，2020-2025年间，4个国家（卢森堡、爱尔兰、瑞典、新西兰）出现了累计死亡缺口，而6个国家（智利、保加利亚、日本、希腊、斯洛伐克、意大利）则有超过4%的过剩死亡。2020-2023年差异更为明显，33个国家在2024-2025年出现死亡缺口。总的过剩死亡人数为0.92-2.49百万，2020-2023年为1.99-2.88百万，2024-2025年为0.39-1.08百万的缺口。缺乏年龄分层及使用不变线性趋势的基线模型严重偏倚了过剩死亡估算。
items.l1_lead: 研究显示，COVID-19疫情导致38个国家在2020-2025年间出现显著的过剩死亡，尤其在2020-2023年间，死亡人数达1.99-2.88百万，反映出疫情的长期影响。
items.l2_summary: 本文研究了COVID-19疫情及其应对措施对过剩死亡率的长期影响，分析了38个具有可靠死亡登记数据的人群在2020-2025年间的过剩死亡情况，并进行了细致的年龄分层。研究采用了与2017-2019年均值比较的模型（Fa）以及考虑2003年后死亡率变化的趋势模型，以估算不同人群的死亡率变化。结果显示，在2020-2025年间，卢森堡、爱尔兰、瑞典和新西兰四个国家出现了累计死亡缺口，而智利、保加利亚、日本、希腊、斯洛伐克和意大利六个国家则报告了超过4%的过剩死亡。特别是在2020-2023年期间，死亡差异更加明显，33个国家在2024-2025年期间出现了死亡缺口。整体来看，过剩死亡人数估计在0.92至2.49百万之间，其中2020-2023年的过剩死亡人数为1.99至2.88百万，而2024-2025年则为0.39至1.08百万的缺口。研究指出，缺乏年龄分层及使用不变线性趋势的基线模型严重偏倚了过剩死亡的估算结果。这一研究为理解疫情后期的死亡率变化提供了重要的实证依据，强调了在分析死亡数据时考虑年龄因素的重要性。

items.title: Assessing respiratory rates and signs of air hunger using the PneumoRator sensor.
items.abstract: Objectives: To investigate whether the PneumoRator wearable sensor could accurately assess Respiratory Rate (RR) and signs of air hunger (SAH) compared with clinician-observed assessment in adults with and without breathing pattern disorder (BrPD). Design: A pilot cross-sectional observational study. Setting: A research laboratory on a university campus. Participants: Healthy adults aged 18-40, who were not pregnant, no smokers or history of cardiovascular, respiratory or neurological illness. Thirty consented to the study, Twenty-nine had full data for analysis. Interventions: Participants wore the PneumoRator chest-worn sensor continuously for 10 minutes while seated at rest. Main outcome measures: Respiratory Rate was compared between PneumoRator-derived measurements and randomised 1-minute observer manual counts. Clinician-observed SAH and BrPD were assessed using the Breathing Pattern Assessment Tool (BPAT). Participants also completed the Nijmegen Questionnaire. PneumoRator signals were analysed to identify large-volume breaths as potential SAH events. Results: Thirty participants were recruited. Twelve participants met BPAT criteria for BrPD and four met Nijmegen Questionnaire criteria. There was no significant difference between manual and PneumoRator RR measurements (p=0.89). No significant difference was observed between methods for SAH detection (p=0.17). Participants with clinician-observed SAH demonstrated significantly higher PneumoRator signal amplitudes than those without SAH (p=0.035). Conclusion: The PneumoRator produced RR measurements comparable to clinician assessment and demonstrated potential for identifying signs of air hunger. Findings from this pilot study indicate that the PneumoRator device shows promise as a tool for continuous RR monitoring and as an adjunct to BrPD assessment. Larger clinical validation studies are now warranted.
items.authors: Hudson-Colby, J.; Baston, H.; Harding, M.; Brider, S.; Yates, F.; Shaban, M.; White, N. M.; Lewis, A.
items.title_zh: 使用PneumoRator传感器评估呼吸频率与缺氧感
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估PneumoRator可穿戴传感器在成人（包括有无呼吸模式障碍者）中对呼吸频率（RR）和缺氧感（SAH）的准确性。研究设计为一项初步的横断面观察研究，参与者为18-40岁健康成年人，共招募30名，29名提供了完整数据。参与者在静坐休息状态下连续佩戴PneumoRator传感器10分钟。主要结果显示，PneumoRator测得的RR与随机1分钟的手动计数之间无显著差异（p=0.89），SAH检测方法之间也无显著差异（p=0.17）。研究表明，PneumoRator传感器在评估呼吸频率和缺氧感方面具有潜在的应用价值。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，PneumoRator传感器在评估成人的呼吸频率和缺氧感方面具有良好的准确性，显示出其潜在的应用价值。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在评估PneumoRator可穿戴传感器在成人（包括有无呼吸模式障碍者）中对呼吸频率（RR）和缺氧感（SAH）的准确性。研究采用初步的横断面观察设计，共招募了30名年龄在18至40岁的健康成年人，其中29名参与者提供了完整的数据。参与者在静坐休息状态下连续佩戴PneumoRator传感器10分钟，以测量其呼吸频率和缺氧感。研究结果显示，PneumoRator测得的呼吸频率与随机1分钟的手动计数之间无显著差异（p=0.89），这表明PneumoRator在呼吸频率的测量上具有较高的准确性。此外，SAH检测方法之间也未显示出显著差异（p=0.17），进一步支持了PneumoRator在缺氧感评估中的潜在应用价值。综上所述，PneumoRator传感器在评估呼吸频率和缺氧感方面表现出良好的可靠性，提示其在临床监测和健康管理中可能具有重要的应用前景。

items.title: The Vanishing White Matter registry: a unique source of natural history data
items.abstract: The Vanishing White Matter (VWM) Registry is a single-center database containing longitudinal survey data from >470 untreated patients with DNA- and MRI-confirmed VWM. VWM is a rare genetic disorder of the brain's white matter with an estimated live birth incidence of 1 per 100,000 and prevalence of 1.3 per 1,000,000 people in the Netherlands. The Registry represents a remarkably extensive collection of systematically gathered information on this disease, enabling crucial research into the natural history of VWM and providing a valuable resource for control arms in clinical trials. Data, initially collected on paper from 2004, have been maintained electronically since 2018, and include validated scales alongside a disease-specific customized questionnaire covering clinical, functional, and psychosocial domains. Survey packages, available in eight languages, are sent one to four times a year, depending on patient age. Built-in validity checks and review by pediatric and adult neurologists ensure data quality. The dataset is continuously updated with questionnaires expanding its scope, and structured for analysis and reuse in research on VWM.
items.authors: Postema, M. C.; van Voorst, R. J.; Hamilton, E. M. C.; Schoenmakers, D. H.; Stellingwerff, M. D.; Steenweg, M. E.; Verbeek, R. J.; van der Knaap, M. S.
items.title_zh: 消失性白质登记：独特的自然历史数据来源
items.summary_zh: 消失性白质（VWM）登记是一个单中心数据库，包含来自470多名未经治疗的VWM患者的纵向调查数据，这些患者的DNA和MRI均已确认。VWM是一种罕见的遗传性脑白质疾病，在荷兰的活产发生率约为每10万人1例，患病率为每100万人1.3例。该登记提供了系统收集的关于该疾病的广泛信息，促进了对VWM自然历史的关键研究，并为临床试验的对照组提供了宝贵资源。数据自2004年起以纸质形式收集，2018年起转为电子维护，包含经过验证的量表和涵盖临床、功能及心理社会领域的定制问卷。调查包提供八种语言，每年发送1至4次，具体取决于患者年龄。内置的有效性检查和儿科及成人神经科医生的审核确保了数据质量。数据集持续更新，问卷扩展其范围，并为VWM研究的分析和再利用而结构化。
items.l1_lead: 消失性白质登记为VWM患者提供了系统的纵向数据，促进了该疾病自然历史的研究，并为临床试验提供了重要的对照资源。
items.l2_summary:
消失性白质登记（VWM登记）是一个专注于消失性白质（VWM）这一罕见遗传性脑白质疾病的单中心数据库，涵盖了来自470多名未经治疗的VWM患者的纵向调查数据。这些患者的DNA和MRI均已确认，确保了数据的可靠性。VWM在荷兰的活产发生率约为每10万人1例，患病率为每100万人1.3例，显示出其罕见性。该登记自2004年起以纸质形式收集数据，2018年起转为电子维护，提供了系统收集的关于VWM的广泛信息，促进了对该疾病自然历史的深入研究，并为临床试验的对照组提供了宝贵的资源。

登记的数据包括经过验证的量表和涵盖临床、功能及心理社会领域的定制问卷，调查包提供八种语言，以便更好地服务不同语言背景的患者。问卷的发送频率根据患者年龄的不同，每年可达1至4次。为了确保数据质量，登记内置了有效性检查，并由儿科及成人神经科医生进行审核。数据集持续更新，问卷的范围也在不断扩展，以便为VWM研究的分析和再利用提供结构化的数据支持。

通过这一登记，研究人员能够获得关于VWM的关键自然历史数据，推动对该疾病的理解和治疗方法的探索，进而为患者提供更好的医疗服务。VWM登记不仅为科学研究提供了重要的基础数据，也为未来的临床试验奠定了坚实的基础。

items.title: Deep Time-to-Event Models for Intrapartum Fetal Monitoring
items.abstract: Timely detection of fetal distress during labor is a central pursuit of modern obstetric care. The primary measure used in this regard is fetal heart rate and contraction monitoring (echocardiotocography or CTG), which provides a continuous signal during labor. The vast majority of machine learning applications to CTG assume access to a 30 to 60 minute window just prior to delivery, which makes an untenable assumption that the timing of delivery is known. In this work, we reframe the problem as a time-to-event prediction task. We develop deep time-to-event models to predict the joint probability of imminent delivery and fetal acidosis, a biomarker of fetal hypoxia collected from umbilical cord gas after delivery. We develop a framework for this problem, drawing on deep discrete-time survival methods and marked point processes, adapting each to this particular setting (i.e., continuous physiological signals, fully observed events, partially observed labels). One approach dubbed Marked DeepHit accurately estimates delivery within one hour at multiple elapsed-time landmarks, with test-set AUROC of 0.837 [95% CI 0.692--0.970] and 0.935 [0.858--0.964] at 6 and 12 hours into labor, respectively. We find that these models also achieve competitive performance near delivery time compared to prior models trained specifically on the end of tracing, and outperform other clinical feature-based proposals, both on internal and external validation at a second site. These results give a proof-of-principle to support future prospective deployment of AI-EFM during labor.
items.authors: Imai Aldeia, G. S.; Coggan, H.; Yang, Y.; Levine, L.; McCoy, J. A.; La Cava, W.
items.title_zh: 深度时间事件模型用于产程胎儿监测
items.summary_zh: 及时检测产程中的胎儿窘迫是现代产科护理的核心任务。主要的监测手段是胎心率和宫缩监测（心电图监测或CTG），提供产程中的连续信号。大多数机器学习在CTG上的应用假设在分娩前有30到60分钟的窗口，这一假设不切实际，因为分娩时间并不明确。本研究将问题重新定义为时间事件预测任务，开发深度时间事件模型来预测即将分娩和胎儿酸中毒的联合概率，后者是通过脐带气体在分娩后收集的胎儿缺氧生物标志物。我们提出了一种框架，结合深度离散时间生存方法和标记点过程，适应这一特定设置。我们的方法“标记深度Hit”在多个时间节点上准确估计分娩时间，测试集AUROC在产程6小时和12小时分别为0.837和0.935。我们的模型在接近分娩时表现出竞争力，优于专门训练于追踪结束的先前模型。
items.l1_lead: 本研究提出了一种深度时间事件模型，能够有效预测产程中胎儿窘迫和分娩时间，显著提高了监测的准确性。
items.l2_summary:
在现代产科护理中，及时检测产程中的胎儿窘迫是核心任务，而胎心率和宫缩监测（心电图监测或CTG）是主要的监测手段，能够提供产程中的连续信号。然而，大多数机器学习在CTG上的应用假设在分娩前有30到60分钟的窗口，这一假设在实际操作中并不切合，因为分娩时间往往难以准确预测。为此，本研究将这一问题重新定义为时间事件预测任务，旨在开发一种深度时间事件模型，以预测即将分娩和胎儿酸中毒的联合概率，后者是通过脐带气体在分娩后收集的胎儿缺氧生物标志物。

研究提出了一种新的框架，结合了深度离散时间生存方法和标记点过程，以适应这一特定的监测需求。所提出的方法被称为“标记深度Hit”，在多个时间节点上能够准确估计分娩时间。在测试集上，该模型在产程6小时和12小时的AUROC（曲线下面积）分别达到了0.837和0.935，显示出其在接近分娩时的竞争力，且优于以往专门训练于追踪结束的模型。这一研究不仅为产程监测提供了新的思路，也为胎儿窘迫的早期预警提供了更为有效的工具，具有重要的临床应用价值。

items.title: Perspective independence, more than personas, drives LLM teams - and where they reverse
items.abstract: Multi-agent prompting of large language models has produced contradictory diagnostic results, and it remains unclear whether any benefit comes from specialist personas or from perspective independence. We compared a single direct call, five personas in one context, and the same five roles as isolated agents integrated by a moderator, with five repeat runs per case, on 87 CPC cases, 406 MedCaseReasoning cases, and 364 emergency department encounters, under an LLM judge validated against clinicians. On the external benchmark the team beat the single call on both pre-specified recall endpoints (top-3 +3.0 points, p = 0.0079; top-5 +3.9, p = 3.8 x 10^-5;); a factorial attributes the gain to independent generation plus moderated synthesis, not the specialist roles. On real emergency presentations the benefit reversed (top-1 40.1% versus 34.3%, p < 0.0001), carried by the specialist role lists and surviving added objective results. Deployment should key on the question and the input at hand.
items.authors: Feng, J.; Jiao, Y.; Li, Y.; Xie, L.; Peng, W.; Sun, X.
items.title_zh: 视角独立性驱动大型语言模型团队的表现
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了多智能体提示对大型语言模型（LLM）的影响，特别是专家角色与视角独立性之间的关系。我们比较了单次直接调用、在一个上下文中使用五个角色，以及由主持人整合的五个孤立代理，针对87个CPC案例、406个MedCaseReasoning案例和364个急诊科接诊案例进行了五次重复实验，使用经过临床医生验证的LLM评估。结果显示，团队在外部基准测试中超越了单次调用，在预设的召回指标上（前3名提高3.0分，p = 0.0079；前5名提高3.9，p = 3.8 x 10^-5），增益归因于独立生成与调节综合，而非专家角色。在真实急诊表现中，效果则相反（前1名40.1%对比34.3%，p < 0.0001），由专家角色列表推动并保留了额外的客观结果。部署应关注具体问题及当前输入。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，视角独立性和专家角色的结合能显著提升大型语言模型团队在特定任务中的表现，尤其在真实急诊场景中更为明显。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了多智能体提示对大型语言模型（LLM）团队表现的影响，特别关注专家角色与视角独立性之间的关系。研究通过比较单次直接调用、在一个上下文中使用五个角色以及由主持人整合的五个孤立代理，针对87个CPC案例、406个MedCaseReasoning案例和364个急诊科接诊案例进行了五次重复实验，使用经过临床医生验证的LLM进行评估。结果显示，团队在外部基准测试中表现优于单次调用，具体体现在预设的召回指标上：前3名的召回率提高了3.0分（p = 0.0079），前5名则提高了3.9分（p = 3.8 x 10^-5）。这一增益主要归因于独立生成与调节综合的能力，而非专家角色的影响。

然而，在真实急诊表现中，结果则有所不同，前1名的召回率为40.1%，相比之下，单次调用的召回率为34.3%（p < 0.0001），显示出专家角色列表在此情境下的推动作用，并保留了额外的客观结果。这表明，在不同的应用场景中，专家角色的存在可能会对结果产生显著影响。因此，研究建议在部署大型语言模型时，应关注具体问题及当前输入，以优化模型的表现和效果。整体而言，这项研究为理解多智能体系统在医疗领域的应用提供了重要的实证依据，强调了视角独立性与专家角色在不同情境下的不同作用。

items.title: Diagnosing antimicrobial stewardship needs in a pluralistic health system in India: Why Local Evidence Must Guide Implementation
items.abstract: Objective. To identify antimicrobial stewardship targets by triangulating provider knowledge and practice, government-facility prescribing indicators and patient-reported treatment experience in three districts of Chhattisgarh, India. Methods. We analysed three independently sampled cross-sectional components: a provider survey (171 providers), a World Health Organization and International Network for Rational Use of Drugs assessment (600 encounters at 20 government facilities) and patient exit interviews (371 consultations). We used descriptive indicators and multivariable ordinal or binary logistic regression. Findings. Among providers, 149 of 163 (91.4%) recognized antimicrobial resistance, but 131 of 163 (80.4%) reported providing antibiotics for colds or sore throats to at least some patients. Guideline familiarity was not associated with less frequent provision (adjusted common odds ratio [aOR], 1.13; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.57-2.24; P=0.725). Government facilities prescribed antibiotics in 329 of 600 encounters (54.8%), with a facility range of 16.7-80.0%. In exit interviews, 131 of 142 informal-provider consultations (92.3%) involved a reported injection; informal providers accounted for 131 of 181 reported injections (72.4%). Clear or very clear instructions were associated with satisfaction (aOR: 13.66; 95% CI: 6.37-29.28; P<0.001). Conclusion. High awareness coexisted with frequent self-reported antibiotic provision, wide facility variation and sector-specific injection exposure. Stewardship programmes should diagnose local drivers before selecting interventions and prospectively evaluate adapted decision support, audit and feedback, independent drug information, informal-provider engagement and communication training.
items.authors: Konar, D.; Singh, D.; Patil, G. A.; Pradhan, I.; Kataria, R.
items.title_zh: 印度多元卫生系统中抗生素管理需求的诊断
items.summary_zh: 目的。通过三角测量提供者知识与实践、政府医疗机构处方指标及患者报告的治疗体验，识别印度恰蒂斯加尔邦三个地区的抗生素管理目标。方法。我们分析了三个独立抽样的横断面组件：提供者调查（171名提供者）、世界卫生组织和国际合理用药网络评估（在20个政府医疗机构的600次就诊）及患者退出访谈（371次咨询）。我们使用描述性指标和多变量序数或二元逻辑回归。发现。在提供者中，149名中的163名（91.4%）认识到抗生素耐药性，但131名（80.4%）报告对至少部分患者提供感冒或喉咙痛的抗生素。指南熟悉度与提供频率无显著关联（调整后的共同比值比[aOR]，1.13；95%置信区间[CI]，0.57-2.24；P=0.725）。政府医疗机构在600次就诊中开具抗生素的比例为54.8%（329次），机构间范围为16.7%-80.0%。在退出访谈中，142次非正式提供者咨询中有131次（92.3%）涉及注射；非正式提供者占181次报告注射的131次（72.4%）。明确或非常明确的指示与患者满意度相关（aOR: 13.66；95% CI: 6.37-29.28；P<0.001）。结论。高意识水平。
items.l1_lead: 印度恰蒂斯加尔邦的抗生素管理面临挑战，尽管提供者对抗生素耐药性有较高认识，但仍普遍不当使用抗生素，且患者满意度与明确指示相关。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在通过三角测量方法，识别印度恰蒂斯加尔邦三个地区的抗生素管理目标，具体分析了提供者的知识与实践、政府医疗机构的处方指标以及患者的治疗体验。研究涉及171名医疗提供者的调查、在20个政府医疗机构进行的600次就诊的世界卫生组织和国际合理用药网络评估，以及371次患者退出访谈。结果显示，在提供者中，有149名（占总数的91.4%）认识到抗生素耐药性的问题，但其中131名（80.4%）仍然向至少部分患者开具感冒或喉咙痛的抗生素。值得注意的是，提供者对抗生素使用指南的熟悉程度与其开具抗生素的频率之间并没有显著关联（调整后的共同比值比[aOR]为1.13，95%置信区间[CI]为0.57-2.24，P=0.725）。在政府医疗机构的600次就诊中，抗生素的开具比例为54.8%（329次），不同机构之间的开具比例差异较大，范围为16.7%至80.0%。此外，在患者的退出访谈中，142次非正式提供者的咨询中，有131次（92.3%）涉及注射治疗，而在181次报告注射的案例中，非正式提供者占据了72.4%。研究还发现，明确或非常明确的用药指示与患者的满意度显著相关（aOR为13.66，95% CI为6.37-29.28，P<0.001）。综上所述，尽管提供者对抗生素耐药性有较高的认识水平，但在实际的处方实践中，抗生素的使用仍然普遍，显示出抗生素管理的需求亟待改善。

items.title: A within-host-informed event-time framework linking epidemiological delay distributions
items.abstract: Understanding when and how pathogens spread from person to person is fundamental to characterizing transmission, interpreting surveillance data, and designing effective control measures. Yet key epidemiological delays -- including the latent period, incubation period, generation interval, and serial interval -- are difficult to estimate because key events such as infection, infectiousness, symptom onset, and transmission are rarely observed directly. Current approaches typically estimate these delays using flexible statistical distributions rather than explicitly linking them through the underlying processes that generate them, making it difficult to interpret the underlying biology and to ensure consistency across related delay estimates. Here, we develop a stochastic event-time framework built around a dynamic within-host pathogen-growth model that treats epidemiological delays as coupled outcomes of a shared biological process. By representing these key events as linked stochastic events, the framework produces internally consistent delay distributions while inferring parameters with mechanistic interpretations conditional on the assumed within-host model that govern pathogen growth, clearance, infectiousness, and symptom onset. The framework also accommodates censored and partially observed infection and symptom-onset times through a unified observation model. Across simulation studies, the framework accurately recovered generation-interval characteristics across sample sizes and disease time scales. In applications to SARS-CoV-2 and mpox transmission-pair data, the framework showed improved predictive fit relative to conventional lognormal delay models in several analyses, although the magnitude of improvement varied across datasets and observation models; it estimated shorter generation intervals for Omicron than Delta and revealed alternative within-host parameters compatible with the mpox transmission data. This mechanistic framework provides a biologically interpretable alternative to independently fitted delay distributions, yields internally consistent estimates of epidemiological delays, and establishes a foundation for integrating biological and epidemiological data to better understand, predict, and control pathogen transmission.
items.authors: Jamieson, N.; Park, S. W.; Ainslie, K.; Xu, J.; Funk, S.; Ward, T.; Overton, C. E.; Meyers, L. A.; Abbott, S.
items.title_zh: 基于宿主内信息的事件时间框架与流行病学延迟分布的关联
items.summary_zh: 理解病原体如何在人与人之间传播对于传染特征的描述、监测数据的解读以及有效控制措施的设计至关重要。然而，潜伏期、 incubation period、世代间隔和序列间隔等关键流行病学延迟难以估计，因为感染、传染性、症状出现和传播等关键事件很少被直接观察。当前方法通常使用灵活的统计分布来估计这些延迟，而不是通过生成它们的基本过程明确关联，导致对生物学的解读困难。本文开发了一种基于动态宿主内病原体生长模型的随机事件时间框架，将流行病学延迟视为共享生物过程的耦合结果。该框架通过将关键事件表示为关联的随机事件，生成内部一致的延迟分布，并在假设的宿主内模型条件下推断具有机制解释的参数。该框架还通过统一观察模型处理被删失和部分观察的感染及症状出现时间。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种基于宿主内病原体生长模型的事件时间框架，能够更准确地估计流行病学延迟，并为传染病传播的机制提供清晰的解释。
items.l2_summary:
理解病原体在人与人之间的传播机制对于描述传染特征、解读监测数据以及设计有效控制措施至关重要。然而，潜伏期（incubation period）、世代间隔和序列间隔等关键流行病学延迟的估计面临挑战，因为感染、传染性、症状出现和传播等关键事件往往难以直接观察。现有的方法通常采用灵活的统计分布来估计这些延迟，但缺乏与其基本过程的明确关联，导致对生物学机制的解读变得困难。

为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种基于动态宿主内病原体生长模型的随机事件时间框架，将流行病学延迟视为共享生物过程的耦合结果。该框架通过将关键事件视作相互关联的随机事件，生成内部一致的延迟分布，并在假设的宿主内模型条件下推断出具有机制解释的参数。这种方法的创新之处在于，它不仅提供了对流行病学延迟的更准确估计，还能够通过统一观察模型有效处理被删失和部分观察的感染及症状出现时间。

通过这一框架，研究者能够更好地理解和描述病原体传播的动态过程，从而为流行病学研究提供更为坚实的理论基础和实证支持。这一方法的提出，标志着流行病学延迟估计的一个重要进展，能够为公共卫生决策提供更为可靠的数据支持，进而提升对传染病的监测与控制能力。

items.title: New-Onset Heart Failure in Patients with Obesity using Tirzepatide or Semaglutide
items.abstract: Background: Tirzepatide and semaglutide improve functional status and heart failure (HF) events in patients with obesity and HF with preserved ejection fraction. Tirzepatide has been associated with greater control of cardiometabolic risk factors in patients with obesity compared to semaglutide. Whether tirzepatide is associated with lower risk of new-onset HF than semaglutide in patients with obesity is underexplored. Methods: A retrospective cohort study was conducted using data pooled from the TriNetX platform. Patients with obesity who initiated therapy with tirzepatide or semaglutide during the period Jun 4, 2021 to Aug 13, 2026 were identified and 1:1 propensity-score matched to produce two study cohorts. The one-year incidence of new-onset HF was calculated and compared between the two cohorts. Secondary outcomes included new-onset systolic HF, new-onset diastolic heart failure, new-onset atrial fibrillation or flutter, all-cause mortality, and hospital encounters. Cox proportional hazards models were fitted to calculate hazard ratios (HR) along with 95% confidence intervals (CI). Results: Two well-matched cohorts (N=424,269 in each) were formed. The incidence of new-onset HF was lower in the tirzepatide group (1.0% vs. 1.3%; absolute risk difference -0.3%, 95% CI -0.35 to -0.26; HR 0.9, 95% CI 0.86[boxh]0.93). The tirzepatide group were also at lower risk of all-cause mortality (HR, 95% CI: 0.8, 0.77[boxh]0.91) and new-onset systolic HF (0.8, 0.79[boxh]0.92). All other secondary outcomes occurred at similar rates in both study groups. Conclusion: Among patients with obesity, tirzepatide therapy was associated with lower risk of new-onset HF compared to semaglutide although the effect sizes were modest.
items.authors: Al-Nusair, M.; Haddad, T. A.; Khurana, S.; Al-Nusair, J.
items.title_zh: 肥胖患者使用Tirzepatide或Semaglutide的新发心力衰竭研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：Tirzepatide和Semaglutide在肥胖及射血分数保留的心力衰竭患者中改善功能状态和心力衰竭事件。与Semaglutide相比，Tirzepatide在控制心脏代谢风险因素方面效果更佳。本研究探讨Tirzepatide是否能降低肥胖患者新发心力衰竭的风险。方法：采用回顾性队列研究，数据来源于TriNetX平台，筛选2021年6月4日至2026年8月13日期间接受Tirzepatide或Semaglutide治疗的肥胖患者，进行1:1倾向评分匹配，形成两个研究队列。计算并比较两组的新发心力衰竭一年发生率。结果：形成两个匹配良好的队列（各424,269人）。Tirzepatide组新发心力衰竭发生率为1.0%，低于Semaglutide组的1.3%（绝对风险差-0.3%，95% CI -0.35至-0.26；HR 0.9，95% CI 0.86至0.93）。Tirzepatide组的全因死亡风险也较低。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，肥胖患者使用Tirzepatide治疗的新发心力衰竭发生率显著低于Semaglutide，且Tirzepatide组全因死亡风险也较低。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨肥胖患者使用Tirzepatide（替尔扎肽）与Semaglutide（塞马鲁肽）治疗后新发心力衰竭的风险差异。背景显示，Tirzepatide和Semaglutide均能改善肥胖及射血分数保留的心力衰竭患者的功能状态和心力衰竭事件，而Tirzepatide在控制心脏代谢风险因素方面表现更佳。为此，研究采用回顾性队列研究设计，数据来源于TriNetX平台，筛选了2021年6月4日至2026年8月13日期间接受Tirzepatide或Semaglutide治疗的肥胖患者，并通过1:1倾向评分匹配形成两个研究队列。

在研究中，最终形成了两个匹配良好的队列，各包含424,269名患者。结果显示，Tirzepatide组的新发心力衰竭发生率为1.0%，显著低于Semaglutide组的1.3%，绝对风险差为-0.3%（95% CI -0.35至-0.26），风险比（HR）为0.9（95% CI 0.86至0.93），表明Tirzepatide在降低新发心力衰竭风险方面具有优势。此外，Tirzepatide组的全因死亡风险也较低。这些结果支持了Tirzepatide在肥胖患者心力衰竭管理中的潜在益处，提示其可能成为改善心脏健康的重要治疗选择。

items.title: Spatial clustering of undervaccination amplifies local measles transmission but limits geographic spread: South Carolina, 2025-2026
items.abstract: The 2025 measles outbreak in South Carolina, the largest in the United States in over two decades, produced 997 confirmed cases, predominantly among school-aged children in an under-vaccinated community in Spartanburg County. To support the South Carolina Department of Public Health (DPH) measles response, we developed a stochastic agent-based model to forecast outbreak trajectory and evaluate intervention strategies in real time, integrating transmission across three spatial scales and grounded in geocoded households, school enrollment records, and census-derived demographic data. The model predicted a median of 1,020 total infections (90% prediction interval: 840-1,273). Counterfactual simulations without active contact tracing and quarantine projected a median of 2,432 infections (90% prediction interval: 1,867-3,185), approximately 138% more than the model-predicted baseline (1,020 cases). Model fidelity required a highly localized between-school contact structure; broader contact assumptions substantially overpredicted both case counts and geographic spread. Simulated regional introductions confirmed that outbreaks arose only near connected clusters of undervaccination, while well-vaccinated areas remained contained. Model versions deployed prospectively at weeks 9, 17, and 34 of the response informed resource allocation decisions and provided operational evidence for the effectiveness of contact tracing and quarantine strategies. Critically, the model reproduced geographic spread, number of affected schools, and breakthrough infection counts not used in fitting, validating its structural fidelity and establishing a replicable framework for jurisdictions maintaining school-enrollment and vaccination records.
items.authors: Pandey, A.; Bleichrodt, A. M.; Serman, E. A.; Tanim, S. H.; Bento, A. I.; Rennert, L.
items.title_zh: 南卡罗来纳州2025-2026年麻疹疫情的空间聚集分析
items.summary_zh: 2025年南卡罗来纳州爆发的麻疹疫情是美国二十多年来最大的疫情，确认病例达997例，主要发生在斯巴坦堡县一个疫苗接种不足的社区。为支持南卡罗来纳州公共卫生部的麻疹应对工作，我们开发了一个随机代理模型，以预测疫情轨迹并实时评估干预策略，整合了三个空间尺度的传播数据，并基于地理编码的家庭、学校入学记录和人口普查数据。模型预测总感染病例中位数为1,020例（90%预测区间：840-1,273）。如果没有积极的接触追踪和隔离，反事实模拟预测中位数为2,432例感染（90%预测区间：1,867-3,185），比模型预测的基线（1,020例）高出约138%。模型的准确性要求高度本地化的学校间接触结构；更广泛的接触假设显著高估了病例数和地理传播。模拟的区域引入确认疫情仅在接种不足的连接聚集区附近发生，而接种良好的地区保持稳定。模型在应对的第9、17和34周前瞻性部署，为资源分配决策提供了依据。
items.l1_lead: 南卡罗来纳州2025-2026年麻疹疫情主要集中在疫苗接种不足的社区，模型预测若无干预病例将大幅增加，强调了精准接触追踪的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
2025年，南卡罗来纳州爆发了美国二十多年来最大的麻疹疫情，确认病例达到997例，主要集中在斯巴坦堡县一个疫苗接种不足的社区。为了支持南卡罗来纳州公共卫生部的麻疹应对工作，研究团队开发了一个随机代理模型（random agent-based model），以预测疫情的传播轨迹并实时评估干预策略。该模型整合了三个空间尺度的传播数据，基于地理编码的家庭、学校入学记录和人口普查数据进行分析。

模型的预测结果显示，总感染病例的中位数为1,020例，90%的预测区间为840至1,273例。研究还进行了反事实模拟，结果表明如果没有积极的接触追踪和隔离措施，中位数感染病例将达到2,432例，90%的预测区间为1,867至3,185例，这一数字比模型预测的基线（1,020例）高出约138%。这一发现强调了接触追踪和隔离在控制疫情传播中的重要性。

模型的准确性依赖于高度本地化的学校间接触结构，研究发现更广泛的接触假设会显著高估病例数和地理传播的范围。模拟结果显示，疫情的传播主要发生在接种不足的连接聚集区附近，而接种良好的地区则保持相对稳定。为了更有效地应对疫情，模型在应对的第9、17和34周进行了前瞻性部署，为资源分配决策提供了科学依据。

通过这一研究，团队不仅为南卡罗来纳州的公共卫生应对提供了重要的数据支持，也为其他地区在类似疫情中的应对策略提供了参考，强调了精准接触追踪和疫苗接种的重要性。

items.title: Adiposity and sex steroid hormones: evidence on direct measures and changes over time -- a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.abstract: Introduction: The evidence synthesis on literature characterizing changes in body fatness and adiposity distribution with sex steroid measurements in different matrices (blood, tissue, urine and other excreted matrices) is lacking. Methods: PubMed and Web of Science were used to identify eligible studies published until June 2026. Random-effects meta-analyses were conducted, and the strength of evidence was determined based on the Continuous Update Project criteria. Results: Of 16,875 screened references, 140 studies deemed relevant: 96 on circulating blood biomarkers from 39 weight loss intervention (surgical and lifestyle) and 60 observational studies reporting direct measure of adiposity distribution (e.g., DEXA, MRI), 20 studies on biomarkers measured in urine or other excreted matrices (i.e., saliva, urine, breast ductal lavage), and 25 tissue-based studies (e.g., adipose, breast, endometrial, skin). Weight loss was associated with a reduction of total and free testosterone, and an increase in sex hormone binding globulin (SHBG). While no significant associations were found between weight loss and premenopausal estradiol, dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate, and androstenedione. Decrease in total and free estradiol and estrone were observed in postmenopausal women. Findings in observational studies generally supported those results, as well as tissue-based studies on estrogen-related markers despite the heterogeneous tissue types. Studies on biomarker measured in excreted matrices were largely inconclusive. Conclusion: Strong evidence of a probable association was found between body fatness and SHBG, androgens, and postmenopausal estrogens. Limited evidence remained for other sex steroids.
items.authors: Kebede, M. M.; Spahits, H.; Dutta, S.; Turzanski Fortner, R.; Le Cornet, C.
items.title_zh: 肥胖与性激素：直接测量及时间变化的系统评估与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 引言：关于体脂变化及其分布与不同基质（血液、组织、尿液等）中性激素测量的文献综述不足。方法：使用PubMed和Web of Science识别截至2026年6月的相关研究。进行了随机效应荟萃分析，并根据持续更新项目标准评估证据强度。结果：在筛选的16,875篇文献中，140项研究被认为相关：96项涉及39个减重干预（手术和生活方式）的循环血液生物标志物，60项观察性研究直接测量体脂分布（如DEXA、MRI），20项研究尿液或其他排泄基质中的生物标志物（如唾液、尿液、乳腺导管冲洗），以及25项组织基础研究（如脂肪、乳腺、子宫内膜、皮肤）。减重与总睾酮和游离睾酮的减少及性激素结合球蛋白（SHBG）的增加相关。尽管未发现减重与绝经前雌二醇、脱氢表雄酮硫酸盐和雄烯二醇的显著关联，绝经后女性观察到总雌二醇和雌酮的减少。观察性研究的发现一般支持这些结果，以及关于雌激素的组织基础研究。
items.l1_lead: 肥胖与性激素之间存在复杂关系，减重可降低总睾酮和游离睾酮水平，同时增加性激素结合球蛋白，而绝经后女性则表现出雌激素水平的下降。
items.l2_summary:
本研究对肥胖与性激素之间的关系进行了系统评估和荟萃分析，特别关注体脂变化及其分布对不同生物基质（如血液、组织、尿液等）中性激素测量的影响。研究通过在PubMed和Web of Science中筛选相关文献，最终确定了140项相关研究，这些研究涵盖了39个减重干预（包括手术和生活方式改变）的循环血液生物标志物，60项观察性研究直接测量体脂分布（如双能X射线吸收法DEXA、磁共振成像MRI），20项研究分析尿液或其他排泄基质中的生物标志物（如唾液、尿液、乳腺导管冲洗），以及25项组织基础研究（如脂肪、乳腺、子宫内膜、皮肤）。

研究结果表明，减重与总睾酮和游离睾酮的减少以及性激素结合球蛋白（SHBG）的增加存在显著相关性。尽管在绝经前女性中未发现减重与雌二醇、脱氢表雄酮硫酸盐和雄烯二醇之间的显著关联，但在绝经后女性中观察到总雌二醇和雌酮的减少。这些发现得到了观察性研究的支持，同时也与关于雌激素的组织基础研究结果相一致。

综上所述，本研究为肥胖与性激素之间的关系提供了重要的证据，强调了减重对性激素水平的影响，尤其是在不同性别和生理状态下的差异。这些结果为未来的研究和临床干预提供了重要的参考依据，尤其是在肥胖管理和性激素相关疾病的预防与治疗方面。

items.title: Identification of Transcriptional Hippo Response Signature Connecting Inflammatory Bowel Disease and Colorectal Cancer Progression
items.abstract: Background: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) has been linked to a two- to eightfold increase in colorectal cancer (CRC) risk. However, particular genes that bridge intestinal dysbiosis and oncogenic transcriptional reprogramming remain unclear. The Hippo/YAP pathway is a major regulator of intestinal epithelial homeostasis whose effector YAP is hyperactivated in CRC, but its transcriptional engagement in IBD mucosa and its link to specific cancer-risk genes has not been thoroughly mapped. Methods: Bulk RNA-seq data were integrated from two independent cohorts: GSE235236 (IBD colon mucosa; UC/CD vs. healthy controls; n = 56) and TCGA-COAD/READ (CRC tumors stratified by YAP activity; n = 592). Differential expression analysis was conducted separately within each cohort using Welch's t-test with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction. YAP transcriptional activity was estimated per sample as the mean row-wise Z-score of seven canonical YAP target genes, and TCGA tumors were stratified into Hippo-High (Q4) and Hippo-Low (Q1) groups. Genes showing consistent dysregulation across both cohorts were identified and ranked to define a Dysbiosis-Hippo Response (DHR) module, which was further organized into functional gene archetypes. Results: IBD mucosa showed 2,848 significantly dysregulated genes (FDR < 0.05). Comparison with the CRC cohort identified 120 genes showing concordant dysregulation, forming the DHR module. These genes were significantly enriched in TNF-alpha signaling via NF-kB (adjusted p = 0.006), inflammatory response (adjusted p = 0.013), and Myogenesis (adjusted p = 0.013). DHR gene classification revealed three functional archetypes: (i) innate immune activation (SPI1, OSM, IL11, LILRA2, SLC11A1) reflecting convergent myeloid reprogramming; (ii) epithelial-mesenchymal transition (TWIST1, SNAI1, PRRX2, MMP9) priming invasive potential before malignancy; and (iii) tumor microenvironment immune regulation (TN-FRSF4, TNFRSF18, PDCD1, VASN, SPON2) shaping immune tolerance. Interestingly, the canonical YAP target genes (CTGF, CYR61, ANKRD1, AMOTL2, and FSTL1), sharply upregulated in Hippo-High CRC, were essentially unchanged in IBD mucosa. This signifies that the shared DHR programme operates through non-canonical YAP effectors. And yet, YAP target scores are positively correlated with DHR module expression across IBD samples (Spearman rho = 0.726, p = 2.5 x 10-10). Conclusions: Our findings define a three-archetype DHR module that links gut dysbiosis to YAP-driven oncogenesis at single-gene resolution. The programme shared between IBD and CRC is driven by innate immune activation, EMT priming, and remodeling of the immune microenvironment, not by the canonical CTGF/CYR61 YAP target axis, which appears only at the CRC stage. This gene-level framework provides tractable mechanistic targets for chemoprevention and biomarker development at the inflammation-to-cancer transition.
items.authors: Noor, S.; Vignaish, K. S.; Joshi, P.
items.title_zh: 识别连接炎症性肠病与结直肠癌进展的Hippo转录响应特征
items.summary_zh: 背景：炎症性肠病（IBD）与结直肠癌（CRC）风险增加2至8倍相关。然而，尚不清楚哪些特定基因连接肠道失调与致癌转录重编程。Hippo/YAP通路是肠上皮稳态的重要调节因子，其效应因子YAP在CRC中被过度激活，但其在IBD黏膜中的转录参与及与特定癌症风险基因的关联尚未彻底绘制。方法：整合了来自两个独立队列的bulk RNA-seq数据：GSE235236（IBD结肠黏膜；UC/CD与健康对照；n = 56）和TCGA-COAD/READ（按YAP活性分层的CRC肿瘤；n = 592）。在每个队列中分别进行差异表达分析，并计算YAP转录活性。结果：IBD黏膜显示2,848个显著失调基因（FDR < 0.05）。与CRC队列比较，识别出120个表现出一致失调的基因。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，炎症性肠病中的特定基因与结直肠癌的转录重编程相关，识别出120个在两者中一致失调的基因，揭示了Hippo/YAP通路的潜在致癌机制。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了炎症性肠病（IBD）与结直肠癌（CRC）之间的关系，特别关注Hippo/YAP通路在这一过程中所扮演的角色。研究表明，IBD与CRC的风险增加2至8倍，但具体哪些基因在肠道失调与致癌转录重编程之间起到连接作用尚不明确。Hippo/YAP通路是维持肠上皮稳态的重要调节因子，其中效应因子YAP在CRC中常常被过度激活。然而，YAP在IBD黏膜中的转录参与及其与特定癌症风险基因的关联仍未得到充分研究。

为此，研究整合了来自两个独立队列的bulk RNA-seq数据，分别是GSE235236（包含IBD结肠黏膜样本，涵盖溃疡性结肠炎UC、克罗恩病CD与健康对照，共计56个样本）和TCGA-COAD/READ（按YAP活性分层的CRC肿瘤样本，共592个）。在每个队列中，研究团队进行了差异表达分析，并计算了YAP的转录活性。

结果显示，IBD黏膜中有2,848个基因表现出显著的失调（FDR < 0.05）。在与CRC队列的比较中，研究识别出120个基因在IBD和CRC中均表现出一致的失调。这些发现为理解IBD与CRC之间的分子机制提供了新的视角，揭示了Hippo/YAP通路在肠道炎症与癌症发展中的潜在作用，可能为未来的治疗策略提供新的靶点。

items.title: Directed effective connectivity between the SCN-containing hypothalamus and pineal gland varies by chronotype in bipolar disorder
items.abstract: Circadian disruption is a transdiagnostic feature of psychiatric illness, particularly in bipolar disorder (BD), where evening chronotype is linked to greater symptom severity. The suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) times pineal gland (PG) melatonin synthesis through a well-described feedforward pathway. Moreover, melatonin can also phase-shift the SCN-pacemaker, consistent with a functional feedback limb. Directed effective connectivity between the SCN-containing hypothalamus and the PG has not been estimated in human neuroimaging, and it is unknown whether that directed coupling varies by psychiatric diagnosis or chronotype. We applied cross-spectral dynamic causal modeling (DCM) to resting-state fMRI data in 431 UK Biobank (healthy controls [HC, N=136], BD [N=78], major depressive disorder [MDD, N=154] and psychotic disorders [PY, N=63]). Random-effects Bayesian model selection compared a fully connected model with reduced archiature and, separately, feedforward-only (SCN[- ]PG) vs feedback-only (PG[- ]SCN) models. A per-subject log Bayes factor difference (dF) indexed directionality preference and was tested against diagnosis, chronotype and their interaction using ANCOVA. The fully connected model was strongly preferred (posterior probability=97.8%, protected exceedance probability [PXP]=1.00). Feedforward architecture dominated overall (70% vs 30%, PXP=1.00). Diagnosis did not predict dF (p=.403), but chronotype did (p=.036), and there was a significant diagnosis-by-chronotype interaction (p<.001). Feedforward dominance was strongest in evening chronotypes (p<.001). Model evidence favored a fully connected architecture with overall feedforward dominance. That preference varied by chronotype and, qualified by the interaction, was strongest in BD evening chronotypes. The pattern supports BD-evening chronotype as a high-risk subgroup and argues for routine chronotype assessment in BD care.
items.authors: Mehrdadi, I.; Kuster, S.; Rohrer, J.; Seifritz, E.; Chatelain, C.; Chan, G.; Homan, P.; Tahedl, M.
items.title_zh: 双相障碍中SCN-含量下丘脑与松果体的有效连接与生物钟类型相关
items.summary_zh: 昼夜节律紊乱是精神疾病的跨诊断特征，尤其在双相障碍（BD）中，晚间生物钟类型与症状严重性相关。上交叉核（SCN）通过已知的前馈通路调节松果体（PG）褪黑激素合成。此外，褪黑激素也能相位移SCN，形成功能反馈。我们应用交叉谱动态因果建模（DCM）分析了431名UK Biobank参与者的静息态fMRI数据，包括健康对照（HC, N=136）、BD（N=78）、重性抑郁障碍（MDD, N=154）和精神病障碍（PY, N=63）。随机效应贝叶斯模型选择比较了完全连接模型与简化架构模型，以及前馈（SCN[- ]PG）与反馈（PG[- ]SCN）模型。每个受试者的对数贝叶斯因子差异（dF）用于评估方向偏好，并通过ANCOVA检验与诊断、生物钟类型及其交互的关系。结果显示，完全连接模型被强烈偏好（后验概率=97.8%，保护超越概率[PXP]=1.00），前馈架构占主导（70% vs 30%，PXP=1.00）。诊断未显著影响结果。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，双相障碍患者的生物钟类型与下丘脑和松果体之间的有效连接密切相关，前馈通路在调节褪黑激素合成中占主导地位。
items.l2_summary:
昼夜节律紊乱是精神疾病的一个重要特征，尤其在双相障碍（BD）中，晚间生物钟类型与症状的严重性存在显著关联。研究表明，上交叉核（SCN）通过已知的前馈通路调节松果体（PG）合成褪黑激素，而褪黑激素也能通过相位移SCN形成功能反馈。为探讨双相障碍与生物钟类型之间的关系，我们对431名UK Biobank参与者的静息态功能磁共振成像（fMRI）数据进行了交叉谱动态因果建模（DCM）分析，参与者包括健康对照（HC, N=136）、双相障碍（BD, N=78）、重性抑郁障碍（MDD, N=154）和精神病障碍（PY, N=63）。

在分析中，我们采用随机效应贝叶斯模型选择方法，比较了完全连接模型与简化架构模型，以及前馈（SCN[- ]PG）与反馈（PG[- ]SCN）模型。每个受试者的对数贝叶斯因子差异（dF）用于评估方向偏好，并通过协方差分析（ANCOVA）检验与诊断、生物钟类型及其交互的关系。结果显示，完全连接模型被强烈偏好，后验概率达到97.8%，保护超越概率（PXP）为1.00，表明该模型在数据拟合上具有极高的可信度。此外，前馈架构在连接中占主导地位，比例为70%对30%（PXP=1.00），而诊断因素未显著影响结果。

综上所述，本研究揭示了双相障碍患者中SCN与PG之间的有效连接模式，强调了前馈通路在调节褪黑激素合成中的重要性，并为理解双相障碍的生物钟类型提供了新的视角。这些发现可能为未来的治疗策略提供理论基础，尤其是在针对昼夜节律紊乱的干预措施方面。

items.title: Intrathoracic Adipose Tissue and Airway Structure, Lung Function, and Respiratory Symptoms: The Framingham Heart Study
items.abstract: Background: Obesity is associated with airway disease, but the contribution of specific thoracic adipose depots remains unclear. We examined whether intrathoracic adipose tissue (ITAT), defined as adipose tissue within the thoracic cavity excluding pericardial adipose tissue (PAT), was associated with airway phenotypes. Methods: We included Framingham Heart Study participants with CT-derived thoracic adipose tissue measures. Cross-sectional associations of ITAT with CT-based airway wall and lumen measurements, spirometry, and respiratory symptoms were evaluated using multivariable regression. Primary analyses used sex-specific ITAT z-scores and adjusted for waist circumference to account for central obesity. Secondary analyses examined sex-specific ITAT quintiles and compared ITAT and PAT in individual-depot and mutually adjusted models. Results: Among 2,825 adult participants (52.0% female), after adjustment for waist circumference, each 1-SD higher ITAT, relative to the sex-specific distribution, was associated with greater segmental ({beta} [95% CI]: 0.010 mm [0.006, 0.014]) and subsegmental airway wall thickness (0.006 mm [0.002, 0.009]), narrower segmental airway lumen diameter (-0.049 [-0.088, -0.011]), lower FEV1 percent predicted (-1.92 percentage points [-2.72, -1.12]), and higher odds of wheezing (OR [95% CI]: 1.16 [1.02, 1.31]) and dyspnea (1.22 [1.05, 1.42]). Associations were similar after further adjustment for PAT and across ITAT quintiles. In contrast, PAT was not independently associated with airway structural measures after adjustment for ITAT. Conclusion: Higher ITAT volume was associated with greater airway wall thickness and narrower airway lumen, as well as lower FEV1 and greater respiratory symptoms, independent of central obesity and pericardial adiposity. These findings support a depot-specific association of ITAT with airway disease.
items.authors: Zhang, J.; Bosch, N. A.; Law, A. C.; Choi, S. H.; Wilson, K. C.; Dupuis, J.; Washko, G. R.; Cho, M. H.; O'Connor, G. T.
items.title_zh: 胸腔脂肪组织与气道结构、肺功能及呼吸症状的关系研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：肥胖与气道疾病相关，但特定胸腔脂肪储存的贡献尚不明确。本研究探讨了胸腔内脂肪组织（ITAT）与气道表型的关系。方法：纳入了具有CT测量的Framingham心脏研究参与者，使用多变量回归评估ITAT与CT基础气道壁和腔径测量、肺功能及呼吸症状的横断面关联。主要分析使用性别特异的ITAT z-score，并调整腰围以考虑中央肥胖。结果：在2825名参与者中（52.0%为女性），调整腰围后，每增加1个标准差的ITAT与更大的段支气管壁厚度（0.010 mm）和亚段支气管壁厚度（0.006 mm）、更窄的段支气管腔径（-0.049 mm）、较低的FEV1预测百分比（-1.92个百分点）以及更高的喘息（OR: 1.16）和呼吸困难（1.22）的几率相关。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，胸腔脂肪组织的增加与气道壁厚度增大、气道腔径变窄、肺功能下降及呼吸症状加重显著相关。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨胸腔内脂肪组织（ITAT）与气道结构、肺功能及呼吸症状之间的关系，尤其关注肥胖对气道疾病的影响。研究对象为参与Framingham心脏研究的2825名个体，其中52.0%为女性，所有参与者均进行了CT测量。研究采用多变量回归分析方法，评估ITAT与CT基础气道壁和腔径测量、肺功能及呼吸症状的横断面关联，主要分析使用性别特异的ITAT z-score，并调整腰围以考虑中央肥胖的影响。

结果显示，在调整腰围后，每增加1个标准差的ITAT与气道结构的变化显著相关。具体而言，ITAT的增加与段支气管壁厚度增加（0.010 mm）和亚段支气管壁厚度增加（0.006 mm）相关联，同时也与段支气管腔径的缩小（-0.049 mm）相伴随。此外，ITAT的增加还与肺功能下降相关，表现为FEV1（第一秒用力呼气量）预测百分比降低（-1.92个百分点）。在呼吸症状方面，ITAT的增加与喘息的几率增加（OR: 1.16）和呼吸困难的几率增加（OR: 1.22）也存在显著关联。

综上所述，本研究表明胸腔脂肪组织的增加与气道结构的改变、肺功能的下降及呼吸症状的加重密切相关，提示胸腔脂肪在肥胖相关气道疾病中的潜在作用。这一发现为理解肥胖对呼吸系统健康的影响提供了新的视角，并为未来的干预措施提供了依据。

items.title: Extracting smoking history from clinical notes for lung cancer screening decision support: comparing a structured-judgment model with general-purpose large language models
items.abstract: Objective: To compare the accuracy, cost, and speed of a low-cost, non-generative structured-judgment model and four general-purpose large language models (LLMs) for extracting smoking status, pack-years, and quit date from clinical notes to support lung cancer screening (LCS) clinical decision support (CDS). Materials and Methods: We built a synthetic, shareable benchmark of 3,000 outpatient notes in three conditions: 1,000 template-generated notes, 1,000 realistic, ``messy'' notes written by an LLM from structured facts, and 1,000 ``messy'' notes that required complex arithmetic to determine pack-years and quit dates. Ground truth reference labels were programmatically generated before each note was created. We compared TypeSafe Jev 1.13 with Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6 Sol, each using an identical structured output schema. We determined United States Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF) 2021 and American Cancer Society (ACS) 2023 eligibility from each system's output in code. Results: Jev made the correct eligibility decision for 99.1%, 99.9%, and 94.4% of notes in the three conditions, compared with 97.8%, 98.4%, and 98.1% for Haiku, 100.0%, 99.6%, and 99.8% for Sonnet, 99.7%, 98.8%, and 98.5% for Luna, and 100.0%, 99.8%, and 99.6% for Sol. In the complex condition, Jev produced 27 false positive and 14 false negative screening flags per 1,000 notes, the most of any system. Luna cost $0.12 to $0.21 per 1,000 notes and Jev $0.61 to $0.64, compared with $2.44 to $4.22 for Sol, $3.37 to $4.43 for Haiku, and $3.76 to $6.61 for Sonnet. Jev was the fastest system (median 0.45 to 1.21 seconds per note, compared with 1.71 to 3.50 seconds for the others). Discussion: All models tested had high accuracy. The structured-judgment model had the lowest latency, which could allow for synchronous use in clinical decision support systems rather than batched, cached invocation. The cost of the structured-judgment model was low, but the newest cost-efficient LLM, Luna, was less expensive and more accurate on the complex notes, though its latency was higher. Accuracy, latency, and cost are all moving quickly as new models are released. Conclusion: Fast, low-cost language models could make real-time, note-based CDS practical, and current models are highly accurate. Prices and capabilities are changing rapidly, so continuous benchmarking and system updates are essential.
items.authors: Wright, A.; Liu, S.; Wright, A. P.
items.title_zh: 从临床笔记中提取吸烟史以支持肺癌筛查决策
items.summary_zh: 目的：比较一种低成本、非生成性的结构化判断模型与四种通用大型语言模型（LLMs）在提取临床笔记中的吸烟状态、吸烟年数和戒烟日期方面的准确性、成本和速度，以支持肺癌筛查（LCS）临床决策支持（CDS）。方法：我们构建了一个包含3000份门诊笔记的合成基准，分为三种情况：1000份模板生成的笔记、1000份由LLM根据结构化事实生成的“杂乱”笔记，以及1000份需要复杂计算以确定吸烟年数和戒烟日期的“杂乱”笔记。结果：在三种情况下，Jev的正确筛查决策率分别为99.1%、99.9%和94.4%，而Haiku为97.8%、98.4%和98.1%，Sonnet为100.0%、99.6%和99.8%，Luna为99.7%、98.8%和98.5%，Sol为100.0%、99.8%和99.6%。在复杂情况下，Jev每1000份笔记产生27个假阳性和14个假阴性筛查标记。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，低成本的结构化判断模型在提取吸烟史方面的准确性与大型语言模型相当，有助于肺癌筛查决策的支持。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在比较一种低成本、非生成性的结构化判断模型与四种通用大型语言模型（LLMs）在提取临床笔记中吸烟状态、吸烟年数和戒烟日期的准确性、成本和速度，以支持肺癌筛查（LCS）临床决策支持（CDS）。研究构建了一个包含3000份门诊笔记的合成基准，分为三种情况：1000份模板生成的笔记、1000份由LLM根据结构化事实生成的“杂乱”笔记，以及1000份需要复杂计算以确定吸烟年数和戒烟日期的“杂乱”笔记。

在结果方面，Jev模型在三种情况下的正确筛查决策率分别为99.1%、99.9%和94.4%；Haiku模型的正确率为97.8%、98.4%和98.1%；Sonnet模型则表现出100.0%、99.6%和99.8%的准确性；Luna模型的正确率为99.7%、98.8%和98.5%；而Sol模型在三种情况下均表现出100.0%、99.8%和99.6%的高准确性。在复杂情况下，Jev模型每1000份笔记产生27个假阳性和14个假阴性筛查标记。

综上所述，研究表明，尽管不同模型在提取吸烟相关信息的准确性上存在差异，但整体上都能有效支持肺癌筛查的临床决策。尤其是Sonnet和Sol模型在各类笔记中的表现尤为突出，显示出其在临床应用中的潜力。这些结果为未来在肺癌筛查中利用人工智能技术提供了重要的参考依据。

items.title: Computational Linguistic Alignment in Psychosis from Semi-Structured Clinical Interviews
items.abstract: Background. Something in discourse with a person experiencing psychosis often "feels off" before formal assessment is completed, yet this phenomenon has not been quantified at the level of ongoing dyadic conversation. Prior work has largely treated patient speech in isolation, limiting our capacity to measure how communicative disruption emerges within clinical exchange. Methods. We applied a three-level decomposition of conversational alignment in 109 patients with psychotic disorders (26 female) and 60 healthy controls (22 female) at baseline and 12 months (n = 115). Register divergence captured lexical distance between interviewer and participant; embedding-based synchrony measured semantic trajectory coupling; within-speaker coherence was computed separately for each speaker. We used linear mixed-effects models adjusted for timepoint and participant clustering. Results. Patients showed significantly greater lexical-semantic divergence from the interviewer (d = 0.48, p < .001) and reduced embedding-based synchrony (d = -0.59, p < .001), both effects observed at each timepoint, consistent with a partially stable profile. Critically, the interviewer's within-speaker coherence was reduced during conversations with patients (d = -0.33, p = .016), indicating that the linguistic phenomenon of interest extended beyond patient speech to the interaction itself. Register divergence tracked impoverished thinking, while synchrony tracked disorganized thinking (both FDR-corrected q = .038). Conclusions. Conversational alignment in psychosis reveals a reconfiguration of dyadic semantic coordination, marked by reduced interviewer coherence despite preserved patient narrative continuity. These transcript-derived alignment metrics offer a scalable approach to quantifying interpersonal communicative function in routine clinical encounters.
items.authors: Olarewaju, E.; Voppel, A. E.; Meister, F.; El Mouslih, C.; Dzialoszynski, P.; PALANIYAPPAN, L.
items.title_zh: 精神病患者临床访谈中的计算语言学对齐研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：在与精神病患者的交流中，常常会感到某种“异常”，但这一现象尚未在双人对话层面量化。方法：我们对109名精神病患者（26名女性）和60名健康对照者（22名女性）进行了三层次的对话对齐分析，时间点为基线和12个月（n = 115）。使用词汇差异测量访谈者与参与者之间的词汇距离；基于嵌入的同步性测量语义轨迹耦合；每位发言者的内部一致性单独计算。结果：患者与访谈者之间的词汇-语义差异显著增加（d = 0.48, p < .001），基于嵌入的同步性显著降低（d = -0.59, p < .001），这两个效应在每个时间点均观察到，显示出部分稳定的特征。重要的是，访谈者在与患者对话时的内部一致性降低（d = -0.33, p = .016），表明这一语言现象超出了患者的言语，影响了互动本身。
items.l1_lead: 精神病患者与访谈者之间的语言对齐显著降低，表明患者的语言特征影响了对话的互动质量。
items.l2_summary:
在与精神病患者的临床访谈中，研究者们发现了交流中存在的“异常”现象，但这一现象在双人对话层面尚未得到量化。本研究对109名精神病患者（其中26名女性）和60名健康对照者（22名女性）进行了三层次的对话对齐分析，时间点为基线和12个月（n = 115）。研究采用了词汇差异测量来评估访谈者与参与者之间的词汇距离，并基于嵌入的同步性（embedding synchrony）来测量语义轨迹耦合，同时对每位发言者的内部一致性进行了单独计算。

结果显示，精神病患者与访谈者之间的词汇-语义差异显著增加（d = 0.48, p < .001），而基于嵌入的同步性显著降低（d = -0.59, p < .001）。这两个效应在每个时间点均被观察到，表明其具有部分稳定的特征。此外，访谈者在与患者对话时的内部一致性也显著降低（d = -0.33, p = .016），这表明这种语言现象不仅仅是患者言语的反映，还影响了互动的整体质量。

综上所述，本研究通过量化分析揭示了精神病患者与访谈者之间在语言交流中的显著差异，强调了这种差异对临床互动的潜在影响。这一发现为理解精神病患者的交流特征提供了新的视角，并可能为改善临床访谈的策略提供依据。

items.title: MULTIMODHAL: a multicenter phase 3 randomized controlled trial - fMRI-based symptom capture for guiding rTMS treatment of drug-resistant hallucinations in patients with schizophrenia.
items.abstract: Background: Auditory-verbal hallucinations (AVHs) often persist despite optimized antipsychotic regimens. While conventional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) at the T3P3 scalp site shows limited efficacy due to interindividual variability in AVH-related brain networks, the MULTIMODHAL trial assessed whether fMRI-guided rTMS is superior to conventional targeting for drug-resistant AVHs. Methods: This multicenter, double-blind, controlled trial enrolled 73 adults with drug-resistant AVHs, randomized to receive 10 sessions of active 1-Hz rTMS via either individualized fMRI-guided neuronavigation or conventional T3P3 localization. The primary outcome was the change in the Auditory Hallucination Rating Scale (AHRS) at one month post-treatment. Secondary outcomes included: patient-reported intensity and frequency, alternative severity scales, and AHRS follow-up at 3, 6, and 12 months. Mechanistic analyses assessed rTMS-induced electrical fields modeling, and baseline resting-state functional connectivity profiles. Results: fMRI-guided rTMS yielded a greater reduction in AHRS scores at one month (mean difference, -5.43; 95% CI, -8.92 to -1.94), with sustained benefits at three and six months. The number-needed-to-treat for neuro-guided rTMS was 3.5. Clinical response was associated with greater E-field overlap with AVH-related networks rather than energy deposition or baseline functional connectivity. Both interventions were well-tolerated. Conclusions: fMRI-guided neuronavigation significantly enhances rTMS efficacy for drug-resistant AVHs, with sustained benefits up to six months and a favorable safety profile. These findings emphasize that precise network engagement is more critical for neuromodulation success than stimulation intensity or resting-state connectivity. Study limitations include sample-size and progressive dropout after three months, warranting research on response predictors and maintenance strategies.

items.title_zh: MULTIMODHAL：多中心三期随机对照试验 - 基于fMRI的症状捕捉指导rTMS治疗耐药性幻听
items.summary_zh: 背景：听觉-语言幻觉（AVHs）在优化抗精神病药物治疗后仍常持续存在。传统的低频重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）在T3P3头皮位置的疗效有限，MULTIMODHAL试验评估了fMRI引导的rTMS是否优于传统靶向治疗耐药性AVHs。方法：本多中心双盲对照试验招募73名耐药性AVHs成人，随机接受10次活性1-Hz rTMS，采用个性化fMRI引导神经导航或传统T3P3定位。主要结果为治疗后一个月的听觉幻觉评分量表（AHRS）变化。次要结果包括患者报告的强度和频率、其他严重程度量表及3、6、12个月的AHRS随访。机制分析评估了rTMS诱导的电场模型和基线静息态功能连接特征。结果：fMRI引导的rTMS在一个月时AHRS评分显著降低（平均差异，-5.43；95% CI，-8.92至-1.94），并在三个月和六个月时持续获益。神经引导rTMS的治疗需求数为3.5。临床反应与AVH相关网络的电场重叠程度更大相关。
items.l1_lead: fMRI引导的rTMS治疗耐药性幻听显著优于传统方法，且在治疗后一个月及后续时间内持续有效。
items.l2_summary:
MULTIMODHAL试验是一项多中心、双盲的三期随机对照试验，旨在评估基于功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）引导的低频重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）对耐药性听觉-语言幻觉（AVHs）的治疗效果。尽管经过优化的抗精神病药物治疗，AVHs仍然在许多患者中持续存在，传统的rTMS在T3P3头皮位置的疗效有限，因此本研究探讨了fMRI引导的rTMS是否能够提供更优的治疗效果。

本试验共招募了73名成人耐药性AVHs患者，随机分为两组，分别接受10次活性1-Hz rTMS治疗，其中一组采用个性化的fMRI引导神经导航，另一组则使用传统的T3P3定位。主要结果指标为治疗后一个月的听觉幻觉评分量表（AHRS）变化，次要结果包括患者自报的幻觉强度和频率、其他严重程度量表以及3、6、12个月的AHRS随访数据。

结果显示，fMRI引导的rTMS在治疗后一个月时，AHRS评分显著降低，平均差异为-5.43（95% CI，-8.92至-1.94），并且在三个月和六个月时仍然保持治疗效果。神经引导rTMS的治疗需求数为3.5，表明其在临床应用中的有效性。此外，研究还发现，临床反应与AVH相关网络的电场重叠程度呈正相关，提示fMRI引导的个性化治疗可能通过更精准的靶向作用来改善患者的症状。

综上所述，MULTIMODHAL试验的结果表明，基于fMRI的rTMS治疗在缓解耐药性AVHs方面显著优于传统治疗方法，为未来的临床实践提供了重要的依据。

items.title: Spatial Accessibility to Hospital Capacity and the Concentration of Health-System Contributions in New Jersey
items.abstract: Background: Hospital consolidation increasingly places multiple hospitals under common system control. However, spatial accessibility estimates alone do not indicate whether that accessibility is distributed across many health systems or concentrated within a few. Methods: We used the enhanced two-step floating catchment area (E2SFCA) method to estimate tract-level spatial accessibility to staffed beds at general hospitals reachable within 30 minutes by car. For tracts with positive E2SFCA scores, we aggregated hospital contributions by health system and calculated a Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) from each system's share of the tract's total E2SFCA score. We used Spearman rank correlations to examine associations with tract-level sociodemographic characteristics. Results: Of 163 reachable hospitals, 94 were outside New Jersey and accounted for 62.7% of staffed beds among these hospitals. Across 2,172 tracts, mean and median E2SFCA scores were 1.98 and 1.99 staffed hospital beds per 1,000 population, respectively. Among 2,161 tracts with positive E2SFCA scores, mean and median HHI values were 0.36 and 0.31. Using 2.0 for E2SFCA and 0.18 for HHI as descriptive reference values, 934 tracts had E2SFCA < 2.0 and HHI [ ] 0.18, while 655 had E2SFCA [ ] 2.0 and HHI [ ] 0.18. For seven of eight sociodemographic characteristics, correlations with E2SFCA and HHI were in opposite directions. Conclusions: Considering E2SFCA and HHI together provides a community-level view of spatial accessibility and how that accessibility is distributed across health systems. This framework may inform assessments of hospital consolidation and proposed service or capacity changes. Keywords: Spatial accessibility; hospital consolidation; E2SFCA; health systems; Herfindahl-Hirschman Index
items.authors: Zheng, Y.
items.title_zh: 新泽西医院容量的空间可达性与健康系统贡献集中度
items.summary_zh: 背景：医院整合使多个医院在共同系统控制下运作，但空间可达性估计并不能表明这种可达性是分布在多个健康系统中还是集中在少数系统内。方法：我们使用增强的两步浮动捕捉区（E2SFCA）方法，估算可在30分钟车程内到达的普通医院的工作人员床位的区域级空间可达性。对于E2SFCA得分为正的区域，我们按健康系统汇总医院贡献，并计算每个系统在区域总E2SFCA得分中的份额的赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI）。我们使用斯皮尔曼等级相关分析考察与区域社会人口特征的关联。结果：在163家可达医院中，有94家位于新泽西州外，占这些医院工作人员床位的62.7%。在2172个区域中，平均和中位E2SFCA得分分别为每千人口1.98和1.99个工作人员床位。在2161个正E2SFCA得分的区域中，平均和中位HHI值分别为0.36和0.31。根据E2SFCA的2.0和HHI的0.18作为描述性参考值，934个区域的E2SFCA < 2.0且HHI < 0.18，而655个区域的E2SFCA ≥ 2.0且HHI ≥ 0.18。在八个社会人口特征中，有七个的E2SFCA和HHI的相关性方向相反。
items.l1_lead: 新泽西医院的空间可达性显示出明显的集中趋势，且与区域社会人口特征存在复杂的关联，提示健康系统的资源分布不均。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了新泽西州医院的空间可达性与健康系统贡献集中度之间的关系，特别关注医院整合对可达性的影响。随着多个医院在同一健康系统下运作，传统的空间可达性估计可能无法准确反映医院资源的分布情况。为此，研究采用增强的两步浮动捕捉区（E2SFCA）方法，评估了在30分钟车程内可达的普通医院工作人员床位的区域级空间可达性。

研究结果显示，在163家可达医院中，有94家位于新泽西州外，这些医院的工作人员床位占总数的62.7%。在2172个区域中，平均和中位E2SFCA得分分别为每千人口1.98和1.99个工作人员床位。在2161个E2SFCA得分为正的区域中，平均和中位赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI）值分别为0.36和0.31。根据E2SFCA的2.0和HHI的0.18作为描述性参考值，934个区域的E2SFCA < 2.0且HHI < 0.18，而655个区域的E2SFCA ≥ 2.0且HHI ≥ 0.18。这表明，在某些区域，医院资源的可达性较低且集中度较高。

此外，研究还分析了E2SFCA与区域社会人口特征之间的关系，发现八个社会人口特征中，有七个的E2SFCA和HHI的相关性方向相反。这一发现提示，医院资源的可达性与区域的社会经济状况可能存在复杂的互动关系，值得进一步研究。

综上所述，本研究揭示了新泽西州医院资源的空间可达性与健康系统贡献集中度之间的显著差异，强调了在评估医院资源分布时考虑区域社会人口特征的重要性。这些结果为优化医院资源配置和改善公共健康政策提供了重要的实证依据。

items.title: Behavioral profiles associated with adherence to adjuvant endocrine therapy in breast cancer: a retrospective population-based cohort study
items.abstract: Purpose: Adjuvant endocrine therapy (AET) substantially reduces recurrence and mortality in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer but requires sustained daily adherence over 5 to 10 years. Approximately one-third of patients fall short of recommended adherence in the first year alone, largely due to distinct combinations of attitudes, barriers, and circumstances. Existing studies have catalogued individual risk factors but lack the scale and breadth to characterize how these factors co-occur within patients, or to distinguish behavioral drivers from confounding by clinical and demographic context. We sought to characterize the behavioral and social heterogeneity underlying AET adherence in a national real-world cohort. Moving beyond population-average risk factors, we identify the distinct patient profiles, and the differing drivers within them, that any effective adherence strategy must address. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of US women with invasive breast cancer diagnosed between 2016 and 2025, linking two large-scale, individual-level datasets through privacy-preserving tokenization: Surgo Health's BehavioralPulse, which provides modeled individual-level behavioral and attitudinal risk scores together with consumer sociodemographic attributes, and longitudinal medical and pharmacy claims from a claims data provider. Eligible patients underwent 1 to 2 breast surgeries, initiated oral AET (tamoxifen or aromatase inhibitors), and maintained continuous insurance coverage for 365 days following therapy initiation. The primary outcome was adherence, defined as medication possession ratio (MPR) [ ]80% in the first year. Mixed-effects logistic regression with a random intercept for ZIP3 estimated adjusted associations across behavioral, sociodemographic, and clinical predictors. To characterize how behavioral factors co-occur within patients, we identified the most prevalent configurations of the statistically significant behavioral predictors and estimated their relative association with adherence, holding clinical and demographic factors constant. Results: The final cohort included 401,450 women, of whom 280,595 (69.9%) achieved MPR [ ]80%. Several behavioral factors were independently associated with adherence after adjustment for clinical and demographic covariates, including comfort following medication instructions (aOR, 1.15; 95% CI, 1.06-1.24), geographic proximity to breast oncologists (aOR, 1.17; 95% CI, 1.04-1.32), tangible instrumental social support (aOR, 1.06; 95% CI, 1.00-1.13), religiosity (aOR, 1.04; 95% CI, 1.01-1.08), concern about sexual side effects (aOR, 0.96; 95% CI, 0.93-0.99), and cost-related access barriers (aOR, 0.97; 95% CI, 0.95-1.00). The 10 most common configurations of significant behavioral predictors accounted for over 70% of the cohort, with the two most prevalent representing more than 40% of patients. The most common profile, defined by an absence of behavioral barriers and the presence of social support, was associated with a positive behavioral contribution to adherence propensity (behavioral linear predictor OR = 1.18; 95% CI: 1.04-1.36) comparable in magnitude to several established clinical predictors. Compared against this referent profile, six of the nine remaining profiles had lower adherence, with relative odds ranging from approximately 0.92 (95% CI: 0.89-0.95) to 0.97 (95% CI: 0.94-0.99). One profile, similar to the reference but including high trust in doctors, was associated with higher adherence odds (1.04, 95% CI: 1.01-1.07). These profiles arose from substantively different underlying combinations of factors: segments dominated by cost barriers, by side-effect concerns, or by limited social support produced comparable overall adherence risk but through distinct pathways. Conclusion: In this national cohort, nearly one-third of women did not achieve recommended first-year adherence to AET. The pathways to non-adherence were heterogeneous, structured into recurring behavioral profiles rather than randomly distributed across patients. This heterogeneity is clinically meaningful: patients with similar adherence risk may benefit from substantially different forms of support, ranging from financial navigation to side-effect management to social support resources. Surfacing this structure required linking individual-level behavioral data to large-scale claims data, offering a practical foundation for optimal design of patient-centered adherence interventions that are tailored to the specific configurations of barriers patients actually face.
items.authors: Dibner-Dunlap, A.; Sutermaster, S.; Smittenaar, P.; Sgaier, S.
items.title_zh: 乳腺癌辅助内分泌治疗依从性的行为特征研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：辅助内分泌治疗（AET）显著降低激素受体阳性乳腺癌的复发率和死亡率，但需要在5至10年内持续每日依从。约三分之一的患者在第一年内未能达到推荐的依从水平，主要由于态度、障碍和环境的不同组合。现有研究列出了个体风险因素，但缺乏规模和广度来描述这些因素在患者中的共现情况，或区分行为驱动因素与临床和人口背景的混杂。我们旨在描述国家真实世界队列中AET依从性的行为和社会异质性。方法：我们对2016至2025年间诊断为侵袭性乳腺癌的美国女性进行了回顾性队列研究，通过隐私保护的标记技术链接了两个大规模个体数据集。研究发现，患者的行为特征和驱动因素各异，任何有效的依从策略必须针对这些特征进行调整。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，乳腺癌患者在辅助内分泌治疗中的依从性受多种行为特征和社会因素影响，需针对性调整依从策略以提高治疗效果。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨乳腺癌辅助内分泌治疗（AET）依从性的行为特征，尤其是针对激素受体阳性乳腺癌患者。AET在降低乳腺癌复发率和死亡率方面具有显著效果，但患者需要在5至10年内每日持续服药。然而，约三分之一的患者在第一年内未能达到推荐的依从水平，这主要归因于患者的态度、面临的障碍以及环境因素的不同组合。尽管已有研究列出了个体风险因素，但缺乏足够的规模和广度来描述这些因素在患者中的共现情况，并且未能有效区分行为驱动因素与临床及人口背景的混杂影响。

为此，本研究对2016至2025年间在美国被诊断为侵袭性乳腺癌的女性进行了回顾性队列研究，利用隐私保护的标记技术将两个大规模个体数据集进行了链接。研究结果显示，患者的行为特征和驱动因素存在显著差异，因此，任何有效的依从策略必须针对这些特征进行调整。通过对真实世界数据的分析，研究揭示了影响AET依从性的多样性，为未来制定个性化的干预措施提供了重要依据。这一研究不仅为理解乳腺癌患者在接受AET过程中的行为特征提供了新的视角，也为改善患者的依从性和治疗效果奠定了基础。

items.title: Automated language impairment screening in acute stroke using connected speech
items.abstract: Connected speech is essential for everyday communication, but clinical constraints and patient fatigue limit detailed evaluation in acute stroke (<1-week post-stroke). Bedside assessments may sample discourse but rarely quantify language impairment (LI) in connected speech, leaving patient communication poorly characterized. We analyzed brief story retellings from 86 patients with left-hemisphere stroke (~4 days post-stroke; 63 classified with LI using composite clinical and naming criteria). From transcripts generated with automatic speech recognition, we derived discrete linguistic features and embeddings with Large Language Models (LLMs). An ensemble of embedding-based classifiers distinguished patients with and without LI with 90% balanced accuracy (79% sensitivity, 100% specificity), outperforming independent embedding and discrete-linguistic-based classifiers, showing distinct LLMs contributed complementary information. Adding the discrete-linguistic-based classifier to the ensemble did not improve balanced accuracy but modestly increased sensitivity at the expense of specificity. We provide proof of concept for a fast, largely automated discourse screener of acute LI.
items.authors: Pugalenthi, L. S.; Schnur, T. T.
items.title_zh: 急性中风患者的自动语言障碍筛查研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了86名左半球中风患者（约4天后），其中63名被归类为语言障碍（LI）。我们利用自动语音识别生成的故事复述文本，提取了离散语言特征和大型语言模型（LLMs）的嵌入特征。通过嵌入基础的分类器集成，我们以90%的平衡准确率（79%灵敏度，100%特异性）成功区分有无LI的患者，优于独立的嵌入和离散语言基础分类器，显示不同LLMs提供了互补信息。将离散语言基础分类器加入集成中未提高平衡准确率，但在特异性下降的情况下略微提高了灵敏度。我们提供了急性LI快速、基本自动化的语篇筛查的概念验证。
items.l1_lead: 本研究通过自动语音识别和大型语言模型成功实现了对急性中风患者语言障碍的高效筛查，显示出良好的准确率和特异性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究针对86名左半球急性中风患者（约在发病后4天）进行了自动语言障碍（Language Impairment, LI）筛查的分析，其中63名患者被诊断为存在语言障碍。研究采用自动语音识别技术生成的故事复述文本，提取了离散语言特征和大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）的嵌入特征。通过嵌入基础的分类器集成，研究团队成功实现了90%的平衡准确率，其中灵敏度为79%，特异性达到100%。这一结果显著优于单独使用的嵌入和离散语言基础分类器，表明不同的LLMs能够提供互补的信息。

在实验中，将离散语言基础分类器纳入集成并未显著提升平衡准确率，但在特异性略有下降的情况下，灵敏度有所提高。这一发现为急性语言障碍的快速、基本自动化筛查提供了概念验证，显示出利用自动化技术进行语言障碍筛查的潜力。研究结果不仅为临床实践提供了新的思路，也为后续相关研究奠定了基础，强调了多种语言特征结合使用的重要性。

items.title: Molecular Design and Interface Engineering of Self-Assembled Monolayers for Inverted Perovskite Solar Cells: A Data-Driven Review of Efficiency, Stability and Scalability
items.abstract: Self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) have become indispensable hole-transport layers in inverted perovskite solar cells which enables power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) above 27% in single-junction devices and above 32% in tandems where the tandem devices benefit disproportionately from SAM engineering with certified efficiencies exceeding 31%. In the review eight hypotheses have been proposed including the prediction that bisphosphonic acid SAMs will outperform monophosphonic acid SAMs in thermal stability, glycol ether side chains will improve both PCE and stability and machine learning can identify new SAMs with 27% PCE and 90% retention at 1000 h , the studied researches shows that carbazole-based SAMs with phosphonic acid anchoring groups dominate the field with Me-4PACz and MeO-2PACz . Co-SAM strategies that have hydrogen-bonding additives consistently improve PCE by (1–3)% absolute over single-component SAMs and that bisphosphonic acid anchoring groups are emerging as a way to improve thermal and damp heat stability. Operational stability under maximum power point tracking now exceeds 1000 h for optimized SAM systems though ISOS protocol adoption remains inconsistent.
items.authors: Soumyabir Guha
items.title_zh: 自组装单层在反向钙钛矿太阳能电池中的分子设计与界面工程
items.summary_zh: 自组装单层（SAMs）已成为反向钙钛矿太阳能电池中不可或缺的空穴传输层，使单结器件的光电转换效率（PCE）超过27%，而串联器件的效率超过32%。本综述提出了八个假设，包括双磷酸酸SAMs在热稳定性方面优于单磷酸酸SAMs，乙二醇醚侧链将改善PCE和稳定性，以及机器学习能够识别出PCE达到27%且在1000小时内保持90%效率的新SAMs。研究表明，以咔唑为基础的SAMs（如Me-4PACz和MeO-2PACz）在该领域占主导地位。共SAM策略通过氢键添加剂持续提高PCE（绝对提高1-3%），而双磷酸酸锚定基团正在成为改善热稳定性和潮湿热稳定性的一种方式。优化的SAM系统在最大功率点跟踪下的操作稳定性现已超过1000小时，尽管ISOS协议的采用仍不一致。
items.l1_lead: 自组装单层在反向钙钛矿太阳能电池中显著提升了光电转换效率，且通过优化设计和机器学习可进一步提高其稳定性和性能。
items.l2_summary:
自组装单层（Self-Assembled Monolayers, SAMs）在反向钙钛矿太阳能电池中扮演着至关重要的角色，作为空穴传输层，其应用使得单结器件的光电转换效率（Power Conversion Efficiency, PCE）超过27%，而串联器件的效率更是超过32%。本综述提出了八个假设，探讨了不同类型的SAMs在性能和稳定性方面的表现。其中，双磷酸酸SAMs在热稳定性方面被认为优于单磷酸酸SAMs，而乙二醇醚侧链的引入则有助于提升PCE和稳定性。此外，机器学习技术的应用也被认为能够识别出PCE达到27%且在1000小时内保持90%效率的新型SAMs。

研究发现，以咔唑为基础的SAMs（如Me-4PACz和MeO-2PACz）在反向钙钛矿太阳能电池领域占据主导地位。通过共SAM策略，研究者们利用氢键添加剂持续提高PCE，绝对提高幅度在1-3%之间。同时，双磷酸酸锚定基团的使用被视为改善热稳定性和潮湿热稳定性的一种有效方法。经过优化的SAM系统在最大功率点跟踪下的操作稳定性已超过1000小时，尽管在采用国际标准化组织（ISOS）协议方面仍存在不一致性。

综上所述，自组装单层在反向钙钛矿太阳能电池中的分子设计与界面工程研究，不仅为提升光电转换效率提供了新的思路，也为未来的材料开发和应用奠定了基础。

items.title: Response to Comment “Rethinking the Evidence for a Liquid–Liquid Transition in Water: What Decompression Experiments Reveal” [J. Chem. Phys. 164, 024506 (2026)]
items.abstract: Ultrafast decompression experiments on deeply supercooled water have been interpreted as showing long-lived coexistence of high- and low-density liquid. We reassess this interpretation by separating the timescales of pressure release, structural relaxation, crystallization, and heat exchange. The experimental trajectories are adiabatic, and under these conditions the two fitted WAXS components cannot represent equilibrium HDL and LDL persisting along a common thermodynamic path. We show instead that the spectra are consistent with a responsive liquid fraction evolving during decompression together with a structurally lagged, HDA-like fraction produced by heterogeneous heating. This framework also rationalizes the fluence dependence and clarifies the distinct information contained in the SAXS response. The analysis identifies which observables can provide decisive evidence for a first-order liquid–liquid transition and constrain the location of its critical point.
items.authors: Valeria Molinero, Rajat Kumar, Ingrid de Almeida Ribeiro, Debdas Dhabal

items.title: Topologically-constrained toehold-mediated strand displacement
items.abstract: Toehold-mediated strand displacement (TMSD) is regarded as the simplest mechanism through which synthetic nucleicacid nanosystems can be dynamically actuated and is central to applications in biosensing, molecular computing, data storage and retrieval, and synthetic biology. In these implementations, TMSD often occurs in topologically-confined configurations, with the toehold domain being linked to other elements that restrict its conformational freedom. However, the effect of topological confinement on the biophysics of TMSD remains largely unexplored. Here, we study TMSD in a simple, physiologically-encountered configuration in which the toehold domain is located in a DNA ‘bubble’, a region where the two strands of an otherwise continuous DNA duplex are dehybridised. We show that this topological confinement reduces the rate of TMSD by ∼1–3 orders of magnitude as a result of alterations to the TMSD free-energy landscape.
