A plating-limited current staircase reaches 80% state of charge in 22.9 min at 25 ◦C and 83 min at 0 ◦C, and the closed-loop controller needs 21.5 min without a constraint violation, against 28.0 min for the fastest constant current that respects the constraints. Verification against analytic solutions finds the particle solver second-order accurate in its concentration profile but first-order in the surface value that sets the voltage, a reported state of charge that exceeds the charge balance by up to 19.8 points because shells are averaged without volume weights, and a reversed sign in a kinetic term that is numerically negligible. Varying 9 shipped parameters together by a factor of 1.5 gives a 90% voltage band of ±50 mV at 1C, dominated by the positive particle radius and larger than both the discretisation error and the difference between the two electrolyte rungs; at 3C the choice of electrolyte closure outweighs every other source. That budget assumes its parameters reach the decisions a laboratory makes, and they do not: moving the solid diffusivity over two decades changes the delivered capacity at 3C by 34.8 points while leaving the plating limit, the staircase time, the controlled charge time and the least anode potential unchanged in every digit reported, because the charging model reads 2 cell parameters and the controller 2. Where the discharge rung does respond its capacity collapses onto the diffusion time R2/D to within 0.7 points, and because the particle equation is stepped explicitly, the regime of small particles and fast solid diffusion is the most expensive one to simulate. A grid convergence index shows the simulated voltage converging at first order, leaving the default particle grid 30.7 mV from the extrapolated voltage at 3C; polynomial chaos confirms the linear apportioning of variance, and Gaussian-process emulators predict the voltage to 0.8 mV from 100 runs, with no gain from choosing runs by predictive spread. Drawing the same design from a Sobol sequence rather than a Latin hypercube cuts the largest index error at 256 runs from 0.082 to 0.00022, and a reduced two-parameter problem mapped in full on 625 runs puts the sampled estimator within 0.004 of indices computed exactly. Gaussian splatting of simulated fields, implemented for this study, did not compress regular two-dimensional grids better than proper orthogonal decomposition but fitted scattered samples with an error of 9.97 mV against 14.55 mV for triangulation; in three dimensions, across rate and temperature, it beat both decomposition and interpolation. An adaptation of a recent densification strategy from rendering failed at the largest budget; splitting along the axis of largest field change and band-limiting the primitives to the sample spacing made it stable, with a median held-out error over 10 fits of 13.2 mV against 14.4 mV for residual-driven control. Extended to the vehicle, battery power determines only 5 of 6 longitudinal parameters: a physics-informed network fitted it from 8 starting points with the identifiable combinations within 1.9% of the truth, while the masses it returned ranged from 0.79 to 0.98 times the true value. Re-executing the 10 recorded runs from their stored inputs reproduced 9 bit for bit; the exception showed that a run’s code reference names a month, not a version. A physics-informed extreme learning machine, fitted for this study, solves the particle-diffusion problem to a surface-stoichiometry error of 1.2× 10−4 and passes an admission tolerance that the platform’s 14-shell solver fails; a gradient-trained network of the same form improves 21-fold on least squares with the same few fixed features but still fails that tolerance. Toward a digital twin, the suite’s estimator tolerates the drift of an ageing cell, but calibrating the particle diffusivity through the default grid misses it by −17.4%, against −0.5% through the verified surrogate. Governance made each finding checkable; verification made them visible.
items.authors: Siddhartha Pahari, Jainish Shailesh Solanki

items.title: A unique technology for creating thin gold layers inside medieval glass tesserae.
items.abstract: A unique technology, based on a chemical process that creates a thin layer of gold inside medieval glass tesserae, has been identified analysing physicochemical test results, within a project conducted by the Anna Langer Memorial Foundation. The samples studied are part of a collection of glass tesserae, discovered in the remains of the palatium of Duke Mieszko I in Poznań, by archaeologists from Adam Mickiewicz University, working under the direction of Prof. Hanna M. Kóčka
items.authors: Zofia Luklinska, Alina Pabisiak, Jerzy J. Langer

items.title: Judgment by agents, numbers by code: auditable automated speciation analysis towards a chemistry world model
items.abstract: Chemical speciation governs the reactivity, solubility, and toxicity of a solution, yet assembling speciation calculations from evaluated thermodynamic data remains a manual expert task whose reasoning is discarded once the figure is drawn. To mirror real-world research, automation belongs within a chemistry world model (CWM) where language agents curate and analyze data. As a first module, our agentic framework converts plain-language questions into deterministic equilibrium calculations grounded in NIST Standard Reference Database 46 (SRD-46). Agents resolve intent, curate records, adjudicate duplicates, design calculations, and estimate values beyond database coverage through induction-deduction-validation loops, while deterministic code validates every agentic commitment before it reaches the solver and compacts diagram topology into text readable without a vision stage. Across four case studies of escalating difficulty, quoted constants, patched records, and boundary coordinates reproduced their sources essentially exactly, whereas the same model without the framework missed phases or failed to build a solver. Residual errors surfaced only as auditable narration flaws, from misread topology to a sign-flipped hydrogen-evolution argument. The framework serves as a human-in-the-loop instrument delivering consensus-grade starting points, turning evaluated databases into active discovery instruments, mapping where language-model chemical reasoning still fails, and providing a general agentic template for finetuning.
items.authors: Yunkai Sun, Adwaith Ravichandran, Hassan Harb, Rajeev S. Assary, Brian J. Ingram, Zhenzhen Yang

items.title: Beyond the Kd Gate: Establishing Signal Causality in Electrochemical Aptasensors
items.abstract: Electrochemical aptasensors combine aptamer-based molecular recognition with electrochemical transduction, but a signal correlated with nominal target concentration alone does not establish aptamer–target binding. Target addition or matrix exposure may alter solution composition, reporter or mediator chemistry, nucleic acid behavior, surface organization, electron-transfer kinetics, interfacial integrity, or surface fouling without aptamer–target complex formation. The Kd gate addresses this upstream problem by requiring auditable, construct-matched verification of aptamertarget binding in homogeneous, non-denaturing solution under sensing-relevant conditions. Passing the gate, however, does not show that an immobilized construct retains recognition or that recognition causes the electrochemical response. We propose a sequential framework in which the Kd gate qualifies the recognition reagent, controlled surface measurements establish retained recognition, transduction measurements determine whether retained recognition generates a measurable response, and signalcausality controls establish whether that response depends on recognition. It distinguishes solutionphase Kd,sol, surface-associated apparent Kd,app, and device-response midpoint C50. It links controls to alternative response pathways and separates claim classes: target-correlated, recognition-linked, mechanistic or thermodynamic, and intended-use. Aminoglycoside and doxorubicin lineages illustrate why sequence conversion, truncation, reporter conjugation, and immobilization require reassessment of recognition and signal attribution. The framework should guide electrochemical aptasensor development with independently supported recognition and intended-use performance claims.
items.authors: Sergey N. Krylov, Philippe Dauphin-Ducharme, Paulo Roberto Bueno, Elena Ferapontova, Ilaria Palchetti

items.title_zh: 直接生成原型n-戊基过氧自由基揭示混合命运化学机制对产物分布的影响
items.summary_zh: 有机过氧自由基（RO2）是大气氧化中的关键分支点，在对流层中具有竞争命运：与NO反应、与HO2反应、自交叉反应及异构化。RO2通常在混合命运机制下反应，导致产物分布对反应条件的复杂依赖。在传统环境舱实验中，并非所有RO2命运均可获得，且有利于RO2自交叉反应和异构化的化学机制尚未得到充分表征。本文通过1-碘戊烷光解在环境舱中获取这些条件，利用NH4+化学电离质谱监测产物分布。我们通过改变初始条件调节这些反应路径的重要性，涵盖双分子寿命从约100-2000秒。在不同条件下，主要观察到的C5产物C5H10O3（产率约40-60%）至少需要一次RO2异构化才能形成，表明下游RO2单分子反应的重要性。模型机制部分再现了观察到的产物分布，但无法定量捕捉RO2命运变化的影响，差异表明RO2交叉反应对产物分布的影响尚不清楚。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，原型n-戊基过氧自由基的反应路径和产物分布受混合命运化学机制的复杂影响，强调了RO2异构化和交叉反应的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
有机过氧自由基（RO2）在大气氧化过程中扮演着关键角色，其反应途径具有复杂的竞争性命运，包括与NO反应、与HO2反应、自交叉反应及异构化等。RO2的反应通常遵循混合命运机制，这使得产物分布对反应条件表现出复杂的依赖性。然而，在传统的环境舱实验中，并非所有RO2的命运都能被充分获取，且有利于RO2自交叉反应和异构化的化学机制尚未得到深入表征。为了解决这一问题，本文通过1-碘戊烷的光解反应在环境舱中创造了相应的实验条件，并利用NH4+化学电离质谱监测产物分布。

研究中，通过调节初始条件，探讨了不同反应路径的重要性，涵盖了双分子寿命从约100到2000秒的范围。在不同的实验条件下，主要观察到的C5产物C5H10O3的产率约为40%至60%，这一产物的形成至少需要一次RO2的异构化，进一步强调了下游RO2单分子反应的重要性。尽管模型机制部分能够再现观察到的产物分布，但在定量捕捉RO2命运变化的影响方面仍存在不足，表明RO2的交叉反应对产物分布的影响尚未完全明了。

综上所述，本研究揭示了直接生成原型n-戊基过氧自由基的过程，并强调了混合命运化学机制在产物分布中的重要性，为理解大气化学反应提供了新的视角和数据支持。

items.title: eZacros: Kinetic Monte Carlo Simulations for Electrochemical Catalysis
items.abstract: Free energy diagrams rank electrocatalysts thermodynamically but do not resolve which elementary step limits the rate under operating conditions, or how the surface coverage that governs that competition is established. Lattice kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC) recovers both by treating elementary steps as stochastic events on an explicit lattice, but electrochemical kMC workflows remain far less standardized than the free-energy approaches common in computational electrocatalysis. Here we present eZacros, a framework that implements potential-dependent reaction energetics within the computational hydrogen electrode formalism, electrochemical Brønsted-Evans-Polanyi relations for activation barriers, and effective rate prefactors for charge-transfer steps. It is built on Zacros, a widely used kMC engine, and takes a compact Python input that specifies the lattice, the mechanism, and the energetics. We validate the implementation against an established microkinetic model of the oxygen reduction reaction on Pt(111), recovering its polarization curve and steady-state coverages. For hydrogen evolution, we sweep a single model definition over electrode potential and hydrogen adsorption free energy to generate activity, Tafel slope, and coverage maps. These resolve into a kinetic phase diagram in which no single rate-determining step characterizes the reaction across the full space: the boundaries between Volmer-, Heyrovsky-, and Tafel-controlled regimes are set by the steady-state coverage, which departs from equilibrium adsorption expectations under reaction conditions. eZacros makes potential-resolved kinetics accessible to anyone who can supply adsorption free energies and reference barriers, complementing free-energy screening in catalyst modeling and discovery.
items.authors: Esteban D. Gadea, Valeria Molinero
items.title_zh: eZacros：电化学催化的动力学蒙特卡洛模拟
items.summary_zh: 自由能图可以热力学地对电催化剂进行排序，但无法确定在操作条件下限制反应速率的基本步骤，以及决定竞争的表面覆盖如何建立。晶格动力学蒙特卡洛（kMC）通过将基本步骤视为显式晶格上的随机事件来恢复这两者，但电化学kMC工作流程仍远不如计算电催化中常见的自由能方法标准化。本文提出了eZacros框架，它在计算氢电极形式主义中实现了潜在依赖的反应能量学、电化学Brønsted-Evans-Polanyi关系以及电荷转移步骤的有效速率前因子。该框架基于广泛使用的kMC引擎Zacros，采用紧凑的Python输入，指定晶格、机制和能量学。我们通过与已建立的Pt(111)氧还原反应的微观动力学模型进行验证，恢复其极化曲线和稳态覆盖。对于氢气演化，我们在电极电位和氢吸附自由能上扫动单一模型定义，以生成活性、Tafel斜率和覆盖图。这些结果形成了一个动力学相图，其中没有单一的速率决定步骤能够表征整个反应空间。
items.l1_lead: eZacros框架通过晶格动力学蒙特卡洛模拟，提供了电催化反应速率的基本步骤和表面覆盖的动态理解，揭示了反应空间中复杂的动力学特征。
items.l2_summary:
本文介绍了eZacros框架，该框架旨在通过电化学动力学蒙特卡洛（kMC）模拟来研究电催化反应的基本步骤和表面覆盖的建立。尽管自由能图能够在热力学上对电催化剂进行排序，但它无法揭示在实际操作条件下限制反应速率的关键步骤以及竞争表面覆盖的形成机制。eZacros框架在计算氢电极反应中实现了潜在依赖的反应能量学、电化学Brønsted-Evans-Polanyi关系以及电荷转移步骤的有效速率前因子，填补了电化学kMC工作流程的标准化不足。

该框架基于广泛使用的kMC引擎Zacros，采用紧凑的Python输入格式，用户可以方便地指定晶格、反应机制和能量学。为了验证eZacros的有效性，研究者将其应用于已建立的Pt(111)氧还原反应的微观动力学模型，成功恢复了该反应的极化曲线和稳态覆盖情况。此外，在氢气演化反应中，研究者通过在电极电位和氢吸附自由能上进行单一模型的扫描，生成了活性、Tafel斜率和覆盖图。这些结果形成了一个动力学相图，表明在整个反应空间中没有单一的速率决定步骤能够全面表征反应过程。

通过这些研究，eZacros框架为电催化反应的动力学分析提供了新的工具和视角，推动了电化学催化领域的研究进展。

items.title: A Molecular View of Framework-Associated Zeolite Lewis Acid Sites: Linking Structure to Meerwein–Ponndorf–Verley Reactivity
items.abstract: The Meerwein–Ponndorf–Verley (MPV) reaction has been used to probe the Lewis acidity and local environment of aluminum Lewis acid sites (LAS) in zeolites and how these properties evolve upon post-synthetic treatments such as calcination and steaming. However, directly linking catalytic activity to proposed framework-associated aluminum LAS remains challenging because the identity of the catalytically relevant species is often inferred indirectly from correlations between spectroscopic signatures and reactivity. Molecular mimics of heterogeneous active sites can test hypotheses related to structure and reactivity, yet there exists few scaffolds capable of faithfully recapitulating the primary coordination environments in zeolites under demanding catalytically relevant conditions. In this work, we report a molecular model of a framework-associated (SiO)3Al LAS supported by a rigid, tridentate tris(siloxide) ligand derived from truxenone. The model complex is a competent and robust catalyst for MPV transfer hydrogenation of benzaldehyde with iPrOH, and density functional theory calculations support a pathway initiated by protonation of a supporting siloxide ligand by iPrOH. In contrast, a structurally related anionic Al−OH complex was found to be inactive under the same conditions. These observations suggest that framework-associated (SiO)3Al LAS can mediate MPV reactivity and provide a molecular basis for metal–framework cooperativity occurring at Lewis acidic aluminum sites in zeolites.
items.authors: Martin-Louis Y. Riu, Piper Szeliga, Tyler A. Kerr, Matthew Nava
items.title_zh: 框架相关沸石路易斯酸位点的分子视角
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了沸石中铝路易斯酸位点（LAS）的路易斯酸性及其局部环境，特别是在后处理（如煅烧和蒸汽处理）后的演变。通过Meerwein–Ponndorf–Verley（MPV）反应，我们建立了框架相关的(SiO)3Al LAS的分子模型，采用了来自truxenone的刚性三齿配体。该模型复合物在以异丙醇（iPrOH）为氢源的MPV转移氢化反应中表现出良好的催化活性，密度泛函理论计算支持了由iPrOH质子化支撑硅氧配体的反应路径。相比之下，结构相关的阴离子Al−OH复合物在相同条件下则未表现出催化活性。这些观察结果表明，框架相关的(SiO)3Al LAS能够介导MPV反应性。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，框架相关的(SiO)3Al路易斯酸位点在MPV反应中表现出良好的催化活性，而结构相关的阴离子Al−OH复合物则未能催化反应。
items.l2_summary: 本研究聚焦于沸石中铝路易斯酸位点（Lewis Acid Site, LAS）的路易斯酸性及其局部环境，特别是在经过后处理（如煅烧和蒸汽处理）后的变化。研究通过Meerwein–Ponndorf–Verley（MPV）反应，建立了框架相关的(SiO)3Al LAS的分子模型，并采用了来自truxenone的刚性三齿配体。该模型复合物在以异丙醇（isopropanol, iPrOH）作为氢源的MPV转移氢化反应中显示出良好的催化活性，表明其在催化反应中的有效性。密度泛函理论（Density Functional Theory, DFT）计算进一步支持了由iPrOH质子化支撑硅氧配体的反应路径，强调了框架相关的(SiO)3Al LAS在催化过程中的重要作用。相比之下，结构相关的阴离子Al−OH复合物在相同条件下未表现出催化活性，这一对比结果突显了框架相关LAS的独特催化能力。综上所述，研究表明框架相关的(SiO)3Al LAS能够有效介导MPV反应性，为理解沸石催化机制提供了重要的分子视角。

items.title: Molecular Dynamics Studies of Model Ionizable Lipids in an mRNA Vaccine
items.abstract: Effective COVID-19 mRNA vaccines encapsulate nucleoside-modified messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA), which encodes the prefusion-stabilized SARS-CoV-2 spike protein, inside lipid nanoparticles. Endosomal acidification motivates the study of ionizable-lipid protonation. Here, we isolate how protonation changes hydration, solvent preference, and structural organization of ALC-0315 in simplified model environments. Through molecular dynamics simulations, we identify clear protonationdependent differences in lipid orientation, hydration, and collective organization across three model systems. At a water/hexane interface, the protonated amine headgroup shows a stronger preference for the aqueous phase, reflecting enhanced interactions with water molecules. In 20-lipid assemblies, the protonated assembly remains more hydrated and aqueous-associated over the simulated trajectory, whereas the neutral assembly migrates toward and spreads along the water/hexane interface. In pure ALC-0315 bilayer simulations, protonation strengthens amine hydration and alters bilayerscale structural organization, with the observed morphology depending on the pressurecoupling protocol. Collectively, these findings demonstrate how protonation of ionizable amine headgroups can remodel ALC-0315 assemblies through strengthened lipid–water interactions. These simplified systems provide molecular-level insight into protonationdependent ALC-0315 behavior, while not directly modeling the full multicomponent LNP, the endosomal membrane, or mRNA release.
items.authors: Mohsen Farshad, Jayendran C. Rasaiah
items.title_zh: mRNA疫苗中可离子化脂质的分子动力学研究
items.summary_zh: 有效的COVID-19 mRNA疫苗将修饰的信使核糖核酸（mRNA）封装在脂质纳米颗粒中，编码稳定的SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白。内源性酸化促使我们研究可离子化脂质的质子化。本文探讨了质子化如何改变ALC-0315在简化模型环境中的水合、溶剂偏好和结构组织。通过分子动力学模拟，我们发现脂质取向、水合和集体组织在三种模型系统中存在明显的质子化依赖差异。在水/己烷界面，质子化的胺头基对水相表现出更强的偏好，反映出与水分子的增强相互作用。在20个脂质组装体中，质子化组装在模拟过程中保持更高的水合性，而中性组装则向水/己烷界面迁移并扩散。在纯ALC-0315双层膜模拟中，质子化增强了胺的水合并改变了双层膜的结构组织，观察到的形态依赖于压力耦合协议。这些发现表明，胺头基的质子化可以通过增强脂质-水相互作用重塑ALC-0315组装。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，mRNA疫苗中可离子化脂质的质子化显著影响其水合性和结构组织，增强了脂质与水的相互作用，从而重塑了脂质纳米颗粒的组装特性。
items.l2_summary:
本文研究了在COVID-19 mRNA疫苗中使用的可离子化脂质ALC-0315的质子化对其水合、溶剂偏好和结构组织的影响。mRNA疫苗通过脂质纳米颗粒封装修饰的信使核糖核酸（mRNA），以编码稳定的SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白。研究表明，内源性酸化促使对可离子化脂质的质子化进行深入探讨。通过分子动力学模拟，研究发现质子化对脂质的取向、水合性和集体组织在三种不同的模型系统中产生了显著的依赖性差异。

具体而言，在水/己烷界面上，质子化的胺头基对水相表现出更强的偏好，这表明其与水分子之间的相互作用增强。在20个脂质组装体的模拟过程中，质子化组装显示出更高的水合性，而中性组装则倾向于向水/己烷界面迁移并扩散。此外，在纯ALC-0315双层膜的模拟中，质子化不仅增强了胺的水合性，还改变了双层膜的结构组织，观察到的形态依赖于压力耦合协议。这些结果表明，胺头基的质子化通过增强脂质与水相互作用的能力，能够重塑ALC-0315的组装特性。

综上所述，本文的研究揭示了质子化对可离子化脂质在mRNA疫苗中的重要作用，强调了其在疫苗设计和开发中的潜在影响。通过深入理解脂质的行为，未来的疫苗开发可能会更加高效和精准。

items.title: Data-Efficient Machine Learning Potentials for Organic Reactions through Active-Learning-Guided Fine-Tuning
items.abstract: Transition states (TSs) are central to reaction barriers and mechanisms, yet their accurate localization remains computationally demanding. Reactive machine learning potentials can accelerate TS optimization by rapidly predicting potential energy surfaces, but achieving chemical transferability requires extensive sampling and quantum chemical (QC) labeling of reactive conformations. Here, we introduce an active-learning-guided fine-tuning strategy that couples pretrained chemical knowledge for broad generalization with adaptive labeling of informative reactive conformations for data efficiency. The resulting MACEPre-DeePEST-OS enables efficient TS optimization and barrier predictions across diverse organic reactions while requiring QC labeling for only ~2% of approximately 19 million candidate conformations. Across three in-distribution benchmarks, MACEPre-DeePEST-OS achieves an average root mean square deviation of 0.080 Å for TS geometries and a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.938 kcal/mol for barriers. In cross-dataset evaluation on an external OrgReact subset, fine-tuning reduces the barrier MAE by 58% relative to the pretrained model. Out-of-distribution testing on a Ugi reaction network containing structures with more than 70 atoms yields a barrier MAE of 1.09 kcal/mol, indicating transfer to molecular sizes and reaction complexity beyond the fine-tuning data. These results establish a data-efficient route toward transferable reactive potentials for quantitative analysis of reaction mechanisms and competing pathways.
items.authors: Kaipai Ren, Yujing Zhao, Kun Tang, Juntao Wang, Guangran Zhang, Qilei Liu
items.title_zh: 基于主动学习的有机反应数据高效机器学习势能模型
items.summary_zh: 过渡态（TS）是反应障碍和机制的核心，但其准确定位仍然计算上要求高。反应性机器学习势能可以通过快速预测势能面来加速TS优化，但实现化学可转移性需要广泛采样和量子化学（QC）标记反应构象。本文提出了一种主动学习引导的微调策略，将预训练的化学知识与信息性反应构象的自适应标记相结合，以提高数据效率。所得到的MACEPre-DeePEST-OS在多种有机反应中实现了高效的TS优化和障碍预测，仅需对约1900万个候选构象中的约2%进行QC标记。在三个分布内基准测试中，MACEPre-DeePEST-OS的TS几何平均均方根偏差为0.080 Å，障碍的平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.938 kcal/mol。在外部OrgReact子集的跨数据集评估中，微调使障碍MAE相较于预训练模型降低了58%。在包含超过70个原子的Ugi反应网络的分布外测试中，障碍MAE为1.09 kcal/mol，表明其可转移性超出了微调数据的分子大小和反应复杂性。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出的主动学习策略显著提高了有机反应中过渡态优化的效率，仅需对少量构象进行量子化学标记，且在多种反应中展现出良好的可转移性和准确性。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了一种基于主动学习的有机反应数据高效机器学习势能模型，旨在提高过渡态（Transition State, TS）优化的效率。过渡态是反应障碍和机制的核心，但其准确定位在计算上要求极高。为了加速TS的优化，反应性机器学习势能可以通过快速预测势能面来实现。然而，实现化学可转移性需要对反应构象进行广泛的采样和量子化学（Quantum Chemistry, QC）标记。

为了解决这一问题，研究者提出了一种主动学习引导的微调策略，结合了预训练的化学知识与信息性反应构象的自适应标记，从而提高了数据的效率。通过这一方法，所得到的模型MACEPre-DeePEST-OS在多种有机反应中实现了高效的TS优化和障碍预测。具体而言，该模型仅需对约1900万个候选构象中的约2%进行QC标记，便能取得显著的效果。在三个分布内的基准测试中，MACEPre-DeePEST-OS的TS几何平均均方根偏差为0.080 Å，障碍的平均绝对误差（Mean Absolute Error, MAE）为0.938 kcal/mol。

此外，在外部OrgReact子集的跨数据集评估中，通过微调，障碍的MAE相比于预训练模型降低了58%。在包含超过70个原子的Ugi反应网络的分布外测试中，障碍的MAE为1.09 kcal/mol，这表明该模型的可转移性超出了微调数据的分子大小和反应复杂性。这些结果表明，基于主动学习的微调策略在有机反应的机器学习势能模型中具有重要的应用潜力，能够有效提升TS优化的准确性和效率。

items.title: How Fast Does a Glass Forget? LandscapeConnectivity, Not Barrier Height, Sets the Rateof Memory Erasure under Repeated ThermalCycling
items.abstract: How fast a glass forgets its thermal history under repeated thermal cycling could be set by the height of its slowest barrier, by the number of relaxation channels it has, or by how those channels interconnect.We separate the three.Multi-scan calorimetry and industrial annealing and tempering all repeat a cooling and heating ramp many times, yet discrete-state models of thermal history have so far been driven through only a single pass.We build a 40-level master equation directly from the inherent-structure distribution of embedded-atom molecular dynamics of Cu 50 Zr 50 , so that level energies and degeneracies are measured rather than chosen, and drive it through many non-reset cycles.Because the dynamics are linear, one cycle is an exact map P n+1 = M P n whose second eigenvalue λ 2 is the fraction of the previous cycle's memory surviving one further cycle.It is the cycle-to-cycle counterpart of a structural relaxation time: -1/ ln λ 2 is the number of cycles needed to forget by 1/e, and dividing the cycle duration by -ln λ 2 converts it to seconds.In the atomistic system λ 2 = 0.73 to 0.81, that is 3 to 5 cycles, or 3.5 to 5.3 ns.Holding every barrier fixed and varying only connectivity, the cycles needed to forget fall by a factor of 77 without saturating, and one graph invariant, the effective resistance between the states a cycle must exchange population between, predicts the rate: |µ 2 | ∝ R -1.06 eff across six topologies and six turnaround temperatures (r = -0.996).A closed form, λ 2 = exp[-∮︁ |µ slow | dt], reproduces this to 0.07%.Cycling the atomistic system itself places the measured rate on the k = 3 prediction and excludes landscapes as densely connected as k ≥ 4. Connectivity, not the number of relaxation channels, sets how fast a thermally cycled glass forgets.
items.authors: Hicham Jabraoui, Said Ouaskit

items.title: Determining Which Phonons Affect Dynamic Disorder and Charge Mobility in Molecular Crystals
items.abstract: Organic semiconductors (OSCs), and especially molecular crystals, exhibit unique structural complexity and strong coupling between electronic and vibrational degrees of freedom. The strong electron-phonon coupling (EPC) localizes the charge carriers and limits the charge transport rate as a consequence of the dynamic disorder (σij). In principal, it should be possible to engineer new molecular crystals with reduced dynamic disorder, but determining which phonons contribute the most to dynamic disorder and what are the corresponding effects on charge transport has been elusive. Here, we propose the use of singular value decomposition (SVD) to study phonon modes within molecular crystals by transforming the original phonon modes (OMs) into a reduced set of ranked projected modes (PMs) that affect the EPC. The SVD phonon analysis reduces the number of modes to consider for phonon engineering while retaining the essential physical information which is validated with inelastic neutron scattering. This analysis shows that even the most significant PM for the selected molecules contribute at most 12-45% of the total dynamic disorder. That is, for none of the selected molecules is a single OM responsible for a large proportion of the dynamic disorder. Our results also identify the collective detrimental motions for charge transport by producing atomic displacement visualizations that reveal which atomic and molecular motions contribute to dynamic disorder. Finally, side-chain effects are probed by SVD phonon analysis; these are not usually considered in detail because the electronic coupling is carried exclusively by the conjugated backbone. Our results show that side-chain location and branching can alter the distribution of backbone vibrational states, harden high-energy backbone-involved motions, and couple side-chain motions to backbone dynamics, thereby indirectly affecting the extent of dynamic disorder. All of this supports the conclusion that SVD phonon analysis could be used as a robust phonon engineering tool to eliminate or generate specific features in a phonon spectrum, generating personalized design rules for next-generation OSCs.
items.authors: Chen-Wei Chiang, Toulik Maitra, Jeremy K. Mason, Adam J. Moulé
items.title_zh: 确定影响分子晶体动态无序与电荷迁移的声子
items.summary_zh: 有机半导体（OSCs），尤其是分子晶体，展现出独特的结构复杂性以及电子与振动自由度之间的强耦合。强电子-声子耦合（EPC）使电荷载流子局域化，并因动态无序（σij）限制电荷传输速率。理论上，可以设计出具有较低动态无序的新分子晶体，但确定哪些声子对动态无序贡献最大及其对电荷传输的影响一直难以捉摸。本文提出使用奇异值分解（SVD）研究分子晶体中的声子模式，通过将原始声子模式（OMs）转化为影响EPC的排名投影模式（PMs）集合。SVD声子分析减少了声子工程中需考虑的模式数量，同时保留了重要的物理信息，并通过非弹性中子散射进行了验证。分析结果表明，所选分子的最显著PM对总动态无序的贡献最多为12-45%。即，对于所选的分子，没有单一OM对动态无序的较大比例负责。我们的结果还通过原子位移可视化识别了对电荷传输有害的集体运动。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，通过奇异值分解分析声子模式，可以有效识别影响分子晶体动态无序与电荷迁移的关键声子，从而优化有机半导体的电荷传输性能。
items.l2_summary:
有机半导体（OSCs）特别是分子晶体，因其独特的结构复杂性以及电子与振动自由度之间的强耦合而受到广泛关注。强电子-声子耦合（EPC）会导致电荷载流子的局域化，并因动态无序（σij）限制电荷传输速率。尽管理论上可以设计出具有较低动态无序的新型分子晶体，但确定哪些声子对动态无序的贡献最大及其对电荷传输的影响一直是一个难题。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种使用奇异值分解（SVD）的方法来研究分子晶体中的声子模式。通过将原始声子模式（OMs）转化为影响EPC的排名投影模式（PMs）集合，SVD声子分析有效地减少了在声子工程中需考虑的模式数量，同时保留了重要的物理信息，并通过非弹性中子散射进行了验证。

分析结果显示，所选分子的最显著PM对总动态无序的贡献最多为12-45%。这表明，对于所选的分子，没有单一的OM对动态无序的较大比例负责，而是多个声子模式共同影响了动态无序的程度。此外，研究还通过原子位移的可视化识别了对电荷传输有害的集体运动。这一发现为理解分子晶体的电荷传输机制提供了新的视角，并为未来设计具有更优性能的有机半导体材料奠定了基础。

items.title: Controlling polyethylene fibrillation in PFAS-free dry electrodes for processability and electrochemical performance
items.abstract: Ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) is a more sustainable binder alternative to polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) for producing PFAS-free Li-ion battery electrodes using a solvent-free PE fibrillation process. We show that PE fibrillation is thermo-activated and can be controlled to produce an extensive network of nano-fibrils with a median size of 20-40 nm. PE-containing graphite electrode ultimate tensile strength (UTS), critical for roll-to-roll processing, improved more than 20-fold when the electrode calendering temperature increased from 100 to 160-200 °C, providing mechanical stability superior to equivalent PTFE-containing electrodes. PE-containing electrodes calendered at lower temperatures (120-140 °C) showed comparable charging rate performance but superior capacity retention of ∼90% after 100 cycles when compared with PTFE-containing electrodes. Removing PTFE by calcination to mimic direct recycling required temperatures 600 °C and led to PFAS emissions. In contrast, PE removal was PFAS-free and achieved at 300-400 °C, aided by the catalytic effect of graphite on PE decomposition making PE-containing electrodes more suitable with direct recycling. Overall, integrating across fabrication, mechanical, electrochemical and end-of-life considerations, PE-containing electrodes offer significant potential for more sustainable solvent-free Li-ion batteries.
items.authors: Guillaume Matthews, Benjamin Meyer, Noël Hallemans, Wenjia Du, Paul Shearing, Patrick S. Grant
items.title_zh: 控制无PFAS干电极中聚乙烯纤维化以提升加工性和电化学性能
items.summary_zh: 超高分子量聚乙烯（UHMWPE）作为无PFAS锂离子电池电极的可持续粘合剂替代聚四氟乙烯（PTFE），采用无溶剂的聚乙烯纤维化工艺。研究表明，聚乙烯纤维化是热激活的，可以控制产生中位尺寸为20-40纳米的纳米纤维网络。当电极压延温度从100°C提高到160-200°C时，含聚乙烯的石墨电极的极限抗拉强度（UTS）提高了20倍以上，提供了优于相应PTFE电极的机械稳定性。压延温度较低（120-140°C）的聚乙烯电极在充电速率性能上表现相当，但在100个循环后容量保持率达到约90%，优于PTFE电极。通过600°C的焙烧去除PTFE以模拟直接回收会导致PFAS排放，而聚乙烯的去除在300-400°C下进行，无PFAS排放，并且石墨对聚乙烯分解的催化作用使得含聚乙烯电极更适合直接回收。总体而言，综合考虑制造、机械、电化学和生命周期，含聚乙烯电极在无溶剂锂离子电池中具有显著的可持续潜力。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，采用无PFAS的聚乙烯作为锂离子电池电极粘合剂，能显著提升电极的机械稳定性和电化学性能，展现出良好的可持续性。
items.l2_summary:
超高分子量聚乙烯（UHMWPE）作为无PFAS（无聚氟烷基物质）锂离子电池电极的可持续粘合剂，展现出优于传统聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）的加工性和电化学性能。研究采用无溶剂的聚乙烯纤维化工艺，发现聚乙烯纤维化是热激活的，能够控制生成中位尺寸为20-40纳米的纳米纤维网络。通过调节电极压延温度，研究表明，当温度从100°C提升至160-200°C时，含聚乙烯的石墨电极的极限抗拉强度（UTS）提高了20倍以上，显示出优于相应PTFE电极的机械稳定性。此外，在较低的压延温度（120-140°C）下，聚乙烯电极在充电速率性能上表现相当，但在经历100个循环后，其容量保持率达到约90%，明显优于PTFE电极。

在回收方面，通过600°C的焙烧去除PTFE会导致PFAS的排放，而聚乙烯的去除则可在300-400°C下进行，且不会产生PFAS排放。石墨对聚乙烯分解的催化作用使得含聚乙烯电极更适合直接回收。综合考虑制造过程、机械性能、电化学性能及生命周期，含聚乙烯电极在无溶剂锂离子电池中展现出显著的可持续潜力，成为未来电池材料研究的重要方向。

items.title: Fractal Colonization of Prebiotic Niches: Mechanical Budding of Nano-vesicles and Kinetic Resource Depletion as an Oncological Atavism
items.abstract: Periodic mechanical forcing of the early Earth, from lunar tides (period of about 10 h) and radiogenic geysers (about 15 min) to von Kármán vortex shedding (about 1 s), may have loaded fatty-acid protocell membranes on time scales comparable to their relaxation times. We present a minimal model in which the tension of a parent vesicle, relaxing with time constant τ under rectified periodic forcing, releases one nano-vesicle at each upward crossing of a budding threshold. The shed nano-vesicles deplete the free fatty-acid pool of the surrounding niche through a non-linear sink bounded by the critical micelle concentration (CMC). The depletion equation has an exact solution between shedding events, and numerical integration with illustrative parameters shows that the discrete, tension-gated release produces a staircase of quasi-steady monomer levels that the pool follows towards the CMC. We discuss a matching window fτ = O(1) as a possible paleophysical selection criterion and, as a hypothesis not tested here, an analogy with vesicle-mediated nutrient competition in tumour niches.
items.authors: Peter Mikuláš

items.title: Exploration of Structure–Activity Relationships and Gut Restriction in Anti-Cryptosporidium Triazolopyridazine Series
items.abstract: Cryptosporidiosis is a major cause of diarrheal disease worldwide, particularly in young children and immunocompromised individuals, yet effective therapeutic options remain limited. Previously, the triazolopyridazine derivative SLU-10482 was identified as a potent anti-Cryptosporidium lead, but it suffers from modest affinity for the hERG ion channel. In the present study, structure–activity relationships (SAR) were investigated through systematic modification of the 3-position of the aryl ring and by designing gutrestricted analogues intended to reduce systemic exposure while maintaining antiparasitic activity. A diverse library of analogues was synthesized using amide coupling, Sonogashira, Suzuki, and Buchwald–Hartwig cross-coupling reactions, followed by hydrogenation and late-stage functional group transformations to access alkynyl, alkyl, tertiary amine, quaternary ammonium, and substituted aryl derivatives. Compounds were evaluated for anti-Cryptosporidium parvum activity in infected HCT-8 cells. SAR studies revealed that smaller, less polar substituents at the 3-position were generally associated with improved potency, whereas increasing substituent size and polarity resulted in diminished activity, although several larger polar analogues retained measurable potency. To develop gut-restricted agents, molecular weight, polarity, and conformational flexibility were intentionally increased to reduce intestinal permeability and systemic exposure. While these modifications were expected to preserve local intestinal activity, the resulting analogues exhibited substantially reduced antiparasitic potency. Because the molecular target of this chemotype remains unknown, the observed loss of activity may arise from reduced target engagement, impaired penetration across the parasite membrane barriers, or a combination of both.
items.authors: Antonio Giardina, Caitlin E. Hamill, Gregory M. Giovine, José Teixeira, Edmund Oboh, Soumitra Guin
items.title_zh: 抗隐孢子虫三唑吡啶并噁唑系列的结构-活性关系研究
items.summary_zh: 隐孢子虫病是全球主要的腹泻病因，尤其在幼儿和免疫缺陷者中更为严重，现有有效治疗选择有限。研究中，三唑吡啶并噁唑衍生物SLU-10482被发现具有良好的抗隐孢子虫活性，但其对hERG离子通道的亲和力较低。通过系统性修改芳环3位的取代基，并设计肠道限制类药物以降低全身暴露，同时保持抗寄生虫活性，进行了结构-活性关系（SAR）研究。合成了多样的类药物库，并评估其在感染HCT-8细胞中的抗隐孢子虫活性。结果显示，3位较小、极性较低的取代基通常与增强的活性相关，而增大取代基的大小和极性则导致活性降低，尽管一些较大极性类药物仍保持可测量的活性。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，三唑吡啶并噁唑衍生物SLU-10482对抗隐孢子虫有效，且通过优化芳环3位取代基可增强活性，同时降低对hERG离子通道的亲和力。
items.l2_summary:
隐孢子虫病是全球范围内导致腹泻的重要病因，尤其在幼儿和免疫缺陷者中表现得尤为严重，目前有效的治疗选择相对有限。在这一背景下，研究者们对三唑吡啶并噁唑（triazolopyridine oxazole）系列化合物进行了结构-活性关系（SAR）研究，重点关注其抗隐孢子虫活性。研究中，三唑吡啶并噁唑衍生物SLU-10482被发现具有良好的抗隐孢子虫活性，但其对hERG离子通道的亲和力较低，这一特性可能影响其临床应用。

为进一步优化该化合物的活性，研究团队系统性地修改了芳环3位的取代基，并设计了肠道限制类药物，以降低全身暴露，同时保持其抗寄生虫活性。通过合成多样的类药物库，研究者们评估了这些化合物在感染HCT-8细胞中的抗隐孢子虫活性。结果表明，3位较小且极性较低的取代基通常与增强的抗隐孢子虫活性相关，而增大取代基的大小和极性则导致活性降低。尽管如此，研究中也发现一些较大极性的类药物仍然保持可测量的活性。

这一研究不仅为抗隐孢子虫药物的开发提供了新的思路，也为理解其结构-活性关系奠定了基础，显示出通过合理设计取代基可以有效提升药物的活性和安全性。这些发现为未来的药物开发提供了重要的参考，尤其是在针对隐孢子虫病的治疗策略上。

items.title: Chiral Patterning Drives Peptide Coacervate Formation in Coarse-Grained SIRAH Simulations
items.abstract: Peptide-based polyelectrolyte complexes (PECs) are a promising class of stimuli-responsive materials with applications in drug delivery. Yet, the molecular mechanism by which stereochemical patterning governs their phase behavior remains unresolved. Racemic chiral patterning is known to favor liquid coacervate formation over solid precipitation by disrupting the ordered β-sheet structure, but experimentally elucidating the molecular-level origin of the solution-phase selection remains challenging. Coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics simulations offer a practical route to accessing the time and length scales relevant to coacervate phase behavior but require force fields that capture sequence-dependent structural propensities. One of them is chirality, a capability that has not previously been validated for peptide-based PEC systems. Here, we expand the SIRAH CG force field for modeling chirally and hydrophobically patterned peptide-based PEC systems. By introducing D-chiral dihedral parameters, achieved by inverting the phase angles of the SIRAH backbone torsion potential, we simulate both racemic and homochiral variants of six model PEC systems and compare the results to microsecond atomistic C36m simulations and published FTIR secondary structure data. The racemic SIRAH model reproduces atomistic trends in peptide compaction, aggregate density, and interfacial structure, as assessed by radius of gyration distributions, radial density profiles, and hyperbolic-tangent fits to the droplet interface. Racemic systems exhibit higher backbone contact counts and greater peptide compaction than their homochiral counterparts, consistent with the formation of dense, disordered aggregates characteristic of the liquid coacervate phase, where chains maintain close contact without adopting long-range β-sheet order. These results provide molecular-level support for the macroscopic observation that racemic patterning favors coacervate over precipitate formation, and reveal that alternating chirality promotes compact, entangled chain conformations that satisfy backbone hydrogen bonding outside of canonical β-sheet structures rather than simply eliminating it, a mechanism beyond β-sheet disruption alone. Hydrophobicity-dependent trends in secondary structure and solvent exposure are well reproduced regardless of chiral patterning, establishing SIRAH as a viable framework for peptide-based coacervate simulations and identifying stereochemical patterning as an independent sequence-specific route for tuning coacervate density. Because the SIRAH protein and nucleic acid parameters were derived within a single, structurally consistent framework, the same approach extends naturally to peptide–nucleic acid complex coacervates, an assembly class of growing interest for delivery applications and one that few coarse-grained force fields can treat at backbone-level resolution.
items.authors: Tania Rajpersaud, Tahoora Ateeq, Lorraine Leon, Sergio Pantano, Sharon Loverde
items.title_zh: 手性图案驱动肽共聚体在粗粒化SIRAH模拟中的形成
items.summary_zh: 肽基聚电解质复合物（PECs）是一类有前景的刺激响应材料，广泛应用于药物传递。然而，手性图案如何影响其相行为的分子机制尚未解决。已知外消旋手性图案通过破坏有序的β-折叠结构，促进液态共聚体的形成而非固态沉淀，但在实验上阐明溶液相选择的分子级起源仍具挑战性。粗粒化分子动力学模拟为研究共聚体相行为提供了实用途径，但需要捕捉序列依赖性结构倾向的力场。本文扩展了SIRAH粗粒化力场，以建模手性和疏水性图案的肽基PEC系统。通过引入D-手性二面角参数，模拟了六个模型PEC系统的外消旋和同手性变体，并将结果与微秒级原子模拟和已发布的FTIR二级结构数据进行了比较。外消旋SIRAH模型再现了肽的紧凑性、聚集密度和界面结构的原子趋势。
items.l1_lead: 手性图案通过影响肽基聚电解质复合物的相行为，促进液态共聚体的形成，粗粒化SIRAH模拟为理解其分子机制提供了有效工具。
items.l2_summary:
肽基聚电解质复合物（PECs）是一类具有广泛应用潜力的刺激响应材料，尤其在药物传递领域表现出色。然而，手性图案对其相行为的影响及其分子机制仍未得到充分理解。研究表明，外消旋手性图案通过破坏有序的β-折叠结构，促进液态共聚体的形成，而非固态沉淀。然而，实验上阐明溶液相选择的分子级起源仍然面临挑战。为了解决这一问题，粗粒化分子动力学模拟成为研究共聚体相行为的有效工具，但这需要捕捉序列依赖性结构倾向的力场。

为此，本文扩展了SIRAH（Simplified Interaction Model for Amino Acids and Peptides）粗粒化力场，以建模手性和疏水性图案的肽基PEC系统。研究中引入了D-手性二面角参数，模拟了六个模型PEC系统的外消旋和同手性变体，并将模拟结果与微秒级的原子模拟及已发布的FTIR（傅里叶变换红外光谱）二级结构数据进行了比较。结果显示，外消旋SIRAH模型成功再现了肽的紧凑性、聚集密度和界面结构的原子趋势，这表明该模型在捕捉手性图案对肽基PEC相行为影响方面的有效性。

通过这些研究，本文为理解手性图案在肽基PECs中的作用提供了新的视角，并为未来的材料设计和应用奠定了基础。这一成果不仅丰富了对肽基聚电解质复合物的理论认识，也为相关领域的实验研究提供了重要的参考。

items.title: Understanding Differential Chemical Activities of Eutectic Gallium Indium (eGaIn) Thin Films with Fluorinated Analytes using Raman Spectroscopy
items.abstract: Gallium oxide (Ga2O3) forms on the surface of eutectic gallium indium (eGaIn) alloy in air; In the presence of water, it transforms to gallium oxide monohydroxide, GaO(OH). During such transformation, it is challenging to differentiate the activities of the oxides while adsorbing solutes from the solvent. Herein, we address this challenge by investigating the temporal evolution of eGaIn thin films during adsorption of dilute organofluorines in water. We identify five hours as the stability threshold to obtain a water-modified thin film. Leveraging both fresh and five-hour-modified films in parallel, we distinguish water-specific changes and differentiate the signals uniquely caused by fluorinated analytes. The modified GaO(OH) interface demonstrates increased hydrophilicity for microdroplet studies and structural stability under high-energy (20 kV) electron beam irradiation. We leverage Frontier Molecular Orbital (FMO) theory to predict that the GaO(OH) surface is also a reactive catalytic interface. In the presence of the GaO(OH) surface and UVA irradiation, short-chain (HFBA) and long-chain (PFOA) fluorinated compounds exhibited altered interfacial activity. We leveraged Raman spectroscopy throughout our study to differentiate the in situ activities of Ga2O3 and GaO(OH). Our investigations will be useful for differentiating fresh and modified oxide dynamics during in situ interfacial studies or wet chemical measurements.
items.authors: Dechassa Terefe, Muhammad Shamim Al Mamun, Momena Monwar, Md. Tasmirul Jalil, Ryan C. Tung, M. Rashed Khan
items.title_zh: 利用拉曼光谱研究共晶镓铟薄膜的化学活性
items.summary_zh: 在空气中，共晶镓铟（eGaIn）合金表面形成氧化镓（Ga2O3）；在水存在下，它转变为氢氧化镓（GaO(OH)）。在此转变过程中，区分氧化物在吸附溶质时的活性具有挑战性。本文通过研究稀释有机氟化物在水中吸附过程中eGaIn薄膜的时间演变，解决了这一挑战。我们确定五小时为获得水改性薄膜的稳定阈值。通过并行使用新鲜和五小时改性薄膜，我们区分了水特异性变化，并识别了氟化分析物引起的独特信号。改性GaO(OH)界面在微滴研究中表现出更强的亲水性，并在高能（20 kV）电子束辐照下保持结构稳定。我们利用前沿分子轨道（FMO）理论预测GaO(OH)表面也是一个反应性催化界面。在GaO(OH)表面和UVA辐照下，短链（HFBA）和长链（PFOA）氟化化合物表现出改变的界面活性。我们的研究将有助于区分原始和改性氧化物在原位过程中的动态。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，共晶镓铟薄膜在水中转变为氢氧化镓后，表现出更强的亲水性和反应性，且在特定条件下可有效区分其化学活性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于共晶镓铟（eGaIn）薄膜的化学活性，特别是在不同环境条件下其表面氧化物的转变及其对溶质吸附的影响。在空气中，eGaIn合金表面会形成氧化镓（Ga2O3），而在水的存在下则转变为氢氧化镓（GaO(OH)）。这一转变过程中的氧化物活性区分是一个挑战。为了解决这一问题，研究者通过观察稀释有机氟化物在水中吸附时eGaIn薄膜的时间演变，发现五小时是获得水改性薄膜的稳定阈值。通过并行使用新鲜和经过五小时改性的薄膜，研究者能够区分水特异性变化，并识别出氟化分析物引起的独特信号。

改性后的GaO(OH)界面在微滴研究中展现出更强的亲水性，并在高能（20 kV）电子束辐照下保持了结构的稳定性。此外，研究利用前沿分子轨道（FMO）理论预测了GaO(OH)表面作为反应性催化界面的潜力。在GaO(OH)表面与UVA辐照的条件下，短链（HFBA）和长链（PFOA）氟化化合物的界面活性发生了显著变化。这些发现为区分原始和改性氧化物在原位过程中的动态提供了重要的实验依据，进一步推动了对eGaIn薄膜在不同环境下化学活性的理解。整体而言，本研究为理解和应用改性氧化物在催化和环境科学中的潜力奠定了基础。

items.title: Ferrier Rearrangement Intermediates Featuring Aliphatic Acyl Protecting Groups
items.abstract: The Ferrier rearrangement of 1,2-unsaturated monosaccharides (glycals) to 2,3-unsatured glycosides, is important for the synthesis of pharmaceuticals and natural products. Mechanistically, the nucleophilic substitution proceeds via a cationic intermediate, the “Ferrier cation”, whose structure is difficult to capture with conventional analytical techniques. Here, we characterize the Ferrier cations of glucal and galactal building blocks involving aliphatic acyl protecting groups (pivaloyl-, levulinoyl- and chloroacetyl esters) using cryogenic gas-phase infrared spectroscopy. Comparing experimental and computed spectra of candidate structures, we established that all intermediates are stabilized by interactions of the C4 acyl protecting group with the C3 carbon of the pyranose ring (neighboring participation), potentially steering the stereochemical outcome of the Ferrier rearrangement. The resulting C4-C3-dioxolenium ion structure appears to be general to aliphatic acyl protecting groups, contributing to our fundamental understanding of Ferrier rearrangement reactions.
items.authors: Niklas Geue, Kim Greis, Sabrina Omoregbee-Leichnitz, Carla Kirschbaum, Julinton Sianturi, Shenchuang Wang
items.title_zh: 含脂肪族酰基保护基的Ferrier重排中间体研究
items.summary_zh: 1,2-不饱和单糖（糖醇）的Ferrier重排生成2,3-不饱和糖苷，对药物和天然产物的合成至关重要。该反应机制中，亲核取代通过阳离子中间体“Ferrier阳离子”进行，其结构难以用传统分析技术捕捉。本文利用低温气相红外光谱表征了涉及脂肪族酰基保护基（如pivaloyl、levulinoyl和chloroacetyl酯）的glucal和galactal构建块的Ferrier阳离子。通过比较实验和计算的候选结构光谱，我们发现所有中间体均通过C4酰基保护基与吡喃环C3碳的相互作用（邻近参与）得到稳定，这可能影响Ferrier重排的立体化学结果。最终得到的C4-C3-二噁烯离子结构似乎对脂肪族酰基保护基具有普遍性，增进了我们对Ferrier重排反应的基础理解。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，脂肪族酰基保护基通过与Ferrier阳离子中间体的相互作用稳定反应结构，影响Ferrier重排的立体化学结果，增进对该反应机制的理解。
items.l2_summary:
本文研究了含脂肪族酰基保护基的Ferrier重排中间体，重点关注1,2-不饱和单糖（糖醇）在Ferrier重排反应中生成2,3-不饱和糖苷的机制。Ferrier重排反应在药物和天然产物的合成中具有重要意义，其反应机制涉及通过阳离子中间体“Ferrier阳离子”进行的亲核取代。然而，由于Ferrier阳离子的结构难以通过传统分析技术捕捉，研究者们采用了低温气相红外光谱技术对涉及脂肪族酰基保护基（如pivaloyl、levulinoyl和chloroacetyl酯）的glucal和galactal构建块的Ferrier阳离子进行了表征。

通过对实验和计算的候选结构光谱进行比较，研究发现所有中间体的稳定性均依赖于C4酰基保护基与吡喃环C3碳之间的相互作用（邻近参与），这一发现可能对Ferrier重排的立体化学结果产生影响。最终得到的C4-C3-二噁烯离子结构显示出对脂肪族酰基保护基的普遍适用性，进一步增进了我们对Ferrier重排反应基础机制的理解。这项研究不仅为Ferrier重排反应提供了新的视角，也为相关化学反应的优化和应用奠定了基础。

items.title: StateFlux: Physically Validated Quantum Metabolic State Networks Reveal Limited Incremental Value for Toxicity Prediction
items.abstract: Mechanistic molecular representations are increasingly proposed as a route to improve toxicity prediction by supplementing parent structure with protonation, metabolism, and quantum-chemical reactivity. Whether those physically richer representations provide predictive information that is genuinely orthogonal to molecular structure remains uncertain. Here, StateFlux represents each drug as a network of chemical and predicted metabolic states with node-level GFN2-xTB properties and edge-resolved changes in ionization potential, electron affinity, electrophilicity, solvation, and local reactivity. On a locked DILIrank 2.0 development set (n = 376; 156 DILI-positive and 220 DILI-negative compounds), 10 × 5 scaffold validation gave AUROC/AUPRC values of 0.8249/0.7727 for ECFP, 0.8049/0.7430 for ECFP + FluxCore, and 0.8010/0.7261 for ECFP + StateFluxCore. The FluxCore AUROC decrement relative to ECFP was -0.0199 (95% paired-bootstrap CI, -0.0341 to -0.0072). Strict temporal and scaffold-novel tests likewise showed no consistent advantage, and an independent 5,367-compound genotoxicity benchmark reproduced the result (AUROC 0.7765 for ECFP versus 0.7732 for StateFluxCore). To distinguish limited predictive utility from inaccurate low-cost quantum chemistry, 24 parent-to-metabolite transformations were re-evaluated with 144 ωB97X-D/6-31+G*/SMD single-point calculations. GFN2-xTB closely tracked DFT changes in electrophilicity (Pearson r = 0.963; MAE = 0.408 eV; 79.2% sign agreement). Thus, transformation-induced quantum reactivity can be physically meaningful without providing reliable incremental information for broad toxicity classification. These results argue that mechanistic fidelity and predictive utility should be validated separately when increasingly elaborate molecular representations are introduced into chemical machine learning.
items.authors: Aris Tsai
items.title_zh: StateFlux：物理验证的量子代谢状态网络对毒性预测的增值有限
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了机械分子表征在毒性预测中的应用，结合质子化、代谢和量子化学反应性。StateFlux将每种药物表示为化学和预测代谢状态的网络，节点具有GFN2-xTB属性，边缘则反映了电离势、电子亲和力、亲电性、溶剂化和局部反应性的变化。在DILIrank 2.0开发集中（n = 376；156个DILI阳性和220个DILI阴性化合物），10 × 5支架验证显示，ECFP的AUROC/AUPRC值为0.8249/0.7727，ECFP + FluxCore为0.8049/0.7430，ECFP + StateFluxCore为0.8010/0.7261。FluxCore相对于ECFP的AUROC下降为-0.0199，且严格的时间和支架新颖性测试未显示出一致优势。独立的5,367个化合物基因毒性基准也复现了该结果。
items.l1_lead: 本研究表明，StateFlux在毒性预测中的增值有限，且与传统ECFP方法相比，其性能未显示出一致的优势。
items.l2_summary: 本研究探讨了机械分子表征在毒性预测中的应用，重点关注质子化、代谢和量子化学反应性对毒性评估的影响。研究团队提出了StateFlux模型，将每种药物表示为一个化学和预测代谢状态的网络。在这个网络中，节点具有GFN2-xTB属性，而边缘则反映了电离势、电子亲和力、亲电性、溶剂化和局部反应性的变化。为了验证该模型的有效性，研究者在DILIrank 2.0开发集中进行了实验，样本量为376个化合物，其中156个为DILI阳性（药物性肝损伤）化合物，220个为DILI阴性化合物。通过10 × 5支架验证，研究发现ECFP（扩展连接指纹）模型的AUROC（曲线下面积）和AUPRC（精确率-召回率曲线下面积）值分别为0.8249和0.7727，而结合FluxCore的ECFP模型AUROC和AUPRC值为0.8049和0.7430，结合StateFluxCore的ECFP模型AUROC和AUPRC值则为0.8010和0.7261。相较于ECFP，FluxCore的AUROC下降了0.0199，且在严格的时间和支架新颖性测试中未显示出一致的优势。此外，独立的5,367个化合物基因毒性基准也复现了相似的结果。这些数据表明，尽管StateFlux模型在理论上提供了新的视角，但在实际应用中对毒性预测的增值有限，提示研究者在未来的毒性预测模型开发中需谨慎评估不同方法的实际效果。

items.title: Closing the Loop Between Synthetic and Living Cells
items.abstract: Synthetic cells are moving beyond compartmentalised microreactors to become integrated components of biological networks that physically and chemically merge with their hosts. Existing reviews classify this field by mode of emission, by chemistry, or by architecture, and so describe the construct rather than its effect. This review takes the receiver's side, treating the functional adaptation of the living host as the readout of bio-hybrid function: how living cells probe their synthetic partners mechanically and adapt to them metabolically. We consider the bio-hybrid interface by how far the feedback loop (sensing-actuation) is closed and set out the evidence that would place a study in each of four tiers: open-loop, half-loop, partial feedback, and closed-loop. Read against these criteria, fifteen of the eighteen studies surveyed here are half-loop, three reach partial feedback, and none is closed-loop. All three partial-feedback systems work the same way, by metabolic interception, which the existing taxonomies have no category for. The one construct that comes closest to closed-loop operation contains no living cell at all. We then trace how single-cell coupling is scaling into hybrid prototissues that act as discovery platforms for pathological microenvironments, and we outline the translational barriers these constructs must survive to reach the clinic.
items.authors: Ion Ioannou

items.title: A Convenient Crystalline Acyl Silane for the Colorimetric Titration of Diisobutylaluminum Hydride (DIBAL)
items.abstract: Due to the intense color associated with acyl silanes and their fast reaction with DIBAL to generate colorless alcohols, these properties were utilized to develop a colorimetric titration of DIBAL. A convenient crystalline acyl silane was identified that can be prepared on gram scale without the need for chromatographic purification by direct crystallization of the reaction products. Use of this material for the colorimetric titration of DIBAL and n-BuLi was possible. A variety of other 2 hydride and organometallic reagents were also tested and showed unsatisfactory endpoints. This work was performed by an American Chemical Society Project SEED student during their summer fellowship under the direction of a senior graduate student. The work disclosed could be suitable for application to an advanced undergraduate level laboratory related to the titration of reactive hydride reagents including the significance of atom effects on the physical and chemical properties or organic compounds.
items.authors: Stephen Collins, Colby Basnett, Joshua D. Sieber
items.title_zh: 一种方便的结晶酰基硅烷用于二异丁基铝氢化物的比色滴定
items.summary_zh: 由于酰基硅烷的强烈颜色及其与二异丁基铝氢化物（DIBAL）快速反应生成无色醇的特性，本文开发了一种DIBAL的比色滴定方法。研究中发现了一种方便的结晶酰基硅烷，可以在克级规模上制备，无需通过色谱纯化，直接结晶反应产物即可。该材料可用于DIBAL和n-BuLi的比色滴定。还测试了多种其他氢化物和有机金属试剂，但未能获得满意的终点。该研究由美国化学学会Project SEED的学生在一名高级研究生的指导下进行，适合应用于与反应性氢化物试剂滴定相关的高级本科实验室。
items.l1_lead: 本文开发了一种方便的结晶酰基硅烷，可用于二异丁基铝氢化物的比色滴定，具有良好的反应性和实用性，适合高级本科实验室应用。
items.l2_summary:
本文介绍了一种新开发的比色滴定方法，用于测定二异丁基铝氢化物（DIBAL）的浓度，利用了酰基硅烷的强烈颜色及其与DIBAL快速反应生成无色醇的特性。研究中发现了一种方便的结晶酰基硅烷，该材料可以在克级规模上制备，且无需经过色谱纯化，直接通过结晶反应产物即可获得。这种结晶酰基硅烷不仅适用于DIBAL的比色滴定，还可以用于n-BuLi的滴定。

在实验过程中，研究团队还测试了多种其他氢化物和有机金属试剂，但未能获得满意的滴定终点。这项研究由美国化学学会Project SEED的学生在一名高级研究生的指导下进行，表明该方法适合应用于与反应性氢化物试剂滴定相关的高级本科实验室。通过这一研究，提供了一种简便且有效的手段来进行DIBAL的定量分析，为相关领域的实验室工作提供了新的工具和思路。

items.title: A Physically Grounded Discrete Causal Recording Formalism Based on Spatiotemporal Isolation for Surface Propagation Pattern Reconstruction
items.abstract: This study introduces a pattern-oriented mathematical framework, termed the causal recording framework, which is conceptually rooted in cellular automata and consists of a discrete state layer that encodes physical information.Unlike Laplacian-based continuous partial differential equations (PDEs), which are successfully established for domain-dependent macroscopic pattern generation, the causal recording framework generates and records each local state solely from previously registered causal states, regardless of domain size, while incorporating time irreversibility and dissipative structures.The framework is applied to deterministic geometric order on liquid surfaces and validated through direct experiments and pattern reconstruction.Numerical pattern reconstructions demonstrate that the framework can reconstruct the evolution of real water ripple patterns.This research also reports that disordered, symmetry-breaking ripples on water surfaces can evolve into highly organized symmetric water patterns.This transition is reconstructed through a single causal recording framework, suggesting that emergent regularity arises from the interaction of identical local rules without any modification of the governing equations.The results also suggest that spatial confinement and local source information are critical factors in transforming disordered asymmetric patterns into highly ordered Faraday-wave-like patterns.These findings demonstrate the validity of the causal recording formulation as an effective framework for describing natural pattern formation characterized by domain independence, dissipative structures, and time irreversibility.
items.authors: Junhyung Lee

items.title: Quantification of Levoglucosan in Biomass Burning Particulate Matter Using a Glucometer Test Strip
items.abstract: Levoglucosan (LG) is highly abundant in biomass pyrolysate and is widely used as a tracer for biomass burning in environmental sciences. Current analytical standards rely on gas or liquid chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry (GC/LC-MS). Because these methods are expensive, there is a critical need for low-cost alternatives. This work explores using commercial glucometer strips to detect and quantify LG by first converting it into d-glucose with heat and acid. The hydrolysis condition was optimized to be at 150 °C, with 0.1 M H2SO4, for 60 min, while the sample was buffered at pH 7.3 for optimal detection. Following the optimization of the hydrolysis protocol, the glucometer strip signal exhibited a linear response, which was statistically indistinguishable from the response to d-glucose. However, when applied to authentic biomass burning filter samples, the glucometer method yielded concentrations approximately twice as high as GC–MS measurements. This discrepancy is likely due to interfering compounds in the sample matrix that also release d-glucose upon hydrolysis. Overall, this study establishes the proof-of-concept for using off-the-shelf glucometer testing strips for LG detection, while highlighting the distinct challenges of applying this method to complex environmental samples.
items.authors: Amanda Hanashiro Moraes, Antonio Mirante, Dylan Long, Faisal Hossain, Michael Serpe, Ran Zhao

items.title: Computer Vision for Predicting Electrochemical Reaction Performance from Electroanalytical Data
items.abstract: Electrosynthesis has surfaced as a key approach in modern synthesis, enabling more sustainable chemical transformations with reduced chemical waste. The accurate prediction of electrosynthesis performance is crucial for accelerating the discovery and design of reactions. Despite indisputable advances, the descriptor-based predictions fall short in representing the full reaction regime due to the high‑dimensional parameter space of electrosynthesis. Cyclic voltammograms, which are typically employed for mechanistic analysis, inherently contain rich information about electrochemical processes. Herein, we applied computer vision techniques to collect a cyclic voltammogram image database and trained a neural network directly on these image data. The resulting models achieved reliable performance in predicting electrosynthesis outcomes, demonstrating the potential of image-based deep learning for electrochemical reaction evaluation and data-driven electrosynthesis studies.
items.authors: Xinran Chen, Sven Erik Peters, Lutz Ackermann
items.title_zh: 基于计算机视觉预测电化学反应性能的研究
items.summary_zh: 电合成作为现代合成中的关键方法，能够实现更可持续的化学转化并减少化学废物。准确预测电合成性能对加速反应的发现和设计至关重要。尽管已有显著进展，但基于描述符的预测在高维参数空间中仍显不足。循环伏安图通常用于机理分析，内含丰富的电化学过程信息。本研究应用计算机视觉技术构建循环伏安图像数据库，并直接在这些图像数据上训练神经网络。所得到的模型在预测电合成结果方面表现可靠，展示了基于图像的深度学习在电化学反应评估和数据驱动电合成研究中的潜力。
items.l1_lead: 本研究利用计算机视觉技术构建循环伏安图像数据库，成功训练神经网络以准确预测电合成性能，展示了深度学习在电化学反应评估中的应用潜力。
items.l2_summary:
电合成作为现代合成中的关键方法，具有实现更可持续化学转化和减少化学废物的潜力。准确预测电合成性能对于加速反应的发现和设计至关重要。尽管在这一领域已有显著进展，但基于描述符的预测在高维参数空间中仍显不足，限制了其应用的广泛性。循环伏安图（cyclic voltammetry）作为一种常用的电化学分析工具，蕴含了丰富的电化学过程信息，能够为机理分析提供重要依据。

本研究通过应用计算机视觉技术，构建了一个循环伏安图像数据库，并在这些图像数据上直接训练神经网络。研究结果表明，所得到的模型在预测电合成结果方面表现出可靠性，显示出基于图像的深度学习在电化学反应评估和数据驱动电合成研究中的巨大潜力。这一方法不仅提升了对电化学反应性能的预测能力，也为未来的电合成研究提供了新的思路和工具，推动了电化学领域的进一步发展。通过将计算机视觉与电化学相结合，研究者们能够更有效地解析复杂的电化学过程，从而加速新反应的发现与优化。

items.title: Gas-Phase Fragmentation in Mass Spectrometry Informs the Shape and Topology of Thiolated Metal Nanoclusters
items.abstract: Thiolated metal nanoclusters (NCs), comprising a metal core protected by outer-layer staple motifs, have attracted widespread interest due to their promising applications in catalysis, biosensing, and biomedicine. While mass spectrometry (MS) is widely used to determine the chemical composition of metal NCs via intact mass measurement, its potential for in-depth structural analysis via gas-phase fragmentation in tandem MS (MS/MS) has been relatively underexplored and mostly focused on the collision induced dissociation (CID) technique involving gas collisions. Herein, we systematically compared the fragmentation pathways between CID and an alternative method, surface induced dissociation (SID), using model Au NCs featuring distinct symmetries and structural motifs. We show that gas-phase fragments in CID and SID overall shared the common fragmentation behavior of breaking the outer staples of Au NCs, but with different preferences in the location of bond cleavages. In addition, SID showed characteristic Au losses in ellipsoidal Au NCs with trimeric staples; and fragmentation efficiency in CID and SID varied differentially according to the shape of the NCs. Building on these findings, we applied the method to study non-crystallizable Au-Ag NCs with heterogeneous stoichiometry. The SID fragmentation data helped locate the Au and Ag atoms, providing valuable insights into the synthetic pathway of the NCs, which was otherwise inaccessible experimentally. Together, these results support SID as a complementary MS/MS tool for metal NCs, with particular promise for heterogeneous systems like the mixed NCs that cannot be easily crystallized.
items.authors: Long Shi, Luoming Zhang, Zebo Li, Zijie Chen, Yuqing Yao, Ruikang Tang
items.title_zh: 气相碎裂质谱分析揭示硫醇化金属纳米簇的形状与拓扑
items.summary_zh: 硫醇化金属纳米簇（NCs）由金属核心和外层保护结构组成，因其在催化、生物传感和生物医学中的应用前景而受到广泛关注。尽管质谱（MS）常用于通过完整质量测量确定金属NCs的化学组成，但其在气相碎裂方面的深入结构分析潜力尚未得到充分探索，主要集中在气体碰撞诱导解离（CID）技术上。本文系统比较了CID与另一种方法——表面诱导解离（SID）之间的碎裂路径，使用具有不同对称性和结构特征的模型金纳米簇。结果表明，CID和SID中的气相碎片总体上表现出相似的碎裂行为，主要是破坏金纳米簇的外层结构，但在键断裂位置上存在不同偏好。此外，SID在具有三聚体结构的椭球形金纳米簇中表现出特征性的金损失；CID和SID的碎裂效率则根据纳米簇的形状有所不同。基于这些发现，我们将该方法应用于研究具有异质化学计量的不可结晶化金银纳米簇，SID碎裂数据有助于定位金和银原子，为合成提供了宝贵的见解。
items.l1_lead: 气相碎裂质谱分析揭示了硫醇化金属纳米簇在不同碎裂方法下的形状与拓扑特征，为其合成与应用提供了重要见解。
items.l2_summary:
硫醇化金属纳米簇（NCs）由金属核心和外层保护结构组成，因其在催化、生物传感和生物医学等领域的广泛应用而备受关注。尽管质谱（MS）技术常用于通过完整质量测量来确定金属纳米簇的化学组成，但其在气相碎裂方面的深入结构分析潜力尚未得到充分探索，尤其是气体碰撞诱导解离（CID）技术的应用。本文系统比较了CID与表面诱导解离（SID）两种方法在气相碎裂路径上的差异，使用了具有不同对称性和结构特征的模型金纳米簇进行研究。

研究结果表明，CID和SID在气相碎片的整体碎裂行为上表现出相似性，主要集中在破坏金纳米簇的外层结构。然而，在键断裂的位置上，两者却存在不同的偏好。特别是在具有三聚体结构的椭球形金纳米簇中，SID表现出了特征性的金损失现象。此外，CID和SID的碎裂效率也因纳米簇的形状而有所不同，这一发现为理解不同形状金属纳米簇的碎裂机制提供了新的视角。

基于这些发现，研究团队进一步将该方法应用于具有异质化学计量的不可结晶化金银纳米簇的研究。SID碎裂数据的分析有助于定位金和银原子的分布，为金银纳米簇的合成提供了宝贵的见解。这些结果不仅丰富了对金属纳米簇气相碎裂行为的理解，也为未来在相关领域的应用奠定了基础。通过对CID和SID的比较，研究揭示了不同碎裂机制对金属纳米簇形状和拓扑的影响，为纳米材料的设计和应用提供了重要的理论支持。

items.title: Framework Connectivity Tunes the Nuclear Spin Bath and Extends Coherence in Cu(II) Metal–Organic Framework Qubit Lattices
items.abstract: Designing solid-state spin-qubit arrays that retain long coherence at high spin density remains a central challenge in quantum information materials. In molecular qubits, this challenge arises because the same local coordination environment and lattice architecture that define the spin array also control the dominant decoherence channels, most notably nuclear-spin spectral diffusion and coupling to low-frequency phonons. Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) are therefore especially attractive because they combine dense, crystalline spin arrays with chemically programmable control over the coordination environment, framework connectivity, and supramolecular packing, yet a fundamental understanding of how specific structural changes translate into predictable relaxation behavior remains underdeveloped. Here we compare two closely related oxygen-coordinated Cu(II) frameworks, Cu-TPTC and Cu-TPTriC, that preserve the same first-sphere donor set while changing connectivity and supramolecular packing. Cu-TPTC comprises one-dimensional Cu–O chains assembled into hydrogen-bonded rods, whereas Cu-TPTriC forms coordination-connected Cu–O–Cu two-dimensional sheets that stack through interlayer aromatic contacts in the absence of hydrogen-bond stitching. Continuous-wave electron paramagnetic resonance (CW-EPR) spectroscopy shows that both lattices exhibit relatively narrow linewidths compared with a Cu–N porphyrinic benchmark, consistent with reduced ligand-derived superhyperfine broadening in an oxygenonly coordination sphere. Pulsed electron paramagnetic resonance measurements establish coherent spin control and reveal systematically longer spin–lattice relaxation times (T1) and phase-memory times (Tm) in Cu-TPTriC over 5–25 K, with Tm≈4.8 ± 0.011 μs at 5 K. This coherence gain persists despite substantially shorter Cu···Cu separations in Cu-TPTriC and is consistent with a reduced proton-bath density and modified lattice dynamics, as reflected in the weaker electron spin echo envelope modulation (ESEEM) observed for Cu-TPTriC. Together, these results suggest that within dense oxygen-coordinated Cu(II) framework lattices, the secondary-sphere nuclear-spin environment and lattice dynamics can play an important role in governing decoherence, potentially outweighing spin spacing alone.
items.authors: Kavish Saini, Sisheed Sivaraman, Prashanna Poudel, Bonaventure A. Odeke, Gajadhar Joshi, Manny de Jesus Lopez
items.title_zh: 框架连接调节核自旋浴并延长Cu(II)金属有机框架量子比特的相干性
items.summary_zh: 设计能够在高自旋密度下保持长相干性的固态自旋量子比特阵列是量子信息材料中的一个核心挑战。在分子量子比特中，这一挑战源于定义自旋阵列的局部配位环境和晶格结构也控制着主要的去相干通道，尤其是核自旋谱扩散和与低频声子的耦合。金属有机框架（MOFs）因其结合了密集的晶体自旋阵列与可化学编程的配位环境、框架连接性和超分子堆积而特别有吸引力。然而，如何将特定的结构变化转化为可预测的弛豫行为的基本理解仍然不够成熟。本文比较了两个密切相关的氧配位Cu(II)框架Cu-TPTC和Cu-TPTriC，前者由一维Cu-O链组成并组装成氢键连接的棒，后者则形成通过层间芳香接触堆叠的二维Cu-O-Cu片。连续波电子顺磁共振（CW-EPR）光谱显示，两种晶格的线宽相对较窄。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，通过框架连接调节核自旋浴，可以有效延长Cu(II)金属有机框架量子比特的相干性，为量子信息材料的设计提供新思路。
items.l2_summary:
在量子信息材料的研究中，设计能够在高自旋密度下保持长相干性的固态自旋量子比特阵列是一个核心挑战。特别是在分子量子比特中，局部配位环境和晶格结构不仅定义了自旋阵列，还控制着主要的去相干通道，如核自旋谱扩散和与低频声子的耦合。金属有机框架（MOFs）因其能够结合密集的晶体自旋阵列与可化学编程的配位环境、框架连接性和超分子堆积而受到广泛关注。然而，如何将特定的结构变化转化为可预测的弛豫行为的基本理解仍然不够成熟。

本文比较了两种密切相关的氧配位Cu(II)框架，分别为Cu-TPTC和Cu-TPTriC。Cu-TPTC框架由一维Cu-O链组成，并通过氢键连接形成棒状结构；而Cu-TPTriC则形成通过层间芳香接触堆叠的二维Cu-O-Cu片。通过连续波电子顺磁共振（CW-EPR）光谱的分析，研究发现这两种晶格的线宽相对较窄，表明它们在自旋相干性方面表现出良好的特性。这一发现为理解不同结构对量子比特相干性的影响提供了重要的实验依据，进一步推动了金属有机框架在量子信息处理中的应用潜力。

items.title: Differentiable mass transfer modeling enables wet lab validated inverse analysis of liquid chromatography
items.abstract: Liquid chromatography (LC) is essential to organic synthesis and emerging selfdriving laboratories (SDLs), yet LC method development remains cost-intensive and dependent on expert intuition. Mechanistic chromatographic models offer a route to transferable and data-efficient method development, but their practical use is limited by the computational cost of inverse modeling and by the ill-posedness of parameter estimation from experimental chromatograms. Here we report a wet-lab-validated differentiable physics framework for LC inverse modeling. The framework integrates mechanistic column modeling with physics-informed machine learning (PIML) to enable efficient forward simulation and gradient-based inverse estimation of molecular transport and adsorption parameters from gradient-elution chromatograms. The primary PINN surrogate reproduces the mechanistic reference with a root-mean-square error of 10−3 in dimensionless concentration. To address the ill-posed nature of the inverse problem, we introduce an observability-guided experimental-design strategy that quantifies parameter identifiability and incorporates this information into the inverse objective to promote convergence toward the ground-truth parameters. Across 300 dry-lab simulation parameter combinations, the proposed strategy recovered the ground-truth parameters with relative errors ≤ 10% in 88.3% of cases using three gradient programs, compared with only 6.7% using a single gradient program. We further validate the framework against wet-lab LC 1 measurements, achieving an absolute retention-time error ≤ 10 s for 89.3% of samples and establishing a wet-lab database comprising 731 sets of transport and adsorption parameters extracted from 2,553 gradient-elution LC chromatograms. This work provides an observability-aware differentiable modeling foundation for autonomous LC method development and closed-loop analytical decision-making in AI-driven laboratories.
items.authors: Baochen Li, Zihan Zhou, Yanqing Yu, Sen Lin, Peng Wang, Tianshu Yu
items.title_zh: 可微分质量传递建模实现液相色谱逆分析的湿实验验证
items.summary_zh: 液相色谱（LC）在有机合成和新兴自驱动实验室（SDL）中至关重要，但其方法开发仍然成本高昂且依赖专家直觉。机制性色谱模型为可转移和数据高效的方法开发提供了途径，但其实际应用受到逆建模计算成本和实验色谱图参数估计病态性的限制。本文报告了一种经过湿实验验证的可微分物理框架用于LC逆建模。该框架将机制性柱模型与物理信息机器学习（PIML）结合，实现了从梯度洗脱色谱图中高效的正向模拟和基于梯度的逆向估计。主要的PINN替代模型在无量纲浓度上重现机制性参考，均方根误差为10−3。为解决逆问题的病态性，我们提出了一种可观测性引导的实验设计策略，量化参数可识别性，并将该信息纳入逆目标，以促进向真实参数的收敛。在300个干实验模拟参数组合中，该策略在88.3%的情况下以相对误差≤10%恢复了真实参数。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种结合机制性柱模型与物理信息机器学习的可微分框架，有效实现液相色谱逆建模，并通过实验验证其在参数恢复中的高效性和准确性。
items.l2_summary:
液相色谱（LC）在有机合成和新兴自驱动实验室（SDL）中扮演着重要角色，但其方法开发过程通常成本高昂且依赖于专家的直觉。为了解决这一问题，机制性色谱模型为方法开发提供了可转移和数据高效的途径。然而，逆建模的计算成本和实验色谱图参数估计的病态性限制了其实际应用。本文提出了一种经过湿实验验证的可微分物理框架，用于液相色谱的逆建模。该框架将机制性柱模型与物理信息机器学习（PIML）相结合，实现了从梯度洗脱色谱图中高效的正向模拟和基于梯度的逆向估计。

在研究中，主要的物理信息神经网络（PINN）替代模型在无量纲浓度上成功重现了机制性参考，其均方根误差为10^-3。为了应对逆问题的病态性，研究者提出了一种可观测性引导的实验设计策略，该策略量化了参数的可识别性，并将这些信息纳入逆目标，以促进向真实参数的收敛。在300个干实验模拟的参数组合中，该策略在88.3%的情况下成功以相对误差≤10%恢复了真实参数。这一研究不仅为液相色谱的逆建模提供了新的思路，也为相关领域的实验设计和数据分析提供了有价值的参考。通过结合机制性模型与机器学习方法，研究者有效降低了方法开发的成本和复杂性，推动了液相色谱技术的进一步应用与发展。

items.title: An analytical potential energy surface and variational transition-state theory kinetics of the NH3 + Br → NH2 + HBr hydrogen-abstraction reaction
items.abstract: We report the first full-dimensional analytical potential energy surface (PES) and a variational transitionstate theory (VTST) study of the endothermic gas-phase reaction NH3 + Br −−→ NH2 + HBr, completing the halogen series (NH3 + F, Cl, Br) of the group’s analytical surfaces. Stationary points and energetics were benchmarked at the CCSD(T)/CBS level with the bromine 3d shell frozen; a −3.51 kcal/mol spinorbit correction was added to the NH3 + Br asymptote for the Br(2P) splitting. The benchmark locates a genuine, product-like (Hammond) saddle 17.6 kcal/mol above reactants but submerged 2.1 kcal/mol below the NH2+HBr asymptote (zero-point-and spin–orbit-corrected). A valence-bond/molecular-mechanics PES was calibrated to reproduce these stationary points to better than 0.25 kcal/mol; it retains an exact analytical gradient and dedicated van der Waals wells for the entrance (NH3···Br) and exit (NH2···HBr) complexes. Canonical variational theory with multidimensional tunneling (µOMT) yields forward rate constants over 200 K to 2000 K. Because the adiabatic barrier lies below the product asymptote, the tunneling coefficient is unity and the reverse reaction NH2 +HBr −−→ NH3 +Br exhibits a negative apparent activation energy, as measured for the carbon analogue CH3 +HBr. Quasi-classical trajectories on the same surface, once product zero-point leakage is accounted for, reproduce the variational forward rate as an independent check of the barrier. In the absence of experimental data, the forward rate constants are presented as predictions anchored to the high-level energetics.
items.authors: Cipriano Rangel
items.title_zh: NH3 + Br反应的势能面与变分过渡态理论动力学研究
items.summary_zh: 我们首次报告了吸热气相反应NH3 + Br → NH2 + HBr的全维度解析势能面（PES）及变分过渡态理论（VTST）研究，完成了卤素系列的分析表面。通过CCSD(T)/CBS水平基准测试，固定溴的3d壳层，NH3 + Br渐近线添加了−3.51 kcal/mol的自旋轨道修正。基准结果显示，真实的产物样态鞍点位于反应物上方17.6 kcal/mol，但低于NH2 + HBr渐近线2.1 kcal/mol（经过零点和自旋轨道修正）。我们校准了一个价键/分子力学PES，以更好地再现这些鞍点，精度优于0.25 kcal/mol。采用多维隧穿的规范变分理论（µOMT）计算了200 K至2000 K的正向速率常数。由于绝热势垒低于产物渐近线，隧穿系数为1，反应NH2 + HBr → NH3 + Br表现出负的表观活化能。
items.l1_lead: 研究首次揭示了NH3与Br反应的全维度势能面及其动力学特征，表明该反应具有低绝热势垒和负表观活化能。
items.l2_summary:
本研究首次系统性地探讨了吸热气相反应NH3 + Br → NH2 + HBr的全维度解析势能面（PES）及变分过渡态理论（VTST），并完成了卤素系列的分析表面。通过CCSD(T)/CBS水平的基准测试，研究固定了溴的3d壳层，并在NH3 + Br的渐近线中添加了−3.51 kcal/mol的自旋轨道修正。基准结果表明，真实的产物样态鞍点位于反应物上方17.6 kcal/mol，但低于NH2 + HBr的渐近线2.1 kcal/mol（经过零点和自旋轨道修正）。为更好地再现这些鞍点，研究者校准了一个价键/分子力学PES，其精度优于0.25 kcal/mol。

在动力学方面，采用多维隧穿的规范变分理论（µOMT）计算了200 K至2000 K范围内的正向速率常数。由于绝热势垒低于产物渐近线，隧穿系数为1，反应NH2 + HBr → NH3 + Br表现出负的表观活化能。这一发现表明，该反应在一定温度范围内具有较高的反应性，且隧穿效应在反应过程中起到了重要作用。整体而言，本研究为理解NH3与Br反应的机制提供了重要的理论基础和数据支持，推动了对卤素反应动力学的深入研究。

items.title: Assessing the state of the art in ADMET prediction: Lessons from the OpenADMET-ExpansionRx community blind challenge
items.abstract: Computational blind challenges are essential for advancing drug discovery, especially in research areas with limited public data, such as absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, toxicity (ADMET) prediction. In this paper, we present the results of our latest community blind challenge, organized in collaboration with Expansion Therapeutics (ExpansionRx). Participants were tasked with predicting nine distinct ADMET endpoints routinely evaluated during lead optimization of compounds in drug discovery programs. Following unprecedented engagement from the global community, this challenge provided valuable insights into the state of the art in machine learning for ADMET modeling. Evaluating submissions against a realistic, challenging dataset from active ExpansionRx drug discovery programs revealed that message-passing neural networks and chemical foundation models dominated among the top performers. Furthermore, the results highlighted the power of proprietary industry datasets and a critical need to optimize predictive workflows for different endpoints independently via multitasking and task-affinity grouping. We also demonstrate how hosting our open-source blind challenge infrastructure on a flexible platform like Hugging Face was pivotal for driving community engagement and visibility. Ultimately, blind challenges supported by robust infrastructure, widespread dissemination, and rigorous post-challenge analysis are fundamental to maximizing the utility of public data releases. We anticipate that these community benchmarks will continue to drive the advancement of ADMET models, enabling their deployment in both early- and late-stage drug discovery.
items.authors: Maria A. Castellanos, Hugo MacDermott-Opeskin, Jon Ainsley, Jonathan A. Swain, Sean Colby, Devany West
items.title_zh: 评估ADMET预测的最新进展：来自OpenADMET-ExpansionRx社区盲挑战的经验教训
items.summary_zh: 计算盲挑战对于推动药物发现至关重要，尤其是在公共数据有限的领域，如吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）预测。本文展示了与Expansion Therapeutics（ExpansionRx）合作组织的最新社区盲挑战的结果。参与者需预测在药物发现项目中常规评估的九个不同ADMET终点。全球社区的积极参与为ADMET建模的机器学习现状提供了宝贵见解。评估提交结果时，发现消息传递神经网络和化学基础模型在表现优异者中占主导地位。此外，结果强调了专有行业数据集的优势，以及通过多任务和任务亲和分组独立优化不同终点预测工作流程的必要性。我们还展示了在Hugging Face等灵活平台上托管开源盲挑战基础设施对推动社区参与和可见性的重要性。
items.l1_lead: 计算盲挑战在推动ADMET预测领域的药物发现中至关重要，结果显示消息传递神经网络和化学基础模型表现优异，强调了多任务优化和开源平台的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
在药物发现领域，计算盲挑战被认为是推动研究进展的重要手段，尤其是在吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）预测等公共数据相对有限的领域。本文总结了与Expansion Therapeutics（ExpansionRx）合作组织的最新社区盲挑战的成果，参与者需对九个常规评估的ADMET终点进行预测。此次挑战吸引了全球社区的积极参与，为ADMET建模的机器学习现状提供了重要的见解。

在评估提交结果的过程中，研究发现消息传递神经网络（Message Passing Neural Networks）和化学基础模型（Chemoinformatics-based Models）在表现优异的模型中占据主导地位。这表明，基于先进算法的模型在ADMET预测中具有显著的优势。此外，结果还强调了专有行业数据集的价值，表明这些数据集在提升预测准确性方面的潜力。

为了优化不同终点的预测工作流程，研究指出通过多任务学习（Multi-task Learning）和任务亲和分组（Task Affinity Grouping）独立优化的必要性。这种方法能够有效提高模型在多个ADMET终点上的表现，进一步推动药物发现的效率。

最后，本文还强调了在Hugging Face等灵活平台上托管开源盲挑战基础设施的重要性。这种开放的环境不仅促进了社区的参与，还提升了研究的可见性，为未来的ADMET预测研究奠定了基础。通过此次盲挑战，研究者们获得了宝贵的经验教训，为进一步的研究和应用提供了指导，推动了ADMET预测领域的发展。

items.title: Docking, Molecular Dynamics, QSAR, and Machine Learning in Alzheimer's Small-Molecule Drug Discovery: Current Utility, Key Limitations, and Reproducibility Challenges
items.abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) remains one of the most challenging therapeutic areas for small-molecule drug discovery because of its multifactorial pathology, complex target biology, and demanding central nervous system drug-development requirements. In this context, computational methods have become increasingly important for compound prioritization, hypothesis generation, and structure–activity interpretation. Among these, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, quantitative structure–activity relationship (QSAR) modeling, and machine learning (ML) are widely used in AD-oriented medicinal chemistry, particularly in studies involving targets such as β-secretase 1 (BACE1) and tau. This review critically examines the practical roles of these four approaches in AD small-molecule discovery. Rather than presenting them as universally predictive solutions, the review evaluates their principal strengths, major limitations, and current challenges related to validation, interpretability, reproducibility, and experimental translation. Molecular docking remains useful for structure-based hypothesis generation and binding-pose analysis, especially for structurally characterized targets, but is frequently overinterpreted when numerical scores are treated as direct evidence of biological activity. MD simulations provide a complementary framework for examining protein–ligand stability, conformational flexibility, and interaction persistence, although simulation outcomes remain highly dependent on methodological choices and should not be regarded as definitive validation of binding or efficacy. QSAR continues to support ligand-based activity modeling and analogue prioritization, but its utility depends strongly on dataset quality, applicability domain, and validation strategy. ML offers greater flexibility for activity and property prediction, including multi-parameter prioritization and ADMET-related modeling, yet remains sensitive to dataset bias, overfitting, limited interpretability, and poor reproducibility. Across all four approaches, the review emphasizes that methodological rigor is at least as important as methodological sophistication. Particular attention is given to common problems including inadequate validation, overinterpretation of computational outputs, limited reproducibility, and weak integration with experimental medicinal chemistry. Overall, molecular docking, MD simulations, QSAR, and ML are best viewed as complementary support tools whose value depends on careful application, transparent reporting, and close integration with experimental evidence. A more critical, reproducible, and biologically informed use of these methods is likely to provide a stronger foundation for future AD small-molecule discovery. Keywords
items.authors: Poulami Saha, Anuja Chouhan
items.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病小分子药物发现中的计算方法综述
items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）因其多因素病理、复杂靶点生物学及中枢神经系统药物开发要求，成为小分子药物发现中最具挑战性的领域之一。计算方法在化合物优先级排序、假设生成和结构-活性解释中变得越来越重要。本文重点评估分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟、定量结构-活性关系（QSAR）建模和机器学习（ML）在AD小分子发现中的实际应用。尽管这些方法在结构基础假设生成和结合位点分析中仍然有用，但在将数值评分视为生物活性的直接证据时，常常被过度解读。MD模拟为研究蛋白-配体稳定性提供了补充框架。
items.l1_lead: 计算方法在阿尔茨海默病小分子药物发现中逐渐重要，尤其在化合物优先级排序和结构-活性解释方面，但需谨慎解读数值评分与生物活性的关系。
items.l2_summary:
阿尔茨海默病（AD）因其多因素病理、复杂的靶点生物学以及中枢神经系统药物开发的特殊要求，成为小分子药物发现领域中最具挑战性的课题之一。在这一背景下，计算方法在化合物的优先级排序、假设生成和结构-活性关系（SAR）解释中变得愈发重要。本文对分子对接（molecular docking）、分子动力学（MD）模拟、定量结构-活性关系（QSAR）建模以及机器学习（ML）在阿尔茨海默病小分子药物发现中的实际应用进行了重点评估。

分子对接技术在药物发现中被广泛应用，能够帮助研究人员预测小分子与靶标蛋白的结合模式。然而，尽管这些计算方法在生成结构基础假设和分析结合位点方面具有重要作用，但在将数值评分视为生物活性的直接证据时，往往存在过度解读的风险。特别是在阿尔茨海默病的研究中，药物靶点的复杂性使得单一的计算评分难以全面反映生物活性。

分子动力学模拟为研究蛋白-配体的稳定性提供了一个补充框架，能够揭示在动态条件下分子间的相互作用。这种方法不仅有助于理解药物的结合机制，还能为优化药物设计提供重要信息。定量结构-活性关系建模则通过统计学方法建立化合物结构与生物活性之间的定量关系，为药物筛选提供了理论依据。

总的来说，尽管计算方法在阿尔茨海默病小分子药物发现中发挥了重要作用，但研究者在应用这些方法时需谨慎，避免对数值评分的过度解读。未来的研究应继续探索这些计算工具的潜力，以期在阿尔茨海默病的药物开发中取得更大的进展。

items.title: Accelerating Lead Optimization away from Anti-Targets: Navigating the Structural Complexity of Promiscuous ADMET Proteins
items.abstract: The development of a small-molecule suitable for clinical use involves optimization of ligand binding to an identified target protein but also frequently the reduction of binding to a variety of anti-target proteins known to pose translational risk. These anti-targets, often referred to as ADMET proteins, often contain large, highly flexible binding sites leading to promiscuous binding of small molecules. This property often frustrates efforts to execute structure-based design against these anti-targets. Here we demonstrate the application of a combination of induced fit docking and free energy perturbation to structurally enable several of the most common anti-targets: cytochrome P450 isoforms 3A4 and 2D6, the hERG ion channel, and PXR. Crucially, the enforcement of a consensus binding mode across a congeneric series allowed for the efficient exploration of a wide range of receptor conformation space. Results are presented for both public retrospective datasets and prospective application in active drug discovery programs.
items.authors: Howook Hwang, Mee Shelley, Andrew Placzek, Kevin Demarco, Steven Albanese, Andreas Verras
items.title_zh: 加速优化小分子药物，规避抗靶点的结构复杂性
items.summary_zh: 小分子药物的开发涉及优化配体与靶标蛋白的结合，同时还需减少与多种已知的抗靶点蛋白的结合，以降低转化风险。这些抗靶点，通常称为ADMET蛋白，具有大且高度灵活的结合位点，导致小分子药物的多重结合特性，给基于结构的设计带来挑战。本文展示了诱导适配对接与自由能扰动相结合的方法，成功对多个常见抗靶点（如细胞色素P450同种型3A4和2D6、hERG离子通道及PXR）进行结构优化。通过在同系系列中强制执行共识结合模式，能够高效探索广泛的受体构象空间。结果包括公共回顾性数据集和在活跃药物发现项目中的前瞻性应用。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种结合诱导适配对接与自由能扰动的方法，有效优化小分子药物以规避抗靶点的结构复杂性，降低转化风险。
items.l2_summary: 小分子药物的开发过程面临着优化配体与靶标蛋白结合的挑战，同时还需有效规避与多种已知抗靶点蛋白的结合，以降低转化风险。这些抗靶点，通常被称为ADMET蛋白（吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性），具有较大且高度灵活的结合位点，导致小分子药物可能与多个靶点发生结合，从而增加了基于结构的药物设计的复杂性。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种结合诱导适配对接（induced fit docking）与自由能扰动（free energy perturbation）的方法，成功对多个常见的抗靶点进行结构优化，包括细胞色素P450同种型3A4（CYP3A4）、2D6（CYP2D6）、hERG离子通道及PXR（配体激活的转录因子）。通过在同系系列中强制执行共识结合模式，研究者能够高效探索广泛的受体构象空间，从而提高了药物设计的成功率。该方法不仅在公共回顾性数据集中得到了验证，还在多个活跃的药物发现项目中进行了前瞻性应用，显示出其在小分子药物开发中的潜在价值。这一研究为优化小分子药物的设计提供了新的思路，尤其是在面对复杂的抗靶点结构时，能够有效降低药物开发过程中的风险。

items.title: Bidirectional Refractive-Index Programming via Three-Stage Sequential Thiol-Click Chemistry for High-Performance Holographic Recording
items.abstract: Conventional holographic photopolymers (HPs) mainly rely on a polymerization–diffusion mechanism to record volume holographic gratings (VHGs), resulting in trade-offs among photosensitivity, refractive-index (RI) modulation (Δn), optical clarity, and VHG stability. To address these trade-offs, we propose a bidirectional refractive-index programming (BRIP) strategy based on three sequential thiol-click reactions. Stage I employs a base-catalyzed thiol–acrylate Michael addition to form a thiol-rich host matrix. Under holographic exposure, Stage II triggers photoinduced thiol–vinyl addition to incorporate a high-RI recording monomer into the bright regions, generating the initial VHG Δn while preserving residual thiol sites in the dark regions. After exposure, Stage III uses thermally activated thiol–epoxy addition to incorporate a low-RI enhancing monomer into these complementary dark regions, further increasing Δn. A representative BRIP HP formulation is developed to validate the strategy. Benefiting from the BRIP design, the material requires only 1.1–1.9 mJ/cm2 exposure dose to generate VHGs with initial Δn values of 0.0103–0.0232 after Stage II, which increase to 0.0193–0.0394 after Stage III, while maintaining 95% visible-light transmittance, 0.02% haze, and 4% Δn variation after ten thermal cycles between 200 and -197 °C. This work establishes a new molecular design paradigm for high-performance HPs.
items.authors: Haoqiang Gao, Mingxuan Wang, Diqin Zhang, Yunlong Zhang, Qixin Zhou, Yong Bi
items.title_zh: 基于三阶段硫醇点击化学的双向折射率编程用于高性能全息记录
items.summary_zh: 传统全息光聚合物（HPs）主要依赖聚合-扩散机制记录体积全息光栅（VHGs），导致光敏性、折射率调制（Δn）、光学清晰度和VHG稳定性之间的权衡。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了一种基于三步序列硫醇点击反应的双向折射率编程（BRIP）策略。第一阶段采用碱催化的硫醇-丙烯酸酯迈克尔加成形成富硫醇的宿主基体；第二阶段在全息曝光下触发光诱导的硫醇-乙烯加成，将高折射率记录单体引入亮区，生成初始VHG Δn，同时保留暗区的残余硫醇位点；第三阶段利用热激活的硫醇-环氧加成将低折射率增强单体引入暗区，进一步增加Δn。通过BRIP设计，材料在第二阶段仅需1.1–1.9 mJ/cm²的曝光剂量即可生成初始Δn值为0.0103–0.0232的VHG，第三阶段后增至0.0193–0.0394，同时保持95%的可见光透过率、0.02%的雾度和在200至-197°C之间的10个热循环后的4% Δn变化。此研究建立了一种新的分子设计范式。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种基于三阶段硫醇点击化学的双向折射率编程策略，显著提高了全息光聚合物的折射率调制和光学性能，解决了传统材料的多项局限。
items.l2_summary:
传统的全息光聚合物（HPs）在记录体积全息光栅（VHGs）时，主要依赖聚合-扩散机制，这种方法导致了光敏性、折射率调制（Δn）、光学清晰度和VHG稳定性之间的权衡。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了一种基于三阶段硫醇点击反应的双向折射率编程（BRIP）策略。该策略的第一阶段通过碱催化的硫醇-丙烯酸酯迈克尔加成，形成富硫醇的宿主基体。第二阶段在全息曝光下，利用光诱导的硫醇-乙烯加成，将高折射率记录单体引入亮区，从而生成初始的VHG Δn，同时保留暗区的残余硫醇位点。第三阶段则通过热激活的硫醇-环氧加成，将低折射率增强单体引入暗区，进一步增加Δn。

通过BRIP设计，材料在第二阶段仅需1.1–1.9 mJ/cm²的曝光剂量即可生成初始Δn值为0.0103–0.0232的VHG，而在第三阶段后，Δn值增至0.0193–0.0394。这一过程不仅保持了95%的可见光透过率和0.02%的雾度，还在经历200至-197°C之间的10个热循环后，仅出现4%的Δn变化。这些结果表明，BRIP策略在提高全息光聚合物的性能方面具有显著优势，建立了一种新的分子设计范式，为高性能全息记录材料的开发提供了新的思路。

items.title: Engineering Gold Nanoparticles for Transmembrane Anion Transport
items.abstract: Synthetic transmembrane ion transporters are traditionally classified as either ion channels or carriers. Here we introduce a new nanoparticle-based transporter architecture in which spherical gold nanoparticles densely decorated with flexible urea- and thiourea-based ion-binding arms efficiently mediate transmembrane anion transport, providing the first proof of principle for nanoparticle-based transmembrane anion transport. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal a dynamic relay mechanism in which chloride ions migrate across the membrane by successive hopping between flexible ion-binding arms, while thermal rotational motion of the nanoparticle further facilitates translocation by repeatedly dragging these arms between the aqueous phase and the membrane interior.
