These findings introduce a new design principle for the construction of synthetic ion transporters based on densely functionalized multivalent nanoparticles.
items.authors: Meenakshi Pahwa, Debashis Mondal, Julia Blandine Bassila, Davide Bochicchio, Giulia Rossi, Michał J. Chmielewski
items.title_zh: 工程化金纳米颗粒用于跨膜阴离子运输
items.summary_zh: 合成的跨膜离子运输体传统上分为离子通道或载体。本文介绍了一种新的基于纳米颗粒的运输体架构，其中球形金纳米颗粒上密集装饰了灵活的尿素和硫脲基离子结合臂，能够高效介导跨膜阴离子运输，首次证明了基于纳米颗粒的跨膜阴离子运输的原理。分子动力学模拟揭示了一种动态中继机制，氯离子通过在灵活的离子结合臂之间的连续跳跃跨越膜，而纳米颗粒的热旋转运动进一步促进了运输，通过反复拖动这些臂在水相和膜内部之间移动。这些发现为基于密集功能化多价纳米颗粒的合成离子运输体的构建提供了新的设计原则。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，基于金纳米颗粒的跨膜阴离子运输体通过灵活的离子结合臂和动态中继机制实现高效运输，为合成新型离子运输体提供了设计新思路。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了一种新型的基于金纳米颗粒的跨膜阴离子运输体架构，打破了传统的离子通道或载体的设计思路。研究中合成的球形金纳米颗粒表面密集装饰了灵活的尿素和硫脲基离子结合臂，这种设计使得其能够高效介导跨膜阴离子运输。通过分子动力学模拟，研究者首次证明了基于纳米颗粒的跨膜阴离子运输的原理，揭示了一种动态中继机制。在这一机制中，氯离子通过在灵活的离子结合臂之间进行连续跳跃，成功跨越膜。此外，金纳米颗粒的热旋转运动进一步促进了运输过程，通过反复拖动这些离子结合臂在水相和膜内部之间移动，从而提高了阴离子的运输效率。

这一研究不仅为理解跨膜阴离子运输提供了新的视角，还为基于密集功能化多价纳米颗粒的合成离子运输体的构建提供了新的设计原则。这种新型运输体的开发可能在生物医学、药物传递及其他相关领域具有重要的应用潜力。通过对金纳米颗粒的功能化设计，研究者展示了如何利用纳米技术来优化离子运输过程，为未来的相关研究提供了重要的理论基础和实践指导。

items.title: Computationally Accelerated Discovery of Efficient Dual Component White Light Emitters
items.abstract: This work presents a computationally guided approach to formulating white light emission from a series of Hbonded iridium phosphors and a complementary H-bonding fluorophore. We computationally investigated thirty new Ir(III) complexes that all incorporate a previously studied H-bond rich biguanide functionalised ligand. The results of the computational screening, based on TD-DFT peak emission data and established lifetime and quantum efficiency data in the literature, identified seven Ir(III) candidates suitable for synthesis and further investigation. Of the seven Ir(III) complexes, four were chosen based on their synthetic feasibility and their suitability to further study based on the parameters of the screen. Photophysical investigations of these four candidates with our deep blue emitter showed how three of the four complexes could achieve near ideal white light in the appropriate ratio of the complementary H-bonding fluorophore, while all four hostguest-complements show promising white-light results in polymer (PMMA) films.
items.authors: T.H. Jones, R.S. Horne, D.J. Graham, B.A. Blight, Barry Blight
items.title_zh: 计算加速高效双组分白光发射体的发现
items.summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种计算指导的方法，通过一系列氢键结合的铱磷光体和互补的氢键结合荧光体来实现白光发射。我们计算性地研究了三十种新的Ir(III)配合物，这些配合物均包含先前研究的富氢键的大尿素功能化配体。基于TD-DFT峰值发射数据及文献中已建立的寿命和量子效率数据，计算筛选结果确定了七个适合合成和进一步研究的Ir(III)候选体。在这七个Ir(III)配合物中，四个因合成可行性和筛选参数的适宜性而被选中。对这四个候选体与我们的深蓝色发射体的光物理研究显示，四个配合物中有三个能够在适当比例的互补氢键结合荧光体中实现近理想的白光，而所有四个宿主-客体组合在聚合物（PMMA）薄膜中均显示出良好的白光结果。
items.l1_lead: 本研究通过计算指导的方法发现了高效的双组分白光发射体，成功筛选出多个铱配合物与荧光体组合，实现近理想的白光发射。
items.l2_summary:
本研究提出了一种计算指导的方法，以实现高效的双组分白光发射体。研究团队通过对三十种新的铱(III)配合物（Ir(III) complexes）进行计算性研究，这些配合物均包含富氢键的大尿素功能化配体。研究基于时间依赖密度泛函理论（TD-DFT）计算的峰值发射数据，以及文献中已有的寿命和量子效率数据，筛选出七个适合合成和进一步研究的Ir(III)候选体。在这七个候选体中，四个因其合成可行性和筛选参数的适宜性而被选中进行深入研究。

对这四个候选体与深蓝色发射体的光物理特性进行研究后发现，其中有三个配合物能够在适当比例的互补氢键结合荧光体中实现近乎理想的白光发射。此外，所有四个宿主-客体组合在聚合物（PMMA）薄膜中均显示出良好的白光发射效果。这一发现为高效白光发射体的开发提供了新的思路和可能性，展示了计算方法在材料设计中的重要应用潜力。通过合理的计算筛选和实验验证，本研究为未来的光电材料研究奠定了基础。

items.title: Language-model-derived training data for polymer glass transition prediction: a controlled benchmark
items.abstract: Experimental polymer property data are scarce and costly, whereas large language models (LLMs) have absorbed much of the chemical literature and can be queried for a fraction of a cent per polymer. We ask whether LLM-produced data can replace or supplement experimental data for predicting the glass transition temperature (Tg). With Claude Sonnet 5 as the teacher we built two synthetic datasets for USD 10.28: a generated set of 7,912 polymers whose structures and Tg values were both written by the LLM, and a labeled set of 9,925 hypothetical PI1M polymers whose Tg the LLM predicted. Both were cleaned with RDKit, deduplicated with a cut-invariant polymer key, and purged of every polymer of a held-out test set (1,471 polymers) and validation set (589) drawn from a curated experimental collection. A fine-tuned MoLFormer student was trained along a learning curve of 250 to 5,297 real polymers, with and without a preceding stage on synthetic data, and compared with a fingerprint random forest, two controls (self-training pseudo-labels and shuffled labels) and the teacher’s own zero-shot predictions, over 5 seeds. Trained on synthetic data alone, the student reached a mean absolute error (MAE) of 36.8 ◦C (generated) and 38.5 ◦C (labeled), within about 1 ◦C of the teacher (37.3 ◦C) and far from a student trained on all real data (25.2 ◦C). Synthetic data helped only when real data were scarce: with 250 or 500 real polymers, a synthetic first stage reduced the MAE by 3 ◦C to 5 ◦C on average and on every seed, a gain that shuffled labels abolished and that free self-training pseudo-labels reproduced only in part; against a baseline trained with more patient early stopping it was 3 ◦C to 4 ◦C at 250 real polymers and about 2 ◦C at 500; with 5,297 real polymers the gain was below 1 ◦C and not distinguishable from zero. Of the unique generated polymers, 8.3 % were copies of real polymers, 56 % of the valid generated pairs were repeats, and the teacher’s labels were rounded to a few values and shifted to lower Tg. LLM-produced data are thus a cheap and, below a few hundred measurements, useful supplement, not a substitute for measurements.
items.authors: Rostislav Rusev
items.title_zh: 基于语言模型的聚合物玻璃转变预测训练数据：受控基准研究
items.summary_zh: 实验聚合物性质数据稀缺且成本高昂，而大型语言模型（LLMs）已吸收大量化学文献，可以以极低的成本查询聚合物数据。本文探讨LLM生成的数据是否可以替代或补充实验数据以预测玻璃转变温度（Tg）。我们使用Claude Sonnet 5构建了两个合成数据集，分别为7912个聚合物的结构和Tg值由LLM生成，以及9925个假设PI1M聚合物的Tg值由LLM预测。数据经过RDKit清洗、去重，并剔除来自实验集合的测试集和验证集中的聚合物。通过对比不同模型，使用合成数据训练的模型在Tg预测中达到平均绝对误差（MAE）为36.8°C（生成数据）和38.5°C（标记数据），接近教师模型的37.3°C，远高于仅使用真实数据训练的学生模型的25.2°C。合成数据在真实数据不足时提供了帮助。
items.l1_lead: 大型语言模型生成的聚合物数据可以有效补充实验数据，显著提高玻璃转变温度预测的准确性。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了基于大型语言模型（LLMs）生成的聚合物数据在预测玻璃转变温度（Tg）方面的有效性，旨在解决实验聚合物性质数据稀缺且成本高昂的问题。研究中，作者使用Claude Sonnet 5构建了两个合成数据集：一个包含7912个聚合物的结构及其Tg值，另一个则是9925个假设PI1M聚合物的Tg值。这些数据经过RDKit进行清洗和去重，确保测试集和验证集中不包含来自实验集合的聚合物。

通过对比不同模型的预测结果，研究发现，使用合成数据训练的模型在Tg预测中表现出色，平均绝对误差（MAE）为36.8°C（生成数据）和38.5°C（标记数据），与教师模型的37.3°C相近，明显优于仅使用真实数据训练的学生模型，其MAE为25.2°C。这一结果表明，在真实数据不足的情况下，合成数据能够有效补充实验数据，提升模型的预测能力。

总的来说，本文的研究结果支持了LLM生成的数据在聚合物玻璃转变温度预测中的应用潜力，展示了合成数据在科学研究中的重要性，尤其是在数据获取困难的领域。

items.title: Experimental Data Analysis and Improved Cytochrome P450 Site-of-Metabolism Prediction for Drug Discovery
items.abstract: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes mediate the oxidative metabolism of most marketed drugs, making early prediction of their sites of metabolism (SoMs) essential for addressing metabolic liabilities. In this work, we present a substantial update to our hybrid docking/quantum mechanics SoM prediction tool IMPACTS (J. Chem. Inf. Model., 2012, 52, 2471-2483). This update is evaluated on newly curated, fully annotated datasets containing over 2,400 datapoints and spanning nine human isoforms; these datasets are released to the community in MOL2 and JSON formats. Technical implementations presented in this work include 1) development of a three-dimensional solvent-accessible surface area correction to the precomputed activation energies, 2) design and integration of a highly efficient L-BFGS optimizer, and 3) elimination of a filter that had been historically used to remove unproductive binding modes. We follow these updates with extensive benchmarking and analysis on the newly curated datasets, where we show 1) achievement of a global Top-2 accuracy of ~75% across the nine isoforms and 2) the effective computational cost using the new optimizer was less than 1 minute per metabolite for eight of the nine isoforms. Finally, we present six real-world case studies comprised of approved drugs and discontinued clinical candidates. These case studies illustrate both the practical value and the remaining limitations of our approach.
items.authors: Mihai Burai-Patrascu, Antoine Moitessier, Matej Janezic, Anne Labarre, Kevin Cusack, Joshua Pottel

items.title: Integrative Physics and Machine Learning-Based Optimal Binding Pose Generator for Protein-Ligand Complexes
items.abstract: Accurately identifying the optimal protein–ligand binding pose is crucial for reliable binding affinity prediction, as molecular dynamics–based approaches are highly sensitive to the initial structure. However, there is currently no efficient way to predict such poses. Indeed, we assess the capabilities of three proposed AI-based software solutions (AlphaFold3, Boltz and RoseTTAFold All-Atom) and demonstrate their substantial shortcomings in this context. Here, we present a combined physics-and machine-learning-based method that predicts optimal protein-ligand poses in their relaxed states, enabling rapid and cost-effective downstream estimation of binding affinities. We apply our approach to two targets, tankyrase 2 (TNKS2) and the 3C-like protease (3CLPro), using datasets of 10,000 molecules for each system. Evaluation on an external validation set of approximately 3,000 molecules demonstrates the method’s ability to generalize to previously unseen datasets, aligning with the practical needs of high-throughput drug discovery pipelines that iteratively evaluate new molecules. Our method substantially reduces the need for costly calculations by efficiently filtering out poses unlikely to yield favorable binding affinities upon relaxation.
items.authors: Agastya P Bhati, Jinyu Dong, Sean Black, Shunzhou Wan, Vineeth Gutta, Xibei Zhang
items.title_zh: 基于物理与机器学习的蛋白质-配体最佳结合位点生成器
items.summary_zh: 准确识别蛋白质-配体最佳结合位点对可靠的结合亲和力预测至关重要，但目前尚无高效的预测方法。我们评估了三种基于人工智能的软件解决方案（AlphaFold3、Boltz和RoseTTAFold All-Atom），并展示了它们在此方面的显著不足。本文提出了一种结合物理和机器学习的方法，能够在蛋白质-配体的放松状态下预测最佳结合位点，从而实现快速且经济的结合亲和力估算。我们将该方法应用于两个靶点：tankyrase 2 (TNKS2) 和 3C样蛋白酶 (3CLPro)，每个系统使用10,000个分子的数据集。对约3,000个分子的外部验证集的评估表明，该方法能够推广到未见过的数据集，符合高通量药物发现流程的实际需求。该方法显著减少了对昂贵计算的需求，通过有效过滤不太可能产生有利结合亲和力的位点。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种结合物理与机器学习的新方法，能够高效预测蛋白质-配体最佳结合位点，显著提高结合亲和力估算的准确性和经济性。
items.l2_summary:
准确识别蛋白质-配体最佳结合位点对于可靠的结合亲和力预测至关重要，但目前尚无高效的预测方法。本文评估了三种基于人工智能的软件解决方案，包括AlphaFold3、Boltz和RoseTTAFold All-Atom，结果显示它们在预测最佳结合位点方面存在显著不足。为此，研究者提出了一种结合物理和机器学习的方法，能够在蛋白质-配体的放松状态下有效预测最佳结合位点，从而实现快速且经济的结合亲和力估算。

该方法的应用对象为两个靶点：tankyrase 2 (TNKS2) 和3C样蛋白酶 (3CLPro)，每个系统均使用了10,000个分子的数据库进行训练。通过对约3,000个分子的外部验证集进行评估，研究表明该方法能够有效推广至未见过的数据集，满足高通量药物发现流程的实际需求。此外，该方法显著减少了对昂贵计算资源的需求，通过有效过滤不太可能产生有利结合亲和力的位点，从而提高了预测的效率和准确性。

综上所述，本文提出的基于物理与机器学习相结合的蛋白质-配体最佳结合位点生成器，展示了在药物发现领域的潜在应用价值，尤其是在降低计算成本和提高预测准确性方面，具有重要的科学意义和实际应用前景。

items.title: One network to link them all: an untargeted multi-metabolomics-methods network
items.abstract: Metabolomics aims to cover a large range of metabolites from polar metabolites to hydrophobic lipids. Therefore, multiple chromatographic methods – such as reversed-phase liquid chromatography (RPLC) or hydrophilic interaction chromatography (HILIC) – are combined to provide a comprehensive overview. The resulting tables need to be combined afterward for data analysis, but several metabolites might be detected across multiple methods. Currently, it is only possible to deal with such multiple entries for identified metabolites. There is a strong requirement for data fusion strategies beyond the simple concatenation of individual peak tables. Networks have been shown to represent a powerful tool for metabolomics data analysis. Feature-based molecular networking, or ion identity networking, is a modern tool for reconstructing biochemical knowledge from metabolomics data. Here, we developed a molecular network across multiple acquisition methods to provide a more comprehensive combination of data and metabolite identification. MS/MS spectra between the different LC-method datasets were compared to merge features. Within single chromatographic methods, ion mode matching based on predefined adducts was used to identify metabolites. Within single-ionization modes, spectra were matched based on GNPS mass-shift cosine similarity. A large network of 4,862 nodes and 401,387 edges was generated based on the different connections. The network was tested on several blood-related matrices. Analyses were performed using RPLC-MS for mid- to non-polar metabolites and HILIC-MS for polar metabolites. Identification was performed using in-house and external spectral libraries, as well as prediction software such as Sirius. Well-known metabolites detected in all tested analytical methods, such as tryptophan, were successfully connected. Data were then mined for new metabolites and associations.
items.authors: Pauline Couacault, Sandra Costa González, Clément Frainay, Fabien Jourdan, Michael Witting
items.title_zh: 一个网络连接所有：无靶向多代谢组学方法网络
items.summary_zh: 代谢组学旨在覆盖从极性代谢物到疏水性脂质的广泛代谢物。因此，结合多种色谱方法（如反相液相色谱RPLC和亲水性相互作用色谱HILIC）以提供全面的概述。生成的数据表需要合并进行分析，但多个方法可能检测到相同的代谢物。目前，仅能处理已识别代谢物的多重条目，急需超越简单连接的数据显示融合策略。网络已被证明是代谢组学数据分析的强大工具。我们开发了一个跨多种采集方法的分子网络，以提供更全面的数据和代谢物识别。不同LC方法数据集之间的MS/MS光谱进行了比较以合并特征。通过基于预定义加合物的离子模式匹配识别代谢物，并在单一离子化模式下基于GNPS质量偏移余弦相似性匹配光谱。最终构建了一个包含4,862个节点和401,387条边的大型网络。
items.l1_lead: 我们开发了一种无靶向多代谢组学方法网络，通过结合多种色谱技术和分子网络分析，实现了对广泛代谢物的全面识别和数据融合。
items.l2_summary:
代谢组学是一门旨在全面覆盖从极性代谢物到疏水性脂质的广泛代谢物的学科。为了实现这一目标，研究者们结合了多种色谱方法，如反相液相色谱（RPLC）和亲水性相互作用色谱（HILIC），以提供更为全面的代谢物概述。然而，在数据分析过程中，生成的数据表需要合并，而不同的方法可能会检测到相同的代谢物。目前的技术主要集中在处理已识别代谢物的多重条目上，亟需发展超越简单连接的数据显示融合策略。

为了解决这一问题，研究团队开发了一个跨多种采集方法的分子网络，以提供更全面的数据和代谢物识别。通过比较不同液相色谱（LC）方法数据集之间的质谱（MS/MS）光谱，研究者们能够有效合并特征。具体而言，研究采用基于预定义加合物的离子模式匹配来识别代谢物，并在单一离子化模式下，利用GNPS质量偏移余弦相似性匹配光谱进行分析。最终，构建了一个包含4,862个节点和401,387条边的大型网络，这一网络为代谢组学数据分析提供了强大的工具。

这一研究不仅展示了多代谢组学方法的潜力，也为未来的代谢物识别和数据分析提供了新的思路和方法，推动了代谢组学领域的发展。通过这种网络连接的方式，研究者能够更全面地理解代谢物之间的关系，从而为生物学研究和临床应用提供更为丰富的信息。

items.title: Origin of Reagent-Dependent Diastereoselectivity in Grignard Additions to a TADDOL-Derived α-Ketiminophosphonate
items.abstract: Grignard additions to a TADDOL-derived -ketiminophosphonate display pronounced reagent-dependent diastereoselectivity, with dr values of 94:6 for methylmagnesium bromide and 55:45 for 2-naphthylmagnesium bromide. In this study, we carried out DFT calculations showing that dimeric Grignard models coordinate to the phosphoryl and sulfonyl regions of the substrate, restricting C–P bond rotation and enabling facial differentiation. The nature of the Grignard reagent modulates the organisation of the reactive complex and the relative stability of the competing transition structures, providing a mechanistic rationale for the contrasting stereochemical
items.authors: Adrián López-Francés, Javier Vicario, Abel de Cózar

items.title: Interlayer Mismatch and Solvated Intermediates Control Spacer Mixing in 2D Perovskites
items.abstract: Organic spacer mixing is a versatile strategy for tuning the structure and properties of two-dimensional layered halide perovskites (2DLHPs), yet the factors that govern the resulting mixing configuration remain poorly understood. Here we investigate mixtures of alkyl monoammonium Ruddlesden–Popper (RP) and alkyl diammonium Dion–Jacobson (DJ) 2DLHPs and identify three structural outcomes: alloying, phase separation, and superlattice formation. Across twenty spacer combinations, the interlayer-spacing mismatch between the parent perovskites largely determines the outcome, with small mismatch favoring alloys and large mismatch favoring phase separation. A superlattice phase with a period exceeding either parent, consistent with alternating RP and DJ layers, forms only at large mismatch and only for blends containing 1,4-butanediammonium (DC4). In situ absorption spectroscopy and single-crystal structure determination reveal that superlattice formation proceeds through a dimethylformamide (DMF)-containing intermediate in which DC4 and n-pentylammonium (C5) occupy distinct bridging and intercalated crystallographic sites, producing an ordered precursor that converts to the superlattice upon annealing. Structural mismatch and intermediate-phase chemistry together govern alloying, phase separation, and superlattice formation in mixed-spacer 2DLHPs.
items.authors: Yunhao Wei, Perry W. Martin, Rae A. Hunter, Bobby G. Duersch, Ryan T. VanderLinden, Connor G. Bischak
items.title_zh: 层间不匹配与溶剂中间体控制二维钙钛矿的间隔体混合
items.summary_zh: 有机间隔体混合是一种调节二维层状卤化钙钛矿（2DLHPs）结构和性质的多功能策略，但影响混合配置的因素仍不清楚。本文研究了烷基单铵Ruddlesden–Popper（RP）和烷基双铵Dion–Jacobson（DJ）2DLHP的混合物，识别出三种结构结果：合金化、相分离和超晶格形成。在二十种间隔体组合中，母体钙钛矿之间的层间间距不匹配在很大程度上决定了结果，小的不匹配有利于合金化，而大的不匹配则有利于相分离。超晶格相的周期超过任一母体，仅在大不匹配且含有1,4-丁二胺（DC4）的混合物中形成。原位吸收光谱和单晶结构测定表明，超晶格形成通过含有二甲基甲酰胺（DMF）的中间体进行，其中DC4和正戊基铵（C5）占据不同的桥接和插层晶体学位置，产生有序前驱体，经过退火转变为超晶格。结构不匹配和中间相化学共同决定了混合间隔体2DLHPs中的合金化、相分离和超晶格形成。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，二维钙钛矿的间隔体混合结果受层间不匹配和溶剂中间体的共同影响，小的不匹配促进合金化，而大的不匹配则导致相分离和超晶格形成。
items.l2_summary:
本文研究了有机间隔体混合对二维层状卤化钙钛矿（2DLHPs）结构和性质的影响，重点分析了烷基单铵Ruddlesden–Popper（RP）和烷基双铵Dion–Jacobson（DJ）2DLHP的混合物。研究识别出三种主要的结构结果：合金化、相分离和超晶格形成。通过对二十种不同间隔体组合的分析，发现母体钙钛矿之间的层间间距不匹配是决定混合结果的关键因素。具体而言，小的不匹配有利于合金化，而大的不匹配则倾向于导致相分离。超晶格相的形成仅在大不匹配且含有1,4-丁二胺（DC4）的混合物中观察到，其周期超过任一母体。

研究还通过原位吸收光谱和单晶结构测定，揭示了超晶格的形成过程是通过含有二甲基甲酰胺（DMF）的中间体进行的。在这一过程中，DC4和正戊基铵（C5）分别占据不同的桥接和插层晶体学位置，形成有序的前驱体，经过退火处理后转变为超晶格。这一发现表明，结构不匹配和中间相化学共同决定了混合间隔体2DLHPs中的合金化、相分离和超晶格的形成。

综上所述，本文的研究为理解二维钙钛矿的结构调控提供了新的视角，强调了层间不匹配和溶剂中间体在调节材料性质中的重要作用。

items.title: Estimand Divergence Between Static Docking and Molecular Dynamics as a Triage Filter for Antimalarial Leads
items.abstract: Using a curated collection derived from 396 African natural products and 454 synthetic antimalarials, we evaluated a multi-target docking framework across 136 wild-type and mutant receptor states of PfDHFR and PfCRT.On a primary candidate cohort (n = 12), a Resistance-Resilience Score (RRS) provided a five-tier stratification decoupling predicted wild-type binding strength from mutant-state score retention.Explicit-solvent molecular dynamics (MD) simulations showed a directional divergence in 87.5 % (7/8; 95% Wilson CI 52.9-97.8%, n = 8) of matched candidate-target states, wherein dynamic pocket relaxation retained poses where static grid docking predicted score penalties.At single-replicate scope this divergence is a protocol-local calibration signal: static docking scores and short MD trajectories provide complementary, non-equivalent triage metrics for natural product lead optimization.
items.authors: Myke Vital SAO TEMGOUA, Jean-Pierre TCHAPET NJAFA, Penabei SAMAFOU, Fon Wilfred MBACHAM, Serge Guy NANA ENGO

items.title: Steric Repulsion Driven Formation of a 3D Covalent Organic Framework Polymorph with Exceptionally High Surface Area
items.abstract: Dimensional polymorphism, in which the same molecular building blocks form frameworks of different dimensionality, offers a direct route to distinct pore architectures in covalent organic frameworks (COFs). True 2D/3D polymorphism remains rare, since linkers capable of forming both 2D and 3D COFs tend to favor 2D structures. Accessing 3D polymorphs remains a challenge. We investigated the dimensional polymorphism in an imine-linked COF based on a terphenyl tetraaldehyde linker core, which is functionalized with two bulky methyl benzoate groups, and p-phenylenediamine. The tetraaldehyde linker can adopt planar or pseudo-tetrahedral conformations, while the methyl benzoate groups introduce steric crowding within the framework. Under a wide range of conditions, the system forms a 2D-kgm COF, whereas precise control over small amounts of water gives access to a second highly crystalline and highly porous 3D-dia COF. This phase is retained only after supercritical CO2 activation, while the 2D-kgm COF is retained with and without scCO2, highlighting the importance of activation in the search for 3D phases. The steric crowding appears to limit the degree of interpenetration, enabling the 3D-dia phase to reach a much higher BET surface area of up to 3883 m2 g-1 and a substantial high-pressure CO2 uptake of 31.9 mmol g-1 at 273 K and 19.5 bar compared with the 2D-kgm phase. These results show that steric interactions can shift the balance between competing dimensional polymorphs, while limiting the degree of interpenetration, leading to a compelling route towards materials with exceptionally high surface areas and high CO2 uptake.
items.authors: Alena Winter, Simona Bassoli, Emma Regincós Martí, David J. Ashworth, Farzad Hamdi, Alaa Shaikhqasem
items.title_zh: 立体排斥驱动的高比表面积3D共价有机框架多晶型形成
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种基于三苯基四醛连接核心的亚胺连接共价有机框架（COF）的维度多晶型，连接核心功能化有两个笨基甲酸酯基团和对苯二胺。该四醛连接体可采用平面或伪四面体构象，而甲基苯甲酸酯基团则在框架内引入了立体拥挤。在广泛的条件下，该系统形成了2D-kgm COF，而对水的精确控制则获得了第二种高度结晶且多孔的3D-dia COF。该相仅在超临界CO2激活后保留，而2D-kgm COF在有无超临界CO2的情况下均可保留，强调了激活在寻找3D相中的重要性。立体拥挤似乎限制了交错程度，使得3D-dia相的BET比表面积高达3883 m²/g，且在273 K和19.5 bar下的高压CO2吸附量为31.9 mmol/g，相较于2D-kgm相显著提高。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了立体排斥驱动下，三苯基四醛连接的亚胺共价有机框架可形成高比表面积的3D多晶型，显著提升了CO2吸附性能。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了一种基于三苯基四醛连接核心的亚胺连接共价有机框架（Covalent Organic Framework, COF）的维度多晶型。该连接核心功能化有两个苯基甲酸酯基团和对苯二胺，四醛连接体可采用平面或伪四面体构象，而甲基苯甲酸酯基团则在框架内引入了立体拥挤。研究发现，在广泛的条件下，该系统形成了二维（2D）kgm COF，而通过对水的精确控制，则获得了第二种高度结晶且多孔的三维（3D）dia COF。值得注意的是，该3D相仅在超临界二氧化碳（supercritical CO2）激活后得以保留，而2D-kgm COF在有无超临界CO2的情况下均可稳定存在，这强调了激活过程在寻找3D相中的重要性。

立体拥挤的存在似乎限制了框架的交错程度，使得3D-dia相的比表面积（BET比表面积）高达3883 m²/g，显示出其优越的结构特性。此外，在273 K和19.5 bar的条件下，该3D相的高压二氧化碳吸附量达到31.9 mmol/g，相较于2D-kgm相显著提高。这些结果表明，通过调控立体排斥效应，可以有效地设计和合成具有高比表面积的3D COF，为未来在气体存储和分离等领域的应用提供了新的思路和可能性。

items.title: Optimizing Affinity and Pharmacokinetics of a Cysteine-sulfoxide Derivative as Potential Inhibitor of BACE-1 using Fragment Growing and Molecular Dynamics
items.abstract: Alliin (S-(2-propenyl)-L-cysteine sulfoxide) was initially identified as a potential inhibitor of BACE-1, with the ability to chelate the catalytic dyad, but with very poor pharmacokinetics. We aimed to optimize these pharmacokinetic parameters, with a possible gain in affinity by growing the ligand towards the sub-pocket of the active site under the flaps. We employed fragment growing, implemented in the ligand designer module of Schrodinger, to extend 2-propenyl-alliin (a derivative of alliin) from both ends, with the multiparameter optimization (MPO) score as a guide. Select hits were further validated using molecular dynamics simulations for 500ns in explicit water. Ligands C37, C47, and C57 showed MPO scores above 0.9 with great improvements in LogP ranging from 1.129 to 2.147 and MW from 358g/mol to 384g/mol compared to -0.421 and 225.35g/mol in 2-propenyl-alliin, respectively. All the derivatives maintained an iron-clad charged contacts with the aspartic dyad throughout the simulation; while C47 and C57 made π-π interactions with Phe112 under the flap, using their pyridine side chains. Global root mean square deviations (RMSD), ligand RMSD, and root mean square fluctuations showed very stable ligand-BACE-1 complexes. Binding free energies (BFE; kcal/mol), computed using the MMGBSA, were two-fold higher (in C47, -52.29 ± 5.56 kcal/mol and C57, -59.40 ± 4.66) than that of the verubecestat (-26.78± 3.91), or alliin (−33.82 ± 4.25) in the previously reported work. However, the ligand-bound BACE-1 maintained an open conformation (distance D0 13.0Å). We have utilized fragment growing and molecular dynamics to provide derivatives of cysteinyl sulfoxides with improved pharmacokinetics, hydrophobic contact with Phe112, and improved BFE, while maintaining interactions with the catalytic dyad of BACE-1.
items.authors: Wande M. Oluyemi, Shadrach C. Eze, Stephen C. Nnemolisa, Adewumi T. Adeniyi, Salerwe Mosebi, Innocent I. Okagu
items.title_zh: 优化半胱氨酸亚砜衍生物作为BACE-1抑制剂的亲和力与药代动力学
items.summary_zh: 研究对象为半胱氨酸亚砜衍生物Alliin（S-(2-丙烯基)-L-半胱氨酸亚砜），其作为BACE-1的潜在抑制剂，但药代动力学较差。我们通过在活性位点的亚口袋中扩展配体，优化药代动力学参数并提高亲和力。采用Schrodinger的配体设计模块进行片段扩展，以多参数优化（MPO）评分为指导，扩展2-丙烯基-半胱氨酸亚砜。选定的化合物经过500ns的分子动力学模拟验证。化合物C37、C47和C57的MPO评分均超过0.9，LogP显著提高至1.129至2.147，分子量从358g/mol增至384g/mol。所有衍生物在模拟中与天冬氨酸二聚体保持稳定的电荷接触，C47和C57与Phe112形成π-π相互作用。结合自由能（BFE）计算结果显示，C47和C57的BFE分别为-52.29 ± 5.56 kcal/mol和-59.40 ± 4.66 kcal/mol，显著高于2-丙烯基-半胱氨酸亚砜。
items.l1_lead: 通过优化半胱氨酸亚砜衍生物的结构，显著提高了其作为BACE-1抑制剂的亲和力和药代动力学特性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于半胱氨酸亚砜衍生物Alliin（S-(2-丙烯基)-L-半胱氨酸亚砜）作为β-淀粉样前体蛋白酶1（BACE-1）的潜在抑制剂，但其药代动力学表现不佳。为了提高其亲和力和药代动力学参数，研究团队通过在活性位点的亚口袋中扩展配体，进行了优化。采用Schrodinger的配体设计模块进行片段扩展，并以多参数优化（MPO）评分为指导，成功扩展了2-丙烯基-半胱氨酸亚砜。经过500纳秒的分子动力学模拟，选定的化合物C37、C47和C57的MPO评分均超过0.9，显示出良好的优化效果。

在药代动力学方面，这些衍生物的LogP值显著提高，范围从1.129到2.147，分子量也从358 g/mol增加至384 g/mol，表明其在水溶性和脂溶性方面的改善。所有衍生物在模拟中与天冬氨酸二聚体保持稳定的电荷接触，特别是C47和C57与Phe112形成了π-π相互作用，进一步增强了其结合能力。结合自由能（BFE）计算结果显示，C47和C57的BFE分别为-52.29 ± 5.56 kcal/mol和-59.40 ± 4.66 kcal/mol，显著高于原始的2-丙烯基-半胱氨酸亚砜，表明优化后的衍生物在抑制BACE-1方面具有更强的潜力。

综上所述，通过分子设计和动力学模拟，本研究成功优化了半胱氨酸亚砜衍生物的亲和力与药代动力学特性，为其作为BACE-1抑制剂的应用奠定了基础。

items.title: Reconfigurable Flow Reactors Assembled from 3DPrinted Self-Healing Hydrogel Modules
items.abstract: Here, we introduce millimeter-scale fluidic reactors assembled from digital-light-processing (DLP)-printed self-healing hydrogel modules. A poly(acrylic acid-co-2-acrylamidophenylboronic acid)/poly(vinyl alcohol) formulation combines photoprintability with dynamic interfacial association. Printed modules contain straight, curved, branched, looping, and crossing channels, as well as mixing chambers. When brought into contact under ambient conditions, separate modules form liquid-tight interfaces that support continuous flow. Joined elements can subsequently be separated, rearranged, and rejoined to construct new fluidic circuits from the same building blocks. Finally, reactors containing active mixing chambers are used to perform a competitive thiol–maleimide reaction. Changing only the position at which two competing thiols enter the reactor shifts the apparent product ratio from 95:5 to 17:83 or 94:6. These results establish self-healing interfaces as reversible fluidic connections and provide a materials-based strategy for constructing reconfigurable flow reactors.
items.authors: Diego Ciardi, Youssef Elbishbishy, Piet J. M. Swinkels, Andreas Walther

items.title: A Solid-Phase Platform for Site-Specific Thiolation and Thioether Functionalization of DNA Oligonucleotides
items.abstract: Thionucleobases provide distinctive hydrogen-bonding, electronic, and photochemical properties, but their site-specific incorporation into DNA often requires specialized sulfurcontaining phosphoramidites and multistep monomer synthesis. Here, we establish a unified protocol using sodium hydrosulfide (NaSH) and 1,8-diazabicyclo[5.4.0]undec-7-ene (DBU) for direct on-support conversion of 8-bromo-2′-deoxyadenosine (Br 8 dA) to 8-thio-2′deoxyadenosine (s 8 dA), late-stage C8 thioether diversification, and concurrent conversion of Br 8 dA and 4-triazolylthymidine within a single DNA strand. Electrophilic precursor nucleosides were incorporated by standard solid-phase synthesis and subsequently converted while the oligonucleotide remained support-bound. Conversion of Br 8 dA to s 8 dA was first demonstrated using 2-(trimethylsilyl)ethanethiol and subsequently achieved directly with NaSH·xH2O, eliminating the need for a separate fluoride-mediated deprotection step. Substitution at the C8 was compatible with mixed sequences, multiple modifications, and a range of aliphatic and aromatic thiols, enabling late-stage installation of diverse sulfurcontaining functionalities. Application of the same support-bound protocol to 4-triazolylthymidine afforded DNA containing one or more 4-thiothymidine (s 4 T) residues, and both thionucleobases could be generated within the same strand. Products were characterized by strong-anion-exchange high-performance liquid chromatography and electrospray ionization mass spectrometry. This workflow shifts sulfur installation from specialized monomer synthesis to a simple late-stage conversion and provides practical access to site-specifically thiolated and C8-thioether-functionalized DNA.
items.authors: Jagandeep S. Saraya, Nicholas G. Horton, Derek K. O'Flaherty
items.title_zh: 固相平台用于DNA寡核苷酸的位点特异性硫化和硫醚功能化
items.summary_zh: 硫核苷基因提供独特的氢键、电子和光化学特性，但其在DNA中的位点特异性引入通常需要专门的含硫磷酰胺和多步单体合成。本文建立了一种统一的协议，使用氢硫酸钠（NaSH）和1,8-二氮杂双环[5.4.0]十一烯（DBU），实现8-溴-2′-脱氧腺苷（Br 8 dA）直接转化为8-硫-2′-脱氧腺苷（s 8 dA），并在单一DNA链中同时进行Br 8 dA和4-三唑基胸腺嘧啶的转化。通过标准固相合成引入电亲核前体核苷，并在寡核苷酸保持支撑结合的状态下进行转化。首次使用2-(三甲基硅基)乙硫醇证明了Br 8 dA向s 8 dA的转化，随后直接使用NaSH·xH2O实现，省去了单独的氟介导去保护步骤。C8位的取代与混合序列、多重修饰及多种脂肪和芳香硫醇兼容，支持多样化的含硫功能的后期安装。相同的支撑结合协议应用于4-三唑基胸腺嘧啶，获得含有一个或多个4-硫胸腺嘧啶（s 4 T）残基的DNA，并且两种硫核苷基因可以在同一链中生成。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种新方法，通过固相合成实现DNA中位点特异性引入硫核苷，简化了传统的合成步骤，支持多种含硫功能的后期安装。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了一种用于DNA寡核苷酸的位点特异性硫化和硫醚功能化的新方法，旨在简化含硫核苷的合成过程。硫核苷因其独特的氢键、电子和光化学特性，在生物化学研究中具有重要应用。然而，传统的位点特异性引入方法通常需要专门的含硫磷酰胺和复杂的多步合成流程，限制了其广泛应用。

研究中，作者建立了一种统一的合成协议，利用氢硫酸钠（NaSH）和1,8-二氮杂双环[5.4.0]十一烯（DBU），成功将8-溴-2′-脱氧腺苷（Br 8 dA）直接转化为8-硫-2′-脱氧腺苷（s 8 dA）。这一过程不仅简化了合成步骤，还允许在单一DNA链中同时进行Br 8 dA和4-三唑基胸腺嘧啶的转化。通过标准的固相合成方法，研究者引入了电亲核前体核苷，并在寡核苷酸保持支撑结合的状态下进行转化。

值得注意的是，研究首次使用2-(三甲基硅基)乙硫醇证明了Br 8 dA向s 8 dA的转化，随后通过直接使用NaSH·xH2O实现了这一转化，省去了传统方法中单独的氟介导去保护步骤。这一新方法的兼容性也得到了验证，C8位的取代与混合序列、多重修饰及多种脂肪和芳香硫醇的结合均表现良好，支持了多样化的含硫功能的后期安装。

此外，相同的支撑结合协议还被应用于4-三唑基胸腺嘧啶的转化，成功获得了含有一个或多个4-硫胸腺嘧啶（s 4 T）残基的DNA。这表明两种硫核苷基因可以在同一链中生成，为未来的生物化学研究提供了新的工具和思路。整体而言，这项研究不仅为含硫核苷的合成提供了更为高效的策略，也为相关领域的研究奠定了基础。

items.title: μ-Oxo-Bridged Iodine(III) Reagents Enable Catalyst- and Light-Free Fluoro(halo)methyl Radical Generation
items.abstract: While conventional radical fluoroalkylation typically requires exogenous catalysts or photoactivation to overcome significant kinetic barriers, here we report bench-stable μ-oxo-bridged iodine(III) reagents that release fluoro(halo)methyl radicals upon heating without an external catalyst, additive, or light. The resulting radicals initiate cascade cyclizations of methacrylamides and methacrylohydrazides to afford fluorinated oxindoles, pyrazolones, and related heterocycles. Variation of the fluorinated carboxylate ligand within the iodine(III) reagent framework controls the identity of the transferred C1 fragment, thereby providing chlorofluoromethyl, bromofluoromethyl, difluoromethyl, and monofluoromethyl products from a common reagent architecture. The transformation is compatible with structurally diverse and natural-product-derived substrates and proceeds efficiently upon scale-up. By encoding the required bond lability directly into the iodine(III) framework, this strategy establishes a general platform for the catalyst-, additive-, and light-free generation and incorporation of fluorinated C1 radicals into complex molecular frameworks.
items.authors: Anupam Das, Nagarajan Ramkumar, Artis Kinēns, Sergey Belyakov, Andris Antuzevičs, Janis Veliks
items.title_zh: μ-氧桥接碘(III)试剂实现无催化剂和光照的氟(卤)甲基自由基生成
items.summary_zh: 传统的自由基氟烷基化通常需要外源催化剂或光激活以克服显著的动力学障碍。本文报道了一种稳定的μ-氧桥接碘(III)试剂，该试剂在加热条件下释放氟(卤)甲基自由基，无需外部催化剂、添加剂或光照。生成的自由基能够启动甲基丙烯酰胺和甲基丙烯酰肼的级联环化反应，合成氟化的氧吲哚、吡唑酮及相关杂环化合物。通过改变碘(III)试剂框架中的氟化羧酸盐配体，可以控制转移的C1片段的种类，从而从相同的试剂结构中获得氯氟甲基、溴氟甲基、二氟甲基和单氟甲基产物。该转化适用于结构多样的天然产物衍生底物，并在放大时高效进行。通过将所需的键活性直接编码到碘(III)框架中，该策略建立了一个无催化剂、添加剂和光照的氟化C1自由基生成及其在复杂分子框架中引入的一般平台。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，μ-氧桥接碘(III)试剂可在无催化剂和光照的条件下高效生成氟(卤)甲基自由基，推动复杂分子合成。
items.l2_summary:
传统的自由基氟烷基化反应通常依赖外源催化剂或光激活，以克服反应中的动力学障碍。然而，最新研究报道了一种新型的稳定的μ-氧桥接碘(III)试剂，该试剂在加热条件下能够释放氟(卤)甲基自由基，且无需外部催化剂、添加剂或光照。生成的氟(卤)甲基自由基能够有效启动甲基丙烯酰胺和甲基丙烯酰肼的级联环化反应，成功合成了氟化的氧吲哚、吡唑酮及相关的杂环化合物。

研究中，通过改变碘(III)试剂框架中的氟化羧酸盐配体，研究者能够控制转移的C1片段的种类，从而从相同的试剂结构中获得不同的产物，包括氯氟甲基、溴氟甲基、二氟甲基和单氟甲基。这一转化反应适用于多种结构的天然产物衍生底物，并在放大时表现出高效性。通过将所需的键活性直接编码到碘(III)框架中，研究者建立了一个无催化剂、无添加剂和无光照的氟化C1自由基生成平台，并展示了其在复杂分子框架中引入的广泛应用潜力。

这一研究不仅为自由基氟烷基化反应提供了新的思路，也为合成化学领域中无催化剂反应的实现开辟了新的方向，具有重要的理论意义和实际应用价值。

items.title: Mind the coverage gap: The crucial importance of the pH- and potential-dependent surface coverage in oxygen reduction electrocatalysis
items.abstract: Understanding the origins of oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) activity and selectivity on gold electrodes remains a longstanding puzzle in electrocatalysis. In particular, it remains unclear why Au(100) in alkaline media is exceptionally active and selective toward the 4-electron ORR while acidic conditions and other gold surfaces catalyze exclusively 2-electron ORR. We address this question through extensive grand-canonical density functional theory calculations and investigate the pH- and potential-dependent surface coverage and its effect on ORR thermodynamics and kinetics on Au(111) and Au(100) electrodes. Our results reveal that ORR thermodynamics and kinetics are highly sensitive to pH- and potential-dependent surface coverage, an effect largely neglected in previous computational studies. The key steps governing ORR activity and selectivity – O 2 adsorption and O–O bond cleavage – are influenced even more strongly by surface coverage than by electrode potential. By integrating pH- and potential-dependent surface coverages with elementary reaction thermodynamics and kinetics, we propose a mechanism that consistently explains a broad range of voltammetric observations on ORR activity and selectivity trends on Au(100) and Au(111) across reaction conditions; neglecting coverage effects leads to qualitatively incorrect mechanistic predictions. Our findings demonstrate that ORR electrocatalysis on gold is not governed only by the intrinsic properties of pristine surfaces. Instead, ORR thermodynamics, kinetics, mechanisms, activity, and selectivity depend explicitly on the interplay between pH, electrode potential, surface coverage, and adsorbate–adsorbate interactions which together define the local reaction environment. More broadly, our work establishes the central importance of pH- and potential-dependent surface coverage in (computational) electrocatalysis.
items.authors: Kayvan Moradi, Marko M. Melander
items.title_zh: 关注覆盖率差距：pH和电位依赖的表面覆盖在氧还原电催化中的重要性
items.summary_zh: 理解金电极上氧还原反应（ORR）活性和选择性的来源仍然是电催化中的一个长期难题。尤其是，Au(100)在碱性介质中为何对4电子ORR表现出异常的活性和选择性，而酸性条件及其他金表面则仅催化2电子ORR，仍不清楚。我们通过广泛的广义势密度泛函理论计算，研究了pH和电位依赖的表面覆盖及其对Au(111)和Au(100)电极上ORR热力学和动力学的影响。结果显示，ORR的热力学和动力学对pH和电位依赖的表面覆盖高度敏感，这一效应在以往的计算研究中被忽视。控制ORR活性和选择性的关键步骤——O₂吸附和O–O键断裂，受到表面覆盖的影响甚至比电极电位更强。我们提出了一种机制，能够一致解释Au(100)和Au(111)在不同反应条件下的ORR活性和选择性趋势，忽视覆盖效应会导致定性错误的机制预测。我们的研究结果表明，ORR的活性和选择性受表面覆盖显著影响。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，氧还原反应的活性和选择性受到pH和电位依赖的表面覆盖显著影响，尤其在Au(100)和Au(111)电极上表现出不同的反应趋势。
items.l2_summary:
在电催化领域，理解金电极上氧还原反应（ORR）的活性和选择性一直是一个长期的挑战。尤其是，Au(100)在碱性介质中表现出对4电子ORR的异常活性和选择性，而在酸性条件及其他金表面上则仅催化2电子ORR，这一现象的原因尚不明确。为了解释这一差异，我们通过广泛的广义势密度泛函理论计算，研究了pH和电位依赖的表面覆盖对Au(111)和Au(100)电极上ORR热力学和动力学的影响。研究结果表明，ORR的热力学和动力学对pH和电位依赖的表面覆盖高度敏感，这一效应在以往的计算研究中往往被忽视。

具体而言，控制ORR活性和选择性的关键步骤——O₂的吸附和O–O键的断裂，受到表面覆盖的影响，甚至比电极电位的影响更为显著。我们提出了一种机制，能够一致解释Au(100)和Au(111)在不同反应条件下的ORR活性和选择性趋势。研究发现，忽视表面覆盖效应可能导致对反应机制的定性错误预测。总的来说，我们的研究结果强调了表面覆盖在ORR活性和选择性中的重要性，表明其对电催化反应的影响不可小觑。

items.title: A Dinucleating β-Thio-δ-Diiminate Ligand Enables Metal-Dependent CO2 Reactivity in Homo- and Heterobimetallic Zn and Cu Complexes
items.abstract: Herein, we investigate the β-thio-δ-diimine (BTDDI) ligand, recently reported as a sulfur containing analogue of the established BODDI framework, as a platform for mono- and bimetallic Cu(I) and Zn(II) chemistry. Sequential metalation enables selective access to homo- and heterobimetallic complexes, including the first structurally characterised Cu/Zn derivative of this ligand class. Replacement of the central oxygen donor by sulfur expands the dinuclear framework, resulting in significantly increased metal–metal separations. The reactivity of these complexes towards CO 2 is strongly dependent on both metal identity and nuclearity: monometallic Cu(I) and Zn(II) complexes and the homobimetallic Cu(I) analogue are unreactive, whereas the Cu/Zn and di-Zn complexes undergo CO 2 activation. The di-Zn complex undergoes selective C–C bond formation at the γ-position of the ligand backbone to give a reversibly formed carboxylate-containing product featuring an unusual tripodal [N,S,O] donor motif. Isotopic labelling, spectroscopic and structural studies establish incorporation of CO 2 into the ligand framework, while DFT calculations reveal substantially lower barriers to γ-C insertion for the bimetallic complexes and identify Zn(II) as a key contributor to stabilisation of the resulting carboxylate through Zn–O interactions and subsequent dimerisation. These results establish a mode of CO 2 activation in which ligand-centred reactivity is coupled to metal-centred substrate stabilisation, with metal identity and nuclearity determining the outcome of the reaction.
items.authors: Jamie Allen, Diney S. Shanfrezan, Grace E. Linford-Wood, Tobias Krämer, Alexander F. R. Kilpatrick
items.title_zh: 一种双核β-硫-δ-二亚胺配体促进金属依赖的CO2反应性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了β-硫-δ-二亚胺（BTDDI）配体，该配体是已知BODDI框架的含硫类似物，作为单金属和双金属Cu(I)及Zn(II)化学的基础。通过顺序金属化实现了选择性合成同种和异种双金属络合物，包括该配体类的首个结构表征的Cu/Zn衍生物。中心氧供体被硫替换，扩展了双核框架，显著增加了金属间距。这些络合物对CO2的反应性强烈依赖于金属的种类和核数：单金属Cu(I)和Zn(II)络合物以及同种双金属Cu(I)类似物不活泼，而Cu/Zn和二Zn络合物则能进行CO2活化。二Zn络合物在配体主链的γ位选择性形成C–C键，生成一种可逆形成的含羧酸盐的产物，具有不寻常的三足[N,S,O]供体结构。各类实验和DFT计算表明，二金属络合物的γ-C插入具有显著较低的能量障碍，并确认Zn(II)通过Zn–O相互作用和后续二聚化在羧酸盐的稳定化中起关键作用。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，双核β-硫-δ-二亚胺配体能显著提高Cu/Zn络合物对CO2的反应性，尤其是二Zn络合物在羧酸盐生成中表现出较低的能量障碍。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于一种新型的双核β-硫-δ-二亚胺（BTDDI）配体，该配体是已知BODDI框架的含硫类似物，旨在探讨其在单金属和双金属Cu(I)及Zn(II)化学中的应用。研究通过顺序金属化的方法，成功合成了同种和异种双金属络合物，并首次对该配体类的Cu/Zn衍生物进行了结构表征。研究发现，中心氧供体被硫替换后，双核框架得以扩展，金属间距显著增加。

在CO2的反应性方面，研究表明金属的种类和核数对反应性有显著影响。单金属Cu(I)和Zn(II)络合物以及同种双金属Cu(I)络合物表现出不活泼的特性，而Cu/Zn和二Zn络合物则能够有效地进行CO2的活化。特别是二Zn络合物在配体主链的γ位选择性形成C–C键，生成一种可逆形成的含羧酸盐的产物，其结构具有不寻常的三足[N,S,O]供体特征。

通过一系列实验和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，研究确认了二金属络合物的γ-C插入反应具有显著较低的能量障碍。此外，Zn(II)通过Zn–O相互作用和后续的二聚化过程在羧酸盐的稳定化中发挥了关键作用。这些发现为理解金属配体在CO2反应性中的作用提供了新的视角，并为未来的催化剂设计奠定了基础。

items.title: Machine learning-enabled prediction of dynamic vertical triplet energies underscores the role of vibrational anharmonicity in energy transfer
items.abstract: The concept of triplet energy has long served as the operative predictor of energy transfer reactivity in photochemistry, yet its reliable computational determination remains challenging for many organic systems. The recently introduced dynamic vertical triplet energy (DvTE) framework recasts triplet energy as a statistical ensemble of instantaneous vertical gaps sampled from molecular dynamics trajectories, achieving mean absolute errors of 1.7 kcal/mol against experimental data, but at a computational cost that limits its broader application. Here, DvTE-ML is introduced, which extends machine-learned interatomic potentials to dynamic, ensemble-based prediction of excited-state properties. Built by fine-tuning the MACE-OMOL foundation model, DvTE-ML incorporates path integral molecular dynamics to capture nuclear quantum effects explicitly, alongside an iterative filtering workflow that addresses a state-error contamination risk intrinsic to open-shell training data. Applied to a diverse set of 52 organic molecules, including biologically relevant systems previously intractable at the reference level of theory, DvTE-ML matches the accuracy of the original DvTE framework. Beyond this validation, higher-resolution sampling reveals that gap distributions can deviate from the normal form previously assumed, with vibrational anharmonicity producing skewed distributions, providing additional insights into the mechanisms of triplet energy transfer.
items.authors: Mihai V. Popescu
items.title_zh: 机器学习预测动态垂直三重态能量及其振动非谐性的作用
items.summary_zh: 三重态能量概念长期以来是光化学中能量转移反应性的预测指标，但其在许多有机体系中的可靠计算仍具挑战性。最近提出的动态垂直三重态能量（DvTE）框架将三重态能量视为从分子动力学轨迹中采样的瞬时垂直间隙的统计集合，平均绝对误差为1.7 kcal/mol，然而计算成本限制了其更广泛的应用。本文引入DvTE-ML，扩展了机器学习的原子间势能到动态、基于集合的激发态性质预测。DvTE-ML通过微调MACE-OMOL基础模型，结合路径积分分子动力学显式捕捉核量子效应，并采用迭代过滤工作流程解决开放壳层训练数据固有的状态误差污染风险。应用于52种有机分子，包括以前在理论参考水平上难以处理的生物相关体系，DvTE-ML的准确性与原始DvTE框架相匹配。更高分辨率的采样显示，间隙分布可能偏离之前假设的正态形式，振动非谐性导致分布偏斜。
items.l1_lead: 动态垂直三重态能量（DvTE）框架结合机器学习方法，成功预测有机分子的激发态性质，并揭示振动非谐性对能量间隙分布的影响。
items.l2_summary:
三重态能量在光化学中被视为预测能量转移反应性的关键指标，但在许多有机体系中，其可靠计算仍面临挑战。为了解决这一问题，最近提出的动态垂直三重态能量（Dynamic vertical triplet energy, DvTE）框架将三重态能量视为从分子动力学轨迹中采样的瞬时垂直间隙的统计集合。该框架的平均绝对误差为1.7 kcal/mol，但由于计算成本的限制，其应用范围受到制约。为此，本文引入了DvTE-ML，通过扩展机器学习的原子间势能模型，旨在动态且基于集合地预测激发态性质。DvTE-ML通过微调MACE-OMOL基础模型，结合路径积分分子动力学（Path Integral Molecular Dynamics）显式捕捉核量子效应，并采用迭代过滤工作流程来解决开放壳层训练数据中固有的状态误差污染风险。

在对52种有机分子的应用中，包括一些在理论参考水平上难以处理的生物相关体系，DvTE-ML的准确性与原始DvTE框架相匹配。更高分辨率的采样结果显示，间隙分布可能偏离之前假设的正态形式，振动非谐性导致了分布的偏斜。这一发现为理解三重态能量的动态特性提供了新的视角，并为未来的研究奠定了基础。通过DvTE-ML的引入，研究者们能够更有效地预测激发态性质，从而推动光化学领域的进一步发展。

items.title: Hyperlocal PM2.5 Exposure and Health Burden Disparities Revealed by a Taxi-Based Mobile Monitoring Platform in Shenzhen
items.abstract: Although fine particles (PM 2.5 ) concentrations in China have declined over the past decade, exposure disparities persist at hyperlocal scales. We conducted a six-month mobile monitoring campaign in Shenzhen, where four taxis with calibrated low-cost sensors gathered 24.6 million 1 Hz measurements (~3,700 hours) across 550 km² and 7.3 million residents. We developed a novel application of a multi-source XGBoost (MS-XGB) framework that integrates mobile and fixed-site station data to reconstruct a road-network PM 2.5 dataset at 30 m × 1 h resolution, filling 98% of missing observations. Validation demonstrates strong agreement with both mobile observations (R 2 = 0.97) and data from fixed regulatory monitoring stations (Pearson r = 0.82). We used the road-network dataset to generate a 100 m × 100 m population grid exposure map and benchmarked it against two conventional exposure assessment approaches that rely solely on fixed-site regulatory stations. Relative to MS-XGB, conventional methods systematically underestimated long-term PM 2.5 exposure, with grid-level differences of up to 15 μg/m³. Population-weighted mean exposure was higher in urban villages (16.51 µg/m³) than in other urban areas (14.41 µg/m³), with hotspots 52.5% more likely to occur in urban villages. In Longhua, high exposure was concentrated specifically in urban villages, indicating that district-level averages can mask substantial intra-district heterogeneity. In Nanshan, 40% of elderly residents live in high-exposure areas, compared with 34% of children aged 0–14 and 33% of adults aged 15–59, suggesting that older adults bear a disproportionate exposure burden and face elevated health risks. Our findings demonstrate that mobile-monitoring-based hyperlocal exposure assessment is essential for revealing true PM 2.5 exposure inequalities across population groups and spatial environments that are overlooked by conventional fixed-site approaches.
items.authors: Zilin Guo, Ziyang Jiang, Shutong Jiang, Tongshu Zheng, Yutong Liang

items.title: Triplet Pruning and Spatial Decomposition in M3GNet: Accuracy and Memory Trade-offs in Scaling Graph Neural Network Potentials
items.abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials of several functional forms now support large-scale atomistic simulation.Within this landscape, graph neural network (GNN) potentials such as M3GNet offer transferable message-passing models, but their application to very large systems remains limited by graph construction, message passing, and differentiable force-evaluation costs.In M3GNet, the explicit angular pathway is represented through line-graph triplets, whose construction can dominate inference cost.Here we examine the scalability of M3GNet molecular dynamics via inference-time triplet pruning.We first show that an apparent insensitivity to triplet removal in inspected MatGL implementations originates from an incorrect parent-bond index mapping; after correction, removing triplets substantially increases static energy, force, stress, and property-prediction errors.In short molecular-dynamics trajectories, however, the structural response is strongly system dependent, with some systems showing modest radial-distribution-function changes despite a threefold reduction in inference cost.We then implement and evaluate an owned-core/halo spatial chunking scheme that bounds activation memory during differentiable force evaluation and enables M3GNet simulations of million-atom alloy cells on GPU hardware.These results show that triplet pruning can provide useful acceleration when validated for the target observable, while spatial decomposition offers a more general route to extending GNN potentials to large atomistic systems.
items.authors: Linh La, Yugam Aggarwal, Truyen Tran, Svetha Venkatesh, Sherif Abdulkader Tawfik

items.title: Residue-Conditioned In-Pocket Design for Paralogue Selectivity
items.abstract: Structure based generative model explore chemical spaces inside the protein active site , typically prioritizing candidates through empirical scoring functions.Few evaluate wthether the results is selective for the intended protein over a close paralogue , and none of them combines that evaluation with residue level conditioning and covalent bounds placement . In this paper we describe a design loop in which each rounds installs one chemical group aimed at one named pocket residue that a pairwise alignment marks as divergent in a chosen anti target , subject while enforcing structural continuity by requiring each successive molecule to retain its predecessor as a substructure. The anti target pocket is built by mutating only the divergent position within the target's own structure , so the two differ at those residues and nowhere else . Across 17 design campaigns the selected scaffold was retained in every final lead . Comparison against 44 reference compounds from the literature that target 12 receptor pair demonstrated preservation of established recognition chemistry in 19 comparisons , against a 12.6% unrelated active decoy rate . generated candidates the structure relationships with established inhibitor , including 78% shared core with imatinib and a 59% with erlotinib while adding alternative chemical strategies . These included residue directed electrophile warhead such as a chloroacetamide targeting ABL1 Cys388, and the generation of a macrocyclic peptidomimetic architecture for KRAS G12C. Together, these results demonstrate an integrated computational framework capable of translating therapeutic objectives and structural evidence into traceable medicinal chemistry design decisions across multiple protein targets.
items.authors: Ahmed amine Sadouk
items.title_zh: 基于残基条件的口袋设计以实现同源选择性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种基于结构的生成模型，旨在通过化学空间探索蛋白质活性位点内的候选分子，并通过经验评分函数优先选择候选者。我们提出了一种设计循环，每轮设计一个化学基团，针对在所选抗靶标中标记为不同的口袋残基，同时要求每个后续分子保留前一个分子的亚结构。抗靶标口袋通过仅突变目标结构中的不同位置构建，使得两者在这些残基上存在差异。经过17次设计实验，所选框架在每个最终候选中均得以保留。与文献中针对12个受体对的44个参考化合物比较，19次比较中保持了已建立的识别化学，且无关活性诱饵率为12.6%。生成的候选分子与已知抑制剂的结构关系良好，包括与伊马替尼有78%的共享核心，与厄洛替尼有59%的共享核心，同时引入了替代化学策略。
items.l1_lead: 本研究提出了一种基于残基条件的口袋设计方法，通过结构生成模型优化蛋白质活性位点的候选分子，实现同源选择性并保持化学结构的有效性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了一种基于结构的生成模型，旨在通过化学空间探索蛋白质活性位点内的候选分子，并利用经验评分函数优先选择这些候选者。研究者提出了一种设计循环，每轮设计一个化学基团，针对在所选抗靶标中标记为不同的口袋残基，同时要求每个后续分子保留前一个分子的亚结构。抗靶标口袋通过仅突变目标结构中的不同位置构建，使得两者在这些残基上存在差异。经过17次设计实验，所选框架在每个最终候选中均得以保留。

在与文献中针对12个受体对的44个参考化合物进行比较时，研究显示在19次比较中保持了已建立的识别化学，且无关活性诱饵率为12.6%。生成的候选分子与已知抑制剂的结构关系良好，具体而言，与伊马替尼（Imatinib）有78%的共享核心，与厄洛替尼（Erlotinib）有59%的共享核心，同时引入了替代化学策略。这些结果表明，基于残基条件的口袋设计方法能够有效实现同源选择性，为药物设计提供了新的思路和方法。

items.title: Photo-oxidation of Dilute Methane in Dairy Barn Air: Pilot Scale Optimization
items.abstract: Low concentration (below 1000 ppm) methane emissions from point sources such as cattle barns remain a significant source of greenhouse gas emissions, and have proven hard to mitigate. Previously, a novel method for methane photo-oxidation using UV light to produce chlorine radicals from chlorine gas, which subsequently oxidize methane, was proposed. Here we present the first real-world experimental results from a pilot scale Methane Eradication Photochemical System (MEPS) deployed at a dairy farm in Denmark. Utilizing electrolysis generated chlorine and UV light, chlorine radicals were produced in a confined photoreactor to effectively oxidize methane. The system demonstrated methane oxidation with a specific energy of 0.32 kWh/gCH4 and 75 % methane removal efficiency at an inlet concentration of 89 ppm. To better understand the operational parameters, the reactor was operated at a variety of different methane concentrations, UV irradiance, airflow rates, and chlorine concentrations. Statistical evaluation indicated that increasing UV power and Cl2 concentration synergistically minimizes specific energy while maximizing removal efficiency. The ability to achieve low specific energy and high removal efficiency underscores the system’s viability. By addressing agricultural emissions, this technology offers a tangible pathway for mitigating atmospheric methane and limiting global temperature overshoot in the 21st century.
items.authors: Morten Krogsbøll, Noah D. Weiss, Hugo S. Russell, Svend Bager, Nickie Fogde, Matthew S. Johnson

items.title: ProtMutMap: Predicting Protein Binding Free Energy Changes Using Multiple-Mutation Networks
items.abstract: Predicting changes in binding free energy ΔΔ G caused by multiple mutations at protein−protein interfaces requires accounting for nonadditive interactions between mutations, which an additive approximation based on single mutations cannot capture, and for the dependence on the computational pathway in stepwise approaches that introduce mutations sequentially. Here, we propose ProtMutMap, a method that integrates information from multiple pathways in a network whose nodes represent target variants and variants containing subsets of their mutations, and whose edges represent free energy perturbation (FEP) calculations for residue substitutions. ProtMutMap simultaneously estimates the binding ΔΔ G of each variant from all edge values using Huber loss. We compared ProtMutMap with the additive approximation and the stepwise method at 30 evaluation points, including intermediate variants, using a multiple-mutation dataset comprising 7 protein complex systems derived from SKEMPI2. ProtMutMap achieved a root mean squared error (RMSE) of 1.13 kcal/mol, lower than that of either comparison method. ProtMutMap also yielded lower prediction errors than Rosetta flex ddG. These comparisons with experimental values demonstrate that integrating multiple pathways through variants containing subsets of the target mutations improves binding ΔΔ G predictions for protein variants with multiple mutations.
items.authors: Kairi Furui, Masahito Ohue

items.title: The Chemistry of the Golgi-Cox Stain
items.abstract: Our review provides both a theoretical discussion and experimental investigation of the Golgi–Cox stain. While this procedure has been a mainstay in the histologist’s toolkit for centuries and is implemented quite straightforwardly, there is still significant uncertainty around the chemistry. As such, it remains unclear how the stain works and, therefore, how it can be improved to be safer, faster, more reliable and work for larger specimens. Here, we provide technical and chemical considerations supplemented with original experimental observation on tissue clearing methods. Our findings suggest that Golgi–Cox staining cannot be understood as a simple process of stain diffusion, but rather as the outcome of interactions between tissue structure, fixation, chromate-mediated redox chemistry, mercury binding, pH, and cellular composition. Membrane and lipid integrity influence impregnation, while chromate-dependent changes in pH and redox state create the chemical conditions necessary for subsequent mercury reactions whereby only a few neurons fit within this goldilocks zone and are thus successfully stained. Based on our review and our experimental investigations, we propose the first comprehensive mechanism of the Golgi–Cox stain. Our literature survey and experimental data have been synthesised into a resource for both new and experienced practitioners of histology.
items.authors: Brooklyn Rose Wright, Karen Hakobyan, George Paxinos, Mustafa S. Kassem
items.title_zh: 高尔基-考克斯染色的化学机制研究
items.summary_zh: 本综述对高尔基-考克斯染色进行了理论讨论和实验研究。尽管该方法在组织学中已使用数百年且操作相对简单，但其化学机制仍存在显著不确定性。我们发现，高尔基-考克斯染色不能简单理解为染料扩散过程，而是组织结构、固定、铬介导的氧化还原化学、汞结合、pH值和细胞组成相互作用的结果。膜和脂质的完整性影响染色，而铬依赖的pH和氧化还原状态变化则创造了后续汞反应所需的化学条件，只有少数神经元适合这一“恰到好处”的区域并成功染色。基于我们的综述和实验研究，我们提出了高尔基-考克斯染色的首个综合机制。我们的文献调查和实验数据为组织学的新手和经验丰富的从业者提供了参考资源。
items.l1_lead: 高尔基-考克斯染色的化学机制复杂，涉及组织结构、固定、铬介导的氧化还原反应及细胞组成等多重因素，而非单纯的染料扩散过程。
items.l2_summary:
本综述对高尔基-考克斯染色（Golgi-Cox staining）进行了深入的理论探讨和实验研究，旨在揭示其背后的化学机制。尽管高尔基-考克斯染色法在组织学中已有数百年的应用历史，并且操作相对简单，但其具体的化学机制仍然存在显著的不确定性。研究表明，高尔基-考克斯染色并不能简单地视为染料的扩散过程，而是一个复杂的相互作用结果，涉及到组织结构、固定、铬（chromium）介导的氧化还原化学、汞（mercury）结合、pH值以及细胞组成等多个因素。

在这一过程中，膜和脂质的完整性对染色效果有显著影响，而铬依赖的pH值和氧化还原状态的变化则为后续的汞反应创造了必要的化学条件。研究发现，只有少数神经元能够适应这一“恰到好处”的区域，从而成功地被染色。这一发现强调了高尔基-考克斯染色的选择性和复杂性，表明其效果不仅依赖于染料的性质，还与细胞的微环境密切相关。

基于我们的文献调查和实验数据，我们提出了高尔基-考克斯染色的首个综合机制。这一机制为组织学的新手和经验丰富的从业者提供了重要的参考资源，帮助他们更好地理解和应用这一经典的染色方法。通过对高尔基-考克斯染色的深入研究，我们不仅揭示了其化学机制的复杂性，也为未来的研究提供了新的思路和方向。

items.title: A Pan-YTHDF Probe Enables Chemical Modulation and Dissection of RNA m6A Reader Programs
items.abstract: Genetic perturbation has been central to defining the functions of RNA modification binding proteins (readers), but knockout approaches remove the entire protein and cannot readily distinguish modification-dependent reader activity from other protein-associated functions. Small molecules provide an orthogonal strategy by directly perturbing the reader protein–RNA recognition event while preserving the reader protein. Here we report DF142, a cell-active pan-YTHDF chemical probe developed through an m6A-anchored design strategy. Structure-guided optimization yielded a high-affinity ligand that engages endogenous YTHDF proteins, blocks YTHDF–m6A RNA recognition, and displays a favorable selectivity profile. In mouse B cells, DF142 closely recapitulated the transcriptional effects of genetic Ythdf1/2 loss but induced minimal effects in Ythdf1/2-deficient cells at the applied dose range, distinguishing m6A-dependent from putative m6A-independent programs. In AML cells, application of DF142 revealed a leukemia-relevant RNA program associated with YTHDF–m6A interactions. Its activity in cancer cells and mouse models further demonstrates the utility of DF142 for interrogating YTHDF function in disease-relevant settings. Together, these findings establish DF142 as a chemical probe for dissecting m6A-dependent YTHDF biology.
items.authors: Wenlong Li, Linda Zhang, Zhong Zheng, Pingluan Wang, Yutao Zhao, Yanming Chen
items.title_zh: 一种全YTHDF探针实现RNA m6A识别程序的化学调控与解析
items.summary_zh: RNA修饰结合蛋白（读者）的功能定义主要依赖于基因干扰，但基因敲除方法无法区分依赖于修饰的读者活性与其他蛋白功能。小分子提供了一种正交策略，通过直接干扰读者蛋白与RNA的识别事件，同时保留读者蛋白。我们开发了DF142，这是一种通过m6A锚定设计策略获得的细胞活性全YTHDF化学探针。结构导向优化获得了高亲和力配体，能够结合内源性YTHDF蛋白，阻断YTHDF与m6A RNA的识别，并显示出良好的选择性。在小鼠B细胞中，DF142的转录效应与Ythdf1/2基因缺失的效果相似，但在Ythdf1/2缺失细胞中仅产生最小影响，区分了m6A依赖和假定的m6A独立程序。在急性髓系白血病细胞中，DF142的应用揭示了与YTHDF–m6A相互作用相关的白血病相关RNA程序。这些发现确立了DF142作为解析m6A依赖YTHDF生物学的化学探针的实用性。
items.l1_lead: 研究开发的DF142探针能够有效区分m6A依赖与非依赖的YTHDF蛋白功能，为解析RNA m6A修饰的生物学提供了新的化学工具。
items.l2_summary:
本研究开发了一种全YTHDF化学探针DF142，旨在实现RNA的m6A修饰识别程序的化学调控与解析。RNA修饰结合蛋白（读者，reader）的功能通常依赖于基因干扰技术，但传统的基因敲除方法无法有效区分依赖于修饰的读者活性与其他蛋白的功能。为了解决这一问题，研究者们采用小分子干扰策略，通过直接干扰读者蛋白与RNA的结合，同时保留读者蛋白的存在。DF142是通过m6A锚定设计策略获得的细胞活性探针，其结构经过优化，获得了高亲和力的配体，能够有效结合内源性YTHDF蛋白，并阻断其与m6A RNA的识别，显示出良好的选择性。

在小鼠B细胞实验中，DF142的转录效应与Ythdf1/2基因缺失的效果相似，但在Ythdf1/2缺失细胞中仅产生最小影响，这一结果有效区分了m6A依赖的程序与假定的m6A独立程序。此外，在急性髓系白血病细胞中应用DF142，揭示了与YTHDF–m6A相互作用相关的白血病相关RNA程序。这些发现表明DF142作为解析m6A依赖YTHDF生物学的化学探针具有重要的实用性，为进一步研究RNA修饰的生物学功能提供了新的工具和思路。通过DF142的应用，研究者能够更深入地理解m6A修饰在细胞生物学中的作用及其在疾病中的潜在影响。

items.title: GITT Evaluation with PyBaMM
items.abstract: The accuracy of the galvanostatic intermittent titration technique (GITT) for determining solidstate lithium diffusion coefficients was systematically evaluated using synthetic data generated with Doyle–Fuller–Newman model in PyBaMM. GITT-derived diffusion coefficients were compared with the known values used to generate the data across a broad range of possible material properties. GITT systematically underestimated the diffusion coefficient, with absolute errors increasing at higher diffusivities. For an optimized cell, reliable determination was generally limited to D ≤ 10 -14 m2/s, while a non-optimized cell provided much worse performance. These results demonstrate that GITT-derived diffusivities should be used with caution for quantitative battery-model parametrization. Nevertheless, GITT remains useful for comparative materials evaluation when cell design and analysis conditions are kept consistent.
items.authors: Marcin Kwidziński

items.title: Fully Atomistic Vibrational Free Energy of Molecular Crystals Using Distributed Multipole Moments
items.abstract: Predicting the most stable crystal structure of a given molecule at given temperature and pressure remains challenging. While many crystal structure prediction (CSP) methods focus on identifying the structures with the lowest lattice energy at 0 K, there is growing recognition that accurate predictions require evaluating the vibrational free energy at the temperature(s) of interest. In current workflows, such evaluation is either carried out on a few putative structures using computationally demanding atomistic electronic structure calculations or on a larger number of structures using less expensive and less accurate force field approaches under the rigid-body approximation. There is thus a need for methods that offer a better compromise between accuracy and computational cost. We present, for the first time, lattice dynamics expressions that allow for a fully atomistic treatment of molecular flexibility with a force field commonly used in CSP, where electrostatic interactions are modelled with distributed multipole moments. We implement these expressions in the CrystalDynamics algorithm to calculate dispersion curves, phonon densities of states and vibrational free energies. We demonstrate the application of CrystalDynamics to molecular crystals of three compounds of increasing size and flexibility. The use of analytical derivations results in an efficient evaluation of the free energy of molecular crystals. Our work facilitates the study of relative stability as a function of temperature, enabling the evaluation of enantiotropic transitions between crystal forms. Thanks to its low computational cost, the approach can be integrated into CSP protocols to bridge the gap between static lattice energies at 0 K and temperature-dependent free energies.
items.authors: Stefanos Konstantinopoulos, Claire S. Adjiman
items.title_zh: 分布多极矩法下分子晶体的全原子振动自由能计算
items.summary_zh: 预测给定分子在特定温度和压力下的最稳定晶体结构仍然具有挑战性。现有的晶体结构预测方法主要集中在0 K下识别最低晶格能的结构，但越来越多的研究认识到，准确的预测需要在感兴趣的温度下评估振动自由能。当前的工作流程通常在少数假设结构上进行计算密集型的原子电子结构计算，或在较多结构上使用成本较低但精度较差的力场方法。为此，我们首次提出了允许全原子处理分子灵活性的晶格动力学表达式，并在CrystalDynamics算法中实现，计算色散曲线、声子态密度和振动自由能。我们展示了CrystalDynamics在三种不同大小和灵活性的分子晶体中的应用，证明了该方法的有效性。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种新方法，通过全原子处理分子灵活性，利用CrystalDynamics算法计算分子晶体的振动自由能，提升了晶体结构预测的准确性。
items.l2_summary:
在分子晶体的研究中，预测在特定温度和压力下的最稳定晶体结构仍然面临诸多挑战。现有的晶体结构预测方法主要集中在绝对零度（0 K）下识别最低晶格能的结构，但越来越多的研究表明，准确的预测需要在感兴趣的温度下评估振动自由能。当前的研究工作流程通常依赖于在少数假设结构上进行计算密集型的原子电子结构计算，或者在较多结构上使用成本较低但精度较差的力场方法。为了解决这一问题，研究者首次提出了一种新的晶格动力学表达式，允许全原子处理分子灵活性，并在CrystalDynamics算法中实现了这一方法。该算法能够计算色散曲线、声子态密度和振动自由能，从而为分子晶体的研究提供了更为精确的工具。

在实际应用中，研究者展示了CrystalDynamics在三种不同大小和灵活性的分子晶体中的有效性。这一方法的实施不仅提高了对分子晶体振动自由能的计算精度，还为后续的晶体结构预测提供了新的思路。通过对比不同结构的振动特性，研究者能够更好地理解分子晶体的稳定性及其在特定条件下的行为。这一研究成果为分子晶体的设计与优化提供了重要的理论基础，推动了材料科学领域的进一步发展。

items.title: Selective and Modular Synthesis of N1 and C3 Dialkylated Indoles via Iridium-Catalyzed Hydrogen Borrowing
items.abstract: An iridium-catalyzed strategy for the modular synthesis of N1,C3-dialkylated indoles from readily available alcohols and indolines is presented. The method enables the selective installation of two distinct substituents via N-alkylation, dehydrogenation, and C-alkylation. Mechanistic studies support a borrowing hydrogen pathway that overcomes the challenging C-alkylation of N-protected indoles.
items.authors: Emanuele Silvi, Magnus J. Johansson, Belén Martín-Matute

items.title: BET Bromodomain Pan-D1-Biased Inhibitors with Improved Drug-Like Properties and hERG Profiles as Therapies for Inflammatory Liver Injury
items.abstract: BET bromodomain inhibitors are efficacious as anti-inflammatory compounds, but clinical translation is hampered by dose-limiting toxicities from non-selective inhibition. We herein report compounds 16 and 26, based on previously reported 4-methyl-1,2,3-triazole-based inhibitor, DW34. 16 has a BRD4 BD1 Ki of 10 nM, and up to 13–38-fold selectivity for BRD4 BD1 over other BD2 domains, and an improved hERG affinity of 4.24 µM over DW34. 26, A biscyclopropyl analog of 16 showed further enhancement of BD1 selectivity over BD2 (26–203-fold), but exhibited more potent hERG inhibition. Compound 16 had improved liver and plasma clearance over DW34, with good biodistribution to the liver, and had an intracellular target-engagement affinity Ki of 92 nM, with reduction of Ccl2, Cxcl1, AST, and ALT in in vitro and in vivo mouse models of liver inflammation. 16 represents a useful lead for treating inflammatory liver diseases, with improved specificity, drug-like properties, and reduced hERG affinity.
items.authors: Nora R. Vail, Luke C. Doskey, Elliott J. Peterson, Cole R. Scholtz, Ricardo Gallardo-Macias, Shalil Khanal

items.title: Photophysics and Triplet Sensitization of the Molecular Lanthanide YbQ3
items.abstract: The energy transfer mechanism between organic ligands and lanthanide-based near-infrared emitters, such as ytterbium ions (Yb3+), is of great photophysical interest. In recent years, lanthanides have attracted attention for their capacity for both up-and down-conversion for a range of applications. While lanthanides generally have extremely small absorption cross-sections, their light-matter interaction can be complemented by an appropriate choice of chromophore ligand. Here, we investigate intramolecular ligand-to-Yb3+ triplet energy transfer in ytterbium tris(8-hydroxyquinoline) (YbQ3) molecule as well as the intermolecular sensitization of Yb3+ by palladium(II) octaethylporphyrin (PdOEP). We find that the intramolecular sensitization leads to a Yb3+ photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) of (9.7 ± 1.0)% and and that the local ligand environment results in a relatively short lanthanide emission lifetime of 12.1 ± 0.1 µs. As for the intermolecular energy transfer mechanism in the YbQ3/PdOEP mixture, this is governed by a dynamic quenching of the phosphorescence from PdOEP. Despite the relatively weak collisional probability of energy transfer, requiring ∼ 400 collision events in solution, the PLQY of Yb3+ emission in the mixture was (4.5 ± 0.7)% for selective PdOEP excitation. These results indicate that while triplets can be effective sensitizers for near-infrared lanthanide emission, careful design of the sensitization pathway is required.
items.authors: Syed Hamad Ullah Shah, Ben P. Carwithen, Cameron M. Gould, Damon M. de Clercq, Liam L. Gotley, Irfan M. Khan
items.title_zh: 分子镧系元素YbQ3的光物理特性与三重态敏化研究
items.summary_zh: 有机配体与基于镧系元素的近红外发射体（如铒离子Yb3+）之间的能量转移机制具有重要的光物理意义。近年来，镧系元素因其在多种应用中的上转换和下转换能力而受到关注。本文研究了铒三(8-羟基喹啉)(YbQ3)分子中配体到Yb3+的分子内三重态能量转移，以及通过二价钯八乙基卟啉(PdOEP)对Yb3+的分子间敏化。研究发现，分子内敏化使Yb3+的光致发光量子产率(PLQY)达到(9.7 ± 1.0)%，而局部配体环境导致镧系元素的发射寿命相对较短，为12.1 ± 0.1 µs。在YbQ3/PdOEP混合物中的分子间能量转移机制由PdOEP的磷光动态猝灭主导。尽管能量转移的碰撞概率相对较弱，需约400次碰撞事件，选择性激发PdOEP时Yb3+的PLQY为(4.5 ± 0.7)%。这些结果表明，三重态可以有效地敏化近红外镧系元素。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，分子镧系元素YbQ3中配体的三重态能量转移可以有效提高Yb3+的光致发光量子产率，显示出其在近红外发射体中的应用潜力。
items.l2_summary:
本文研究了分子镧系元素铒三(8-羟基喹啉)(YbQ3)的光物理特性，特别关注了有机配体与镧系元素Yb3+之间的能量转移机制。近年来，镧系元素因其在上转换和下转换应用中的潜力而备受关注，尤其是铒离子Yb3+在近红外发射体中的应用。研究表明，YbQ3中配体到Yb3+的分子内三重态能量转移显著影响了其光致发光量子产率(PLQY)，达到了(9.7 ± 1.0)%。然而，局部配体环境的影响导致Yb3+的发射寿命相对较短，仅为12.1 ± 0.1 µs。

此外，研究还探讨了通过二价钯八乙基卟啉(PdOEP)对Yb3+的分子间敏化作用。在YbQ3/PdOEP混合物中，能量转移机制主要受到PdOEP的磷光动态猝灭的主导。尽管能量转移的碰撞概率相对较弱，需约400次碰撞事件才能实现有效的能量转移，但在选择性激发PdOEP时，Yb3+的PLQY仍达到了(4.5 ± 0.7)%。这些结果表明，三重态能量转移机制能够有效地敏化近红外镧系元素，为未来在光电材料和相关应用中的研究提供了重要的理论基础和实验依据。

items.title: Embedded Morgan Fingerprints for more efficient molecular property predictions with machine learning
items.abstract: High-dimensional molecular fingerprints have become a quiet bottleneck for chemical machine learning, where bit collisions in large, chemically diverse datasets and escalating computational costs constrain model discovery. This work introduces the embedded Morgan Fingerprint (eMFP), a post-processing scheme that compresses standard Morgan Fingerprints into continuously valued, lower-dimensional representations governed by a compression factor q. Applied to three molecular datasets of increasing size (RedDB, Non-Fullerene Acceptors and QM9), five regression models and four encoding configurations under scaffold-aware nested cross-validation, eMFP maintains the predictive power of full-length fingerprints for tree-based methods at moderate compression (q≤32), while exhibiting more model- and setting-dependent behaviour elsewhere. Its continuous outputs pair favourably with Fourier Feature Neural Networks, where they interact more naturally with sinusoidal feature mappings than the original binary fingerprints, and consistently shorten training times per trial. Together, these results position eMFP as a simple, drop-in route to more scalable molecular representations that retain accuracy while easing the computational burden of model development.
items.authors: Emilio Nuñez-Andrade, Isaac Vidal-Daza, Rafael Gomez-Bombarelli, James W. Ryan, Francisco J. Martin-Martinez
items.title_zh: 嵌入式摩根指纹提高分子性质预测效率
items.summary_zh: 高维分子指纹已成为化学机器学习中的瓶颈，数据集中的位碰撞和计算成本的上升限制了模型的发现。本研究提出了嵌入式摩根指纹（eMFP），一种后处理方案，将标准摩根指纹压缩为由压缩因子q控制的连续值低维表示。我们在三个逐渐增大的分子数据集（RedDB、非富勒烯受体和QM9）上应用了eMFP，并在考虑支架的嵌套交叉验证下使用了五个回归模型和四种编码配置。结果表明，在适度压缩（q≤32）时，eMFP保持了树基方法的全长指纹的预测能力，同时在其他情况下表现出更依赖模型和设置的行为。其连续输出与傅里叶特征神经网络配合良好，能更自然地与正弦特征映射交互，并且在每次试验中一致缩短训练时间。这些结果使eMFP成为一种简单、可扩展的分子表示方法，能够保持准确性并减轻模型开发的计算负担。
items.l1_lead: 嵌入式摩根指纹（eMFP）通过压缩标准摩根指纹，提高了分子性质预测的效率，同时保持了预测能力，减轻了模型开发的计算负担。
items.l2_summary:
高维分子指纹在化学机器学习中已成为一个重要的瓶颈，主要由于数据集中的位碰撞和计算成本的上升限制了模型的发现。为了解决这一问题，本研究提出了一种新的后处理方案——嵌入式摩根指纹（eMFP），该方法将标准摩根指纹压缩为由压缩因子q控制的连续值低维表示。研究团队在三个逐渐增大的分子数据集上进行了实验，包括RedDB、非富勒烯受体和QM9，采用了五个回归模型和四种编码配置，并在考虑支架的嵌套交叉验证下进行评估。

实验结果表明，在适度压缩（q≤32）的情况下，eMFP能够保持树基方法的全长指纹的预测能力，这一发现显示出eMFP在分子性质预测中的有效性。同时，在其他情况下，eMFP的表现则更依赖于具体的模型和设置。值得注意的是，eMFP的连续输出与傅里叶特征神经网络（Fourier feature neural networks）结合良好，能够更自然地与正弦特征映射进行交互，并且在每次实验中都能显著缩短训练时间。这些结果表明，eMFP不仅是一种简单、可扩展的分子表示方法，还能够在保持预测准确性的同时减轻模型开发的计算负担。因此，eMFP为分子性质预测提供了一种高效的解决方案，具有广泛的应用潜力。

items.title: Integrating Pathway Engineering and FoTO1-Mediated Oxidation for Taxadien-5α-ol Production
items.abstract: Microbial reconstruction of paclitaxel biosynthesis is hindered by limited taxadiene (1) supply and poor selectivity in the first oxidative step. Here, we engineered Escherichia coli for the efficient de novo production of taxadien-5α-ol (2) by integrating enhanced taxadiene (1) biosynthesis with selective oxidation. Coordinated engineering of taxadiene synthase expression, precursor supply, pathway regulation, and geranylgeranyl diphosphate synthase increased the titer of 1 7.5-fold, from 20.3 to 152.6 mg L−1. However, the CYP725A4–cytochrome P450 reductase fusion produced only 2.2 mg L−1 of 2, representing 7.4% of the detected oxygenated taxanes. Coexpression of facilitator of taxane oxidation 1 (FoTO1) markedly redirected the oxidation profile toward 2, increasing its proportion to 94.2% and its titer 20.8-fold to 45.5 mg L−1. Subsequent fermentation optimization increased the titer to 74.0 mg L−1, and addition of a 15% (v/v) n-dodecane overlay further increased production to 179.9 mg L−1. To our knowledge, this represents the highest reported titer of individually quantified taxadien-5α-ol (2) in a heterologous microbial host. These results highlight the importance of coupling precursor supply with control of oxidation selectivity and establish an efficient platform for further reconstruction of microbial paclitaxel biosynthesis.
items.authors: Haixin Li, Shuyao Xu, Mingyu Yue, Lianchun Deng, Hui-Min Xu, Hongwei Chen

items.title: Treatise on Present Practice and Perspectives of MDGC
items.abstract: The state of affairs of multidimensional gas chromatography (MDGC) at present is no more than an implementation of a two-dimensional form (2D-GC) reducing the domain to the setup known as GCxGC. Introduced in 1991 with great expectation, however, GCxGC still happen to fall short of realizing the anticipated capabilities despite continuous efforts made over the elapsed 35 years. This got quantitative formulation in regard of separation performance as early as 2008, proving that it failed to be competitive with a well-governed 1D-GC. The present paper highlights further limitations of GCxGC: inadequate operation burdened with shortcomings are presented via examples taken from GCxGC literature; crowning the list with the inability to meet fundamental requirement that if a compound can be analyzed by 1D-GC it must remain analyzable by MDGC. The repertoire of the intertwining issues, each of which unavoidably rigs or even hamstrings the others, highlights that GCxGC has a built-in self-limiting feature. Attempts to overcome confinements via loosening the binding conditions turned GCxGC back to the form it emerged from decades ago, yet without getting rid of the hampering curbs. The unfavorable overall picture forces to consider viabilities of other concepts, with focus on avoiding errors and pitfalls of GCxGC while fulfilling basic requirements of MDGC. In our view, there are two alternatives. One is ZGC, principle of which was introduced in 1989, requirements and potential of which are presented here in more detail; the other is a concept called Quantum-GC, which is presented as an introductory approach.
items.authors: E. Fuggerth

items.title: A Catalyst Discovery Workflow Coupling MLIP with MOBO for Nitrite-to-Hydroxylamine Electroreduction
items.abstract: The selectivity of electrocatalytic nitrite reduction to hydroxylamine is governed by multiple coupled steps within the multi-electron nitrogen–oxygen reduction network, which cannot be represented simultaneously by a volcano relation based on a single adsorption descriptor. To address this limitation, a catalyst discovery workflow coupling machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) with multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) is developed. A small set of physical descriptors maps discrete oxide–dopant candidates onto a low-dimensional continuous representation, while four thermodynamic objectives describe the competing steps in NH2OH formation. The MLIP provides unified, low-cost structural and energy evaluation for oxide candidates. A Gaussian process surrogate model together with expected hypervolume improvement sequentially selects candidates from the discrete pool and updates the Pareto front within a fixed evaluation budget. The workflow integrates chemical objectives, energy evaluation, and sequential decision-making for catalyst screening in oxide systems.
items.authors: Zhiyi Yu, Huaiwen Zhang, Weiming Zhao
items.title_zh: 结合机器学习和多目标优化的亚硝酸盐电还原催化剂发现工作流程
items.summary_zh: 电催化亚硝酸盐还原为羟胺的选择性受多步耦合反应控制，无法仅通过单一吸附描述符的火山关系同时表示。为解决这一限制，本文开发了一种结合机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）与多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）的催化剂发现工作流程。通过一小组物理描述符，将离散的氧化物-掺杂剂候选者映射到低维连续表示，同时四个热力学目标描述了羟胺形成中的竞争步骤。MLIP为氧化物候选者提供统一、低成本的结构和能量评估。高斯过程代理模型与期望超体积改进相结合，顺序选择离散池中的候选者，并在固定评估预算内更新帕累托前沿。该工作流程整合了化学目标、能量评估和顺序决策，为氧化物系统中的催化剂筛选提供了支持。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种结合机器学习和多目标优化的催化剂发现工作流程，有效解决了亚硝酸盐电还原中多步耦合反应的选择性控制问题。
items.l2_summary:
本文提出了一种结合机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）与多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）的催化剂发现工作流程，旨在解决电催化亚硝酸盐还原为羟胺过程中选择性受多步耦合反应控制的问题。传统方法无法通过单一吸附描述符的火山关系来同时表示这一复杂过程，因此本研究通过引入一小组物理描述符，将离散的氧化物-掺杂剂候选者映射到低维连续表示中，以便更好地描述羟胺形成中的竞争步骤。

在这一工作流程中，MLIP为氧化物候选者提供了统一且低成本的结构和能量评估，显著提高了催化剂筛选的效率。通过高斯过程代理模型与期望超体积改进相结合，研究者能够在固定的评估预算内顺序选择离散池中的候选者，并更新帕累托前沿。这种方法不仅整合了化学目标和能量评估，还优化了决策过程，为氧化物系统中的催化剂筛选提供了有效支持。

总的来说，该工作流程通过创新的机器学习和优化技术，提升了催化剂发现的效率和准确性，为未来的电催化研究提供了新的思路和方法。

items.title: Chemically Neutral, Electrokinetically Charged: Ligand Shell Thickness Governs the Zeta Potential and In Vivo Fate of Ultrasmall HfO2 Nanoparticles
items.abstract: Nanoparticles are extensively explored in biological contexts, and while their core composition determines their specific functionality, surface chemistry governs their interactions with the biological environment. In this work, we used ultrasmall (d 5 nm) hafnium oxide nanoparticles as a model system, given their biocompatibility and established use in contrast-enhanced X-ray computed tomography and external-beam radiotherapy. We systematically compared three surface ligands featuring the same high-affinity nitrocatechol anchoring group but different terminal moieties: a short ethylene glycol (EG) oligomer, a 2 kDa polyethylene glycol (PEG) polymer, and a short zwitterionic (ZW) chain. Despite the neutral character of all ligand tails, only the long PEG chains yielded nanoparticles with a near-neutral zeta potential. The short ligands produced nanoparticles with significantly negative zeta potentials (-30 mV), which was found to be an essential component of their colloidal stability. NPs stabilized with short EG or ZW ligands exhibited enhanced uptake by THP-1 macrophages in vitro and short circulation times in vivo in zebrafish larvae, despite suppressed protein corona formation on ZW nanoparticles. The ZW nanoparticles thus present antifouling but not stealth behavior. In contrast, nanoparticles stabilized with long PEG chains largely escaped detection by the phagocyte system. They exhibited prolonged circulation and extravasation in the zebrafish larva model. Zeta potential showed the strongest correlation with macrophage uptake and biodistribution. It reflects the combined effect of surface charge and steric screening. These results highlight the need for long ligand tails for the design of targeted nanomaterials for therapeutic of imaging applications, which require long circulation times.
items.authors: Elizaveta Maksimova, David Wang, Megan Stierli, Nikolina Veljancic, Oya Tagit, Jörg Huwyler
items.title_zh: 化学中性、带电电动：配体壳厚度影响超小HfO2纳米颗粒的电位与体内命运
items.summary_zh: 纳米颗粒在生物领域广泛研究，其核心成分决定特定功能，而表面化学则影响与生物环境的相互作用。本研究以超小（直径5纳米）氧化铪纳米颗粒为模型，因其生物相容性及在对比增强X射线计算机断层扫描和外部束放射治疗中的应用。我们系统比较了三种表面配体，均具有相同的高亲和力硝基儿茶酚锚定基团，但末端基团不同：短链乙二醇（EG）寡聚物、2 kDa聚乙二醇（PEG）聚合物和短链两性离子（ZW）链。尽管所有配体尾部均为中性，只有长链PEG使纳米颗粒具有近中性的电位。短链配体产生的纳米颗粒电位显著负值（-30 mV），这是其胶体稳定性的关键因素。用短链EG或ZW配体稳定的纳米颗粒在体外被THP-1巨噬细胞摄取增强，在斑马鱼幼虫中循环时间短，尽管ZW纳米颗粒的蛋白冠形成受到抑制。ZW纳米颗粒表现出抗污但非隐形行为，而长链PEG稳定的纳米颗粒则大部分逃避了吞噬细胞系统的检测。
items.l1_lead: 配体壳厚度显著影响超小HfO2纳米颗粒的电位和生物体内命运，长链PEG配体可提高纳米颗粒的生物相容性和循环时间。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了超小（直径5纳米）氧化铪（HfO2）纳米颗粒在生物环境中的行为，重点分析了不同表面配体的壳厚度对其电位及体内命运的影响。氧化铪纳米颗粒因其良好的生物相容性而被广泛应用于对比增强X射线计算机断层扫描和外部束放射治疗等领域。研究中比较了三种具有相同高亲和力硝基儿茶酚锚定基团的表面配体，分别为短链乙二醇（EG）寡聚物、2 kDa聚乙二醇（PEG）聚合物和短链两性离子（ZW）链。尽管所有配体的末端基团均为中性，结果显示，只有长链PEG能够使纳米颗粒呈现近中性的电位，而短链配体则导致纳米颗粒电位显著为负值（-30 mV），这一特性对其胶体稳定性至关重要。

在体外实验中，使用短链EG或ZW配体稳定的纳米颗粒被THP-1巨噬细胞的摄取显著增强，表明这些纳米颗粒在生物体内的识别能力较强。此外，在斑马鱼幼虫模型中，短链配体稳定的纳米颗粒循环时间较短，显示出其在体内的快速清除特性。尽管ZW纳米颗粒的蛋白冠形成受到抑制，但其仍表现出抗污但非隐形的行为。相对而言，长链PEG稳定的纳米颗粒则大部分能够逃避吞噬细胞系统的检测，显示出其在生物体内的隐形特性。

综上所述，配体的壳厚度和电位对超小HfO2纳米颗粒在生物环境中的行为有显著影响，长链PEG配体能够有效提高纳米颗粒的生物相容性和体内循环时间，而短链配体则可能导致更强的细胞摄取和更短的循环时间。这一发现为纳米颗粒的设计和应用提供了重要的理论基础和实践指导。

items.title: Controlled Buildup of Multiply Charged Anionic Clusters at Interfaces Using Anion-Anion Reactions
items.abstract: Reactions between ions of identical polarity are usually prevented by a strong Coulomb barrier in the gas phase. Here, we systematically investigate the binding of gaseous reactive anions to anions at a vacuum layer interface and develop our findings into a method for the controlled build-up of highly charged molecular anions and nanoclusters. Following a previous observation of dimeric ions in trace amounts upon the mass-selective deposition of the reactive fragment anion [B 12 I 11 ] – , the procedure was optimized here to oligomerize such ions, resulting in highly charged anionic chains. The surface products were detected using electrospray mass spectrometry after their dissolution. Experimental and computational investigations show that the isolated multiply charged ions are metastable against charge-separating fragmentation. Sequential deposition of two distinct reactive anions enables the formation of mixed oligomers. The deposition sequence and ion-beam focus can control the interfacial reaction, thereby enabling the selective generation of constitutional isomers. To generate stable anions with high negative charge states, ions featuring a positive center for Coulomb stabilization and multiple interface-active organic groups for anion binding were deposited sequentially with reactive anions. Stable products with a negative charge state of –7 were detected as free gaseous anions, surpassing the known limits of negative charge states of similarly sized ions. Finally, we demonstrate that this concept of targeted anion-anion reactions at interfaces can be extended to other functional ions, paving the way for a broadly applicable approach to interface design with charged building blocks and, therefore, offering potential applications in charge-state-based multilevel memory nodes, electrode functionalization, and photonics. Furthermore, the generated products provide fundamental insights into excess charge stabilization in nanosized units and reactivity in highly charged environments.
items.authors: Kay Antonio Behrend, Markus Rohdenburg, Pia K. Schäferjohann, Harald Knorke, Aby-Paul Benny, Tillmann G. Fischer
items.title_zh: 利用阴离子-阴离子反应在界面上控制多重带电阴离子团簇的积累
items.summary_zh: 本文系统研究了气相反应阴离子与真空层界面阴离子的结合，并发展出一种控制高度带电分子阴离子和纳米团簇积累的方法。在对反应性片段阴离子[B12I11]–进行质量选择性沉积后，观察到微量的二聚离子，并优化了该过程以使其聚合，形成高度带电的阴离子链。通过电喷雾质谱检测到表面产物。实验和计算研究表明，孤立的多重带电离子对电荷分离碎裂是亚稳态的。顺序沉积两种不同的反应性阴离子可形成混合寡聚物。沉积顺序和离子束聚焦能够控制界面反应，从而选择性生成构象异构体。为生成高负电荷态的稳定阴离子，具有正电中心和多个界面活性有机基团的离子与反应性阴离子顺序沉积，检测到负电荷态为–7的稳定产物。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种新方法，通过控制阴离子在界面上的反应，实现多重带电阴离子团簇的积累和稳定生成，具有重要的应用潜力。
items.l2_summary:
本文系统研究了气相反应阴离子与真空层界面阴离子的结合，提出了一种控制高度带电分子阴离子和纳米团簇积累的方法。研究中，作者对反应性片段阴离子[B12I11]–进行了质量选择性沉积，观察到微量的二聚离子，并通过优化沉积过程使其聚合，最终形成高度带电的阴离子链。通过电喷雾质谱（Electrospray Mass Spectrometry）检测到的表面产物表明，这些聚合物具有显著的电荷特性。

实验和计算研究表明，孤立的多重带电离子在电荷分离碎裂过程中呈现亚稳态特征。研究还发现，通过顺序沉积两种不同的反应性阴离子，可以形成混合寡聚物，这一过程的沉积顺序和离子束聚焦能够有效控制界面反应，从而选择性生成不同的构象异构体。此外，为了生成高负电荷态的稳定阴离子，研究中采用了具有正电中心和多个界面活性有机基团的离子与反应性阴离子进行顺序沉积，最终检测到负电荷态为–7的稳定产物。

这一研究为多重带电阴离子团簇的积累提供了新的思路，展示了通过界面反应的精确控制可以实现对阴离子特性和结构的调控，具有重要的理论意义和潜在的应用价值。

items.title: Accelerated Hygrothermal Aging of an Epoxy Barrier Coating: Correlating Laboratory Degradation with Performance
items.abstract: This study investigates the hygrothermal aging behavior of an epoxy barrier coating. The coating was subjected to water immersion and dry-heat exposure at 20–80 °C for up to 14 months, and changes in water uptake, tensile properties, and thermal transitions were monitored by gravimetric measurements, tensile testing, dynamic mechanical analysis (DMA), and differential scanning calorimetry (DSC). After two months, combined water and elevated-temperature exposure produced larger reductions in tensile modulus and strength than dry aging, while drying substantially restored the mechanical properties. This indicates that moisture-induced plasticization and swelling account for a major fraction of the early property loss. Longer exposure produced more severe mechanical deterioration, and at 60 °C the material continued to gain mass for up to eight months before subsequent weight loss, consistent with a transition from predominantly diffusioncontrolled water uptake toward degradation-associated behavior. In contrast, DMA and DSC glass-transition temperatures varied only modestly with aging temperature. The results show that mechanical measurements provide a more sensitive indicator of hygrothermal performance than Tg alone for this coating. The study provides material-level evidence relevant to the assessment of rubber-toughened epoxy barrier coatings under combined heat and moisture exposure.
items.authors: Parastou Kharazmi

items.title: Microchemical Strategies and AI-Enabled Biosensing for Non-Invasive Liquid Biopsy in Precision Oncology
items.abstract: Traditional blood-based liquid biopsy platforms have established crucial paradigms in precision oncology by enabling the longitudinal tracking of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) and circulating tumor cells (CTCs).
